articleTitle: Analysis of the business model innovation of the technology of internet of things in postal logistics
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper analyzes the application of the internet of thing technology in postal logistics, prospects the potential structure of the technology of Internet of Things in postal logistics and its impact on the construction of the business model of Internet of Things. It primarily analyses the main way for the technology of Internet of Things to make profitability in postal logistics and discusses the current business models in the point of management and decision making of the industry of Internet of Things. The paper also studies the feature of the business models of Internet of Things in postal logistics combining features of new industry of Internet of Things and characteristics of the postal logistics, puts forward a viable business model, and makes a systematic exposition of the advantage of this model.

Author Keywords: The technology of Internet of Things

articleTitle: Ontology-based semantic web services clustering
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Web service discovery is an important operation in Web service architecture, this paper aims to cluster the Web services before Web service discovery based on OWL-S language. In this paper, Web service ontology is defined. We use Web service function and progress to calculate similarity. Petri net is used to describe Web service process. The Web service similarity is based on an accurate concept semantic similarity of the domain ontology. A domain ontology hierarchy is defined to describe the concept semantic information. The concept semantic similarity is discussed from several aspects, such as the path between two concepts, the path weight, the density of concepts, and the antisense relationship. Finally, we use the Web service similarity to cluster services, and prove the similarity efficiency.

articleTitle: Two-wheel self-balanced car based on Kalman filtering and PID algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Self-balanced car is a typical Incomplete control system. Self-balanced car's body is a natural instability, so it has multivariable, nonlinear, strong coupling and other characteristics. The choice of inertial sensors has become one of the most important issues while designing a self-balanced car. But the sensor module is too expensive that is the reason of the high cost of the self-balanced car. A lower costed acceleration ADXL335 and angular velocity sensor ISZ-650 are chosen to make a sensor module much cheaper and the attitude is measured with Kalman filtering and PID algorithm. Finally a self-balanced car model is made to prove the feasibility of reducing costs.

articleTitle: Risk identification and evaluation research on F-AHP evaluation based supply chain
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With regard to the frequent food supply chain risk incidents situation, This paper divides the hierarchical structure of food supply chain risk factors with F-AHP, and buildes a food supply chain risk factor identification system and risk fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model on the basis of definition of food supply chain. Meanwhile, by taking the food supply chain of one diary producer for example, using the model for empirical research. the conclusion indicates that the F-AHP method can reasonably identification and evaluate the risk on supply chain, it has provided a new method and thought for the research on the risk on supply chain..

articleTitle: Study on double-clutch transmission gear shift control based on optimal control theory
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Twin clutches switching control is one of the keys of double-clutch transmission control. This paper establishes the dynamic models of up-shift and down-shift for the double clutch transmission. Then, taking clutch pressure as optimizing parameter and considering shifting time and ride comfort as optimizing target, this paper researches the clutch pressure control law during gear shifting process, by using the linear quadratic optimal control theory. The vehicle test carried on in this study verifies the optimizing method is effective in improving the quality of shifting.

articleTitle: Resource allocation simulation on operating rooms of hospital
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Operating room (OR) plays a key role in hospitals. Resources required for surgery process include both manpower and facilities. A rational utilization of resource may lead to high efficiency of OR, as well as patients satisfaction. A discrete event system simulation model of ORs in hospital is built under SIMIO. The case study is investigated based on current patients flow and operation data collected from a comprehensive hospital in Ningbo. By simulation, the current resources' utilization and the flow time of surgeries are analyzed. The simulation results indicate problems in current OR's management. Several suggestions based on resource allocation simulation are proposed for improving the OR's efficiency.

articleTitle: Method of diagnostic tree design for system-level faults based on dependency matrix and fault tree
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The feature of testability model and fault tree is analyzed. Based on dependency matrix and fault tree, a new method of diagnostic tree design for system-level faults is proposed. The principle of this method is given. The related definitions and condition assumptions of this method are described in detail. These definitions include standard fault tree, extended dependency matrix, fault detection weight, fault isolation weight, and so on. Two key algorithms and the overall flow of this method are described. The algorithms include extended dependency matrix generation algorithm and diagnostic tree generation algorithm. Finally, a case is given to verify this method. The results show that this new method can efficiently generate the diagnostic tree of system-level faults.

articleTitle: Case study on cluster analysis of the telecom customers based on consumers' behavior
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Customer segmentation is one of important issue in the customer relationship management. It's the means to cluster customer reasonably and effectively in improving economic efficiency of enterprises. This paper proposes a three dimensional model of customer segmentation based on the perspective of customer behavior and clusters the customer group with Kohonen method. Firstly, customer segmentation model was built according to business experience and verified the rationality of it by factor analysis. Chose the suitable variables to describe these three dimensions; secondly, use the Kohonen clustering algorithm to generate customer types. The clustering results were arranged to the eight quadrants. Describe the characteristics of each cluster groups; Thirdly, Marketing strategy was put forward by understanding the customer characteristics. Finally, a case study of the consumption data of a telecom enterprise in the region of Liaoning is given.

articleTitle: Application of improved Taguchi method to the multiresponse optimization
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Taguchi method is the most popular approach for multiresponse optimization. However, the weighting values of responses are ignored in this approach. Thus improved Taguchi method is presented, which applies the principal component analysis to evaluate the weights so that their relative importance can be properly described. The implementation and effectiveness of the proposed method are illustrated by an example from the literature. The results show that improved Taguchi method can optimize the multiresponses.

articleTitle: Empirical investigation on EVA and accounting performance measures: Evidence from China stock market
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Using the data of Chinese listed firms on main board in the year of 2008, this paper investigates the explanatory power to market value added (MVA) of economic value added (EVA) and traditional accounting measures, respectively. The empirical results show that there are significant correlations between EVA and most of the accounting performance measures, such as earnings per share, net profit and return on equity, etc. EVA is superior to traditional accounting measures in its association with market value added, which implies that EVA can reflect the change of firm value more efficiently.

articleTitle: Research on vehicle routing problem with soft time windows based on tabu search algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: A kind of vehicle routing problem about one point provides services to multipoint that contains the constraint conditions of operation time and soft time windows was studied, a minimum cost objective function model was constructed, the thoughts of full arrangement searching and minimum cost of each single route were added to the tabu search algorithm which could obtain the integral optimal solution in all combinations of routing based on the high-speed arithmetic capability of computer, then a practical problem by the program written in Visual Basic was analyzed and solved, it is an effective way to solve the VRP and achieve the production efficiency by working out the artificially intelligent algorithm through the computer.

articleTitle: Application of Six Sigma methodology DMAIC in HR project management —A case study of Motorola SC HR DSS project
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: HR project management has been an important and exciting topic in both academic research and practical conduct. The Human Resource Management areas identified by the Six Sigma approach are frequently appearing as topics in the management literature. This paper presents a typical example in which Six Sigma methodology DMAIC is applied in a Motorola Supply Chain HR project on 3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rd</sup> party contractor hiring. The project not only achieves its set goal of reducing new hire cycle time, but also demonstrates the strengths and simplicity of DMAIC.

articleTitle: Design, implementation and performance of a controller for uninterruptible solar hot water system
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper describes a novel design and implementation of an automatic control system for solar hot water system in both domestic and industrial purpose. The project consists of one 150 liters evacuated tube solar collector, 300 liter storage tank, solenoid valves and an electric water heater. The objective was to implement an embedded system to control how and from which source (collector or electric heater) the hot water is been provided to the user end. The whole system is solely controlled by the controller which decides how the water should flow to the user end. The controller mainly consists of ATmega32 for central processing, LCD for displaying the level of water inside the tanks, segment displays for showing the temperature inside the tank, a regulator for setting the outlet temperature and a button for confirming the set temperature. The controller is powered by a DC power unit.

articleTitle: Aggregate hybrid flowshop scheduling with assembly operations
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper deals with the hybrid flow shop scheduling (HFS) problem with assembly operation. The parts process on the hybrid flow shop stages and after that in order to produce the final product, several parts go under the assembly operations based on the predefined hierarchy structure of products. Each product has some sub-assembly operations and the final product obtains after completion of the last sub-assembly operation. Our aim in this study is finding the schedule that minimizes the completion time of last final product. For considered problem, we first propose an integer programming model and two heuristic algorithms are then employed. Since this problem is NP-hard, we apply the simulated annealing (SA) approach for large sized problems.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation of highway passenger transport enterprises' operation based on the model of AHP-DEA
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Faced with the fierce competition of high-speed rail and intercity rail, the highway passenger transport enterprises how to achieve optimal overall performance? How to evaluate their own performance reasonably and effectively, which can allow companies have better economic efficiency? For these problems, this paper established the evaluation model of DEA-AHP. In this model, it firstly analyzed the qualitative indicators by AHP, which quantified the qualitative indicator service quality of the highway passenger transport enterprises, and made the result as an output item of DEA model. Then, it combined with the other quantitative indicators to make the performance evaluation. Finally, through the empirical analysis, it validated the method is scientific and feasible.

articleTitle: Pricing strategies with recycled products in Reverse Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Using the game theory, a Reverse Supply Chain(RSC) consisting of one manufacturer and two distributors is discussed in the paper. Under the circumstances of both cooperative and non-cooperative member enterprises in the Reverse Supply Chain, a decision-making model is built based on the overall volumes of recycled products and the recycling price as well as the reclaim hard of the distributors separately. Pricing and investment strategies for the recycled products are proposed. Conclusion is drawn that the maximum profit is obtained under the Reverse Supply Chain with the three member enterprises cartelization.

articleTitle: Simulation modeling for weakening bullwhip effect in auto-sales
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: “The bullwhip effect” have serious influence on auto sales chain property and performance. Based on System Dynamics theory, this paper built a model of multi-level auto sales supply chain, made a modeling and simulation research on the bullwhip effect to a scalable multi-agent linear supply chain system. Quantitative analysis on the impact of lead time to the bullwhip effect, and gave corresponding strategies of the weakening impact of the bullwhip effect in the chain.

articleTitle: Study on the braking force allocation dynamic control strategy based on the fuzzy control logic
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The regenerative braking in the electric vehicle is a double-edge sword, which betters the energy saving effect but increase the unsafe hidden dangerous during braking. A braking force allocation dynamic control strategy has been studied in this paper to solve the contradiction between the energy saving and brake security. There are multiple factors to be considered simultaneously, such as the displacement of the brake pedal, the variation rate of the brake pedal displacement, the vehicle speed, the wheel slip rate error and the variation rate of which. So the fuzzy logic controllers are used to solve this problem based on the expert experiences. The results simulated in the Matlab/Simulink model certify that the energy is recovered as much as possible under guaranteeing the wheels out of locking.

articleTitle: An empirical study on spot and futures market price of soybean, soybean oil and soybean meal in China
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper studies the price relations of domestic soybean, soybean oil and soybean meal in spot and futures markets using ADF test, Johansen co-integration test and the Granger causality test. The empirical analysis indicates that spots and futures of soybean, soybean oil and soybean meal are all highly related, and its spot prices occupy the leadership. Spot market guides futures market, the futures price fluctuation of soybean oil leads soybean's spot price. But soybean meal is less correlation with soybean and soybean oil. Further analysis shows that a very small part of soybeans, soybean oil and soybean meal's consumption is from the futures market's delivery. Soybean oil is still strong driving power leading soybean's price. Because of sufficient imports, excess production capacity of soybean processing enterprises, exports of soybean meal limited by the storage and transportation, the soybean price fluctuate slowly though demand of the soybean meal grows year by year.

articleTitle: GA based algorithm for staff scheduling considering learning-forgetting effect
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Learning-forgetting effect reflects productivity changes related to the increment of experience cumulated by previous production volume, which is a critical issue for production efficiency analysis. This paper proposes a GA based staff scheduling methodology for solving personnel efficiency problem caused by learning-forgetting effect, aiming at obtaining scheduling solution in both parallel and serial systems. Individual capability is modeled considering his/her initial and maximum capabilities, as well as learning/forgetting rates on corresponding tasks. Two experiments are designed in scenarios for parallel and serial production lines and strategies of staff scheduling are generated considering learning-forgetting phenomenon. Simulation results illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed methodology.

articleTitle: Using ANP-COPRAS-G method for greenhouse locating
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In this paper, we describe the research and development of hybrid MCDM methods for greenhouse locating. Selection of the most appropriate location for investor is an important problem which requires assessment and analysis of several factors. The paper clarifies the structure of important criteria in greenhouse locating. The six factors identified were: labor, government, environment, physical condition, regional economy and raw materials. In this research, analysis network process (ANP) is applied to find the relative weights among the criteria and to emphasize the interdependent relationships, thus increasing the accuracy of our results COPRAS-G method is applied to rank for five regions in Amol city, in Iran. This article can be a guideline for investors to select the best location for greenhouses.

articleTitle: Kansei engineering in automotive body-side styling design
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This study focused on the relationship between automotive body-side modeling and Kansei image. It is divided into four phases. The first stage: the sample and image words collection; the second stage: the representative sample and representative image semantic choice; the third stage: the establishment of the corresponding relationship between automobile styling elements of image semantics and form features; the fourth stage: the analysis and testing. It established a body side of the segmentation model form factors. Through multivariate analysis, the paper had studied the segments within the study area with correlation analysis, cluster analysis and multiple regression analysis, and got the correspondence of emotional feelings and values of data.

articleTitle: The development of products traceability for enterprise resource planning system
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With the rapid development in management and information technologies, consumers require for products not only on-time delivery, multiple functions, high quality, but also traceability. Manufacturers are required to pinpoint and recall defective products fast and in time, assuring consumers safety and preventing any potential risks. The purpose of this paper is to develop a product tracing module (TRC) for enterprise resource planning system (ERP). We illustrate the concepts of product tracing, including upstream and down-stream tracings for raw materials or components, and a preventive tracing for suppliers or outsourcers. The workflow integration of ERP and TRC is discussed. We also present a digital camera example for the operations of TRC.

articleTitle: The research of road traffic accidents in Henan Province based on the Human Factors Engineering
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: By using the points in Human Factors Engineering, this article analysis the reasons of the road traffic accident in Henan. Based on the research of road traffic accident, the article statistically analysis the reasons from three aspects: human, machine and environment. It explains the relationship between the influences of traffic safety and accidents and also presents subjective preventing recommendations through combination of human, machine and environment.

articleTitle: Study on activity-based cost estimation of steel enterprise
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: For the complexities of production and the limitations and lacks of methods for cost estimation of customized productions, a method for cost estimation based on Case-Based Reasoning was put forward in the steel enterprises. The process flow of the steel productions was analyzed in order to determine every activity in manufacturing steel productions. The descriptive procedure for the cases and the structure of cases database were presented in detail. The algorithm for case retrieving, adapting and learning was presented. The scheme was illustrated and verified by practical applications.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis for CNC machine tool turret including abnormal data
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: NC turret of CNC machine tool is a kind of typical complex subsystem with complicated structure and failure styles. The failure of NC turret is so complicated that the failure data obtained from reliability analysis includes abnormal data, which could bring some error to analysis result. This paper presented a method to eliminate abnormal. Especially, the probability model is discussed in detail. The failure data of some certain CNC machine tool turret is applied to valid the method of eliminating abnormal data presented above. Then, analyze the reliability of NC turret with the remaining data, and obtain its MTBF.

articleTitle: Marketization, FDI and the technological innovation of domestic enterprises—Based on the method of quintile
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper, based on 2001-2005 provincial panel data of large & medium industrial enterprises in China, gives an empirical analysis to the FDI technology spillover mechanism in the process of market reform in China. The empirical results show that: 1) in the control of the market conditions, we found that FDI doesn't affect the technological innovation of domestic enterprises; 2) the improvement of domestic market environment can promote the efficiency of FDI technology spillovers, while FDI can also promote the improvement of domestic market environment, but this interaction is the most obvious when it only includes in the 0.5-0.75 quintile of enterprises technological innovation.

articleTitle: Ontology-based knowledge integration of collaborative design for aviation complex products
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: To solve the problem of knowledge integration difficulty and achieve design knowledge sharing and reuse for the designers, an ontology-based knowledge integration approach of collaborative design for aviation complex products was proposed in this study. In order to realize the ontology integration, ontology modeling of product collaborative design knowledge was conducted firstly based on analysis of composition of collaborative design knowledge. On this basis, an ontology-based knowledge integration model of collaborative design for aviation complex products was constructed. The model transformed the problems of design knowledge integration into knowledge ontology integration problems, and through the establishment of global ontology and local ontology to implement knowledge integration between heterogeneous systems. Finally, a specific application was presented to illustrate the feasibility and validity of the knowledge integration method.

articleTitle: Research on construction project process performance measurement
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Generally, Performance Assessment (PA) of Construction Subject (CS) is based on “Post-Evaluation”. For one-time construction process, PA has limited ability to evaluate the process objectively. The Basic Model of the evaluation upon Process Performance (PP) in Construction Project (CP) was setup in this paper by AHP based on the Fuzzy Evaluation Method, and also by the study of comparison between the Process Performance (PP) concept definition in the construction project and its evaluation, In the mean time, the Model provides the specific guide-lines for evaluation during Construction Project (CP) Performance Assessment (PA) management process.

articleTitle: Research on operation standard expert system based on ontology and CBR
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to effectively support formal representation and reuse of operation standard knowledge, a new operation standard expert system called OS expert system, has been developed based on the integration of ontology and case-based reasoning (CBR). This paper emphatically introduces operation standard ontology, case representation model, case retrieval model and case revision model. Through importing ontology theory into CBR, users can describe cases using any concept or instance of operation standard ontology, which is easier to retrieve and revise cases on the semantic level. The experimental results show that compared with the traditional CBR system, OS expert system has better recall and precision, and it increases the efficiency of establishing operation standard.

articleTitle: Using PCA and ANN to identify significant factors and modeling customer satisfaction for the complex service processes
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper proposes a PCA and ANN based approach to identify significant influential quality factors and modeling customer satisfaction for complex service processes. Firstly, the performance evaluation index system includes initial factors and customer satisfaction degree is proposed, and then the measurement data are collected by questionnaires. Secondly, by using PCA, several preceding principal components (PCs) are extracted, which present about 90% contributions of the whole variations of initial factors. Thirdly, the extracted PCs are converted to new significant factors according to the corresponding coefficients of initial factors in each PC. Finally, BP network is applied to modeling the nonlinear relationship between the significant factors and customer satisfaction degree. The case study of the maintenance service process of an automobile 4S store shows that, the proposed approach can extracted the significant factors from lots of initial factors, and can exactly modeling the complex nonlinear relationship between influential factors and customer satisfaction as well.

articleTitle: An engineering approach for project scoping
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Benefit realization is becoming a critical performance criterion measure for project success. However, the mechanism through which outputs eventually become outcomes has not yet been identified. This paper proposes that an output utilization mechanism is needed to explain the cause and effect relationship between a project's outputs and target outcomes. The paper describes such a utilization mechanism, and discusses its role in the generation of target outcomes. By expanding on the concept of output utilization, the paper suggests the utilization map as a new tool for project scoping.

articleTitle: A research of resequencing problem in automobile paint shops using selectivity banks
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The resequencing operations of using selectivity banks in automobile paint shops is studied in this paper. A 0-1 integer programming model is formulated to describe the process. The objective of the proposed model is to minimize the number of color changes in a car sequence after sorting. A nested ant colony optimization heuristic is developed to find near-optimal solutions. Computational experiments are conducted to evaluate the performance of the presented algorithm. It is shown that the proposed algorithm can effectively and efficiently solve the resequencing problem within reasonable time duration.

articleTitle: An empirical research of cultural industry competitiveness of Tianjin based on gray-fuzzy comprehensive assessment
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: As cultural industry, with the further development of economy and society, is becoming the pillar industry, a more rational urban cultural industry competitiveness evaluation index system is proposed on the existing theories in this paper to evaluate Tianjin's cultural industry competitiveness from the longitudinal to the horizontal aspect by grey fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method. After the quantitative analysis andevaluation, the paper produces the accurate orientation forfurther development of Tianjin's cultural industry competitiveness, furthermore, provides important theoretical guidance as well.

articleTitle: Research on experience reference among cities based on multivariate statistical analysis methods
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The research on experience reference among cities is an important task in Livable City construction. And it's also a question demanding prompt solution currently. In this paper, according to principal components analysis, correlation analysis and cluster analysis, a measurement and comparison model is established. Then, the experience reference method is introduced. And 35 cities of the three major metropolitan regions in eastern China are selected as study cases to verify the model. The result shows that the method is a meaningful attempt.

articleTitle: Posterior probability prediction on the key subsystem of machining center
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to predict the fault probability when the MC is faulty or going to be faulty, a posterior probability method is proposed. Failure Mode, Effects and Criticality Analysis(FMECA) is used for finding out the key subsystem which affects the Machining Center's reliability most seriously. Then, the empirical models of the key subsystem and the whole Machining Center are built based on the fault time, under the assumption that the Machining Center is a Series System, the posterior probability of the key subsystem is obtained by Bayesian theory. The case example shows that the fault probability of the key subsystem changes as the whole system fault probability changes. At a given time t, the fault probability of the key subsystem can be calculated by the empirical models of the key subsystem and whole system

articleTitle: A key characteristics-based model for quality assurance in supply chain
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Quality assurance in supply chain would be more complicated due to multi-organization involvement, collaborative business management, internal & external communication, multi-process alternating, and function crossing. Based on the analysis of key factors for quality assurance in supply chain, a feasible solution is elicited to solve these critical problems. The concept of key characteristics (KCs) is adopted to define the product key features for quality control and improvement. A four-stage KCs-based model covering definition, structure, deployment and assurance is proposed, The model can support KCs transferring in supply chain and assure the product quality responsibilities arrange appropriately, so that buyers and suppliers can collaborate together for quality assurance goals.

articleTitle: Reliability design of CNC system
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Through practical work and theory study of domestic CNC system, it can be found that the reliability of CNC system is still low, the main reason is that depth study of CNC system reliability at design stage is not implemented. Design is the main reason of CNC system failure. Using reliability design measure in design stage of CNC system can decrease failure fundamentally. CNC system reliability design includes reliability design assessment, reliability design principle, reliability design checklist. Using above measures, the reliability of CNC system can be improved effective.

articleTitle: Analysis and enlightenment from traceability of fish products distribution in Iceland
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: A field study was conducted in a fish market and a processing factory in Iceland to evaluate how traceability is secured at fish product distribution. The main characteristics of `One-up-one-down' traceability and the distribution system to assure traceability and the quality of fish products in Iceland are summarized. In addition, the “one-up-one-down” traceability system of fish product distribution in China is explained and suggestions made on how it may be improved. The suggestions consist of general regulation and methods to implement traceability of fish distribution. Recommendations of general regulation contain batch, batch-code, recorded information and recalling. The methods comprise product labeling, recorded information in companies and evidence for tracing the product.

articleTitle: Study on MP-FMEA method for aviation materiel
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on the research of the process FMEA the method of MP-FMEA for aviation materiel was presented, which included the definition of the fault in the maintenance process and its mode. The cause of these faults were studied and classified, the calculation method for RPN in the MP-FMEA was also provided at the same time. At the end of this paper an aero-engine analysis example was used verify the feasibility of the MP-FMEA method. The MP-FMEA method of this paper would be fit for analyzing other kinds of complex materiel's maintenance process to raise their maintenance safety level.

articleTitle: Cation of students innovative and entrepreneurship of China higher engineering colleges
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to further ease the unemployment pressure, colleges worked harder on education of student innovation and entrepreneurship. Colleges had tentatively probed in this aspect. However, there were still some problems, such as shortage of teachers. Colleges should further promote the education reform, and actively explore measures on education of student innovation and entrepreneurship. Particularly, Colleges should further update the concept of innovation and entrepreneurship education and build a sound education system. It should strengthen school-enterprise cooperation to ensure that innovation and entrepreneurship education funding. It also should improve organization and management of technology innovation contest to further develop and improve the innovative ability of college students. Under the background of mass higher education, higher engineering institutions must continue to promote the development of innovation and entrepreneurship education.

articleTitle: Pareto-optimality is a criterion uniting efficiency and justice
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Through analyzing, this paper finds out that Adams' “Equity Theory”, Lorenz Curve, Gini Ratio and Pareto Analysis can be united by Pareto-optimality. Based on the distributive theory and the method of Pareto-optimality, it allows Adams's “Equity Theory” to organically unite the four kinds of justice views on the allocation, and to organically unite the distributive criterion of efficiency and that of justice, which is more scientific significance.

articleTitle: Design and research of conceptual function vehicles under TRIZ Theory
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The Theory of Inventive Problem Solving (TRIZ) is “knowledge on methods”, and designers show Conceptual Products of novel, unique and advanced ideas through concept vehicles. The former is the experience truth of universal significance, the latter is the dream and pursuit of human beings to advanced vehicles, how to organically combine both of them, that is, a new mode of the innovative thinking in the design of concept vehicles is opened up through the TRIZ innovation theory, and the designer can rapidly and accurately find the solution to a problem through the application of the TRIZ theory, to introduce the theory into the product concept design, enable conventionalization to be realized in the problem solution, and enable rules to be followed.

articleTitle: Multiobjective location-transportation problem in post-earthquake delivery of relief materials
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The distribution of relief materials involves facility location and transportation mode selection. From the viewpoint of integrated optimization in emergency logistics systems, a multiobjective optimization model for location-transportation problem is proposed to minimize the total transportation time and the total system loss. A bidimensional matrix encoding and nondominated sort genetic algorithm is proposed. The results of a numerical example show that the algorithm is reliable and can output the Pareto front. Finally, the complexity of the proposed algorithm is analyzed in term of time consumption.

articleTitle: The study of green project management
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Green project management (GPM) research is a new challenge for the development of project management theory. This paper aims at the whole process of project management and proposes a new assessment framework of green project management with a systematic view. This framework will be helpful in improving the effect of implementation for the GPM process. Meanwhile, the paper also carries out some analysis of the contents and objective system of the GPM. Finally, some recommendations for the implementation of the GPM are proposed in the last part.

articleTitle: Uncertainty and construction projects: A new institutional economics perspective
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This article takes the construction project as an adaptation mechanism to uncertainty. In the light of the principles of new institutional economics, the uncertainty caused by information shortage is taken as the main reason for the existence of construction projects, and the complexity of the project itself and the stability of market demand are key factors that affect the uncertainty of projects. An analytical framework is developed. And four governance patterns of the construction project are presented based on the analysis of different combinations between the complexity of the project and the stability of market demand. It is concluded that researches on uncertainty are theoretical bases of project governance.

articleTitle: Research on distributed collaborative design environment supporting complex system-of-systems evolution
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: According to the design requirements of complex system-of-systems, an agent based Evolutionary System-of-Systems Integration Realization environment is presented. Based on some industry standards such as XML, SOAP and WSDL, this environment is designed with peer-to-peer communication between different agents, characterized with standardization of the interfaces, flexibility of the architecture and compatibility with other standard web services frameworks. Such an adaptable framework can effectively support the distributed collaborative design and hence promote the evolutionary integration of complex system-of-systems.

articleTitle: The planning of workshop RFID network based on modified genetic algorithm using metropolis rule
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With the application of RFID in production monitoring, workshop RFID network planning has become an important problem. On the premise of ensuring high read rate and network load balancing, the key is how to allocate network resource, reduce collision between readers, and improve identification probability of tags. This paper, based on the analyzing of network coverage and reader collision, firstly built the mathematic model using bipartite graph and then proposed a modified genetic algorithm using metropolis rule (MGA) to resolve the RFID network planning. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm provide superior performance in network planning. It is shown that the MGA is effective in terms of increasing network coverage and minimizing reader collision.

articleTitle: Entrepreneurial self-efficacy on Pragmatic Learning of Business Practice
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This study examines 422 vocational school students' entrepreneurial self-efficacy and its influencing factors to serve as a school reference for the development of entrepreneurship education measures. The results show that students' `computer self-efficacy (CSE)' has a significant direct effect on `entrepreneurial self-efficacy (ESE)', and `information search behavior (ISB)' has a significant effect on `entrepreneurial self-efficacy' through `computer self-efficacy.' The influence pattern and empirical data of `information search behavior' and `computer self-efficacy' on `entrepreneurial self-efficacy' has a good fit.

articleTitle: An approach to evaluating business models - a case study of Taobao
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Strategy is the choice of business models and thus to canvass well whether business models are identical with strategic goals of firms becomes significantly important. In this paper, we propose a 4-step approach based on Michael E. Porter's business trade-off approach to evaluate the consistency of the business model of a firm with its strategic goals and apply it to Taobao's business models and strategies. And we draw the conclusion that this approach can be widely applicable to evaluate business models of different companies.

articleTitle: Study of three phases process model of it value realization
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Many enterprises have invested vastly in enterprise informatization. How to realize IT value is a hotspot discussed by these enterprises. The current IT value realization process models have the weakness of lack operability. To solve this problem, this paper suggests a three phases model by using process management method to divide the IT value realization process into three phases and even more detail activities. This model can break the middle `black box' process of IT value realization, as well as implant IT value management mechanism into IT value realization process. Finally, verified this suggested model by a case study of China GuangDong Nuclear Power Group.

articleTitle: The establishment of a preventive maintenance period optimum model
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on analysis of the reliability of weapons system under the conditions of variable maintenance period, the number of maintenance and failure under the conditions of the minimum acceptable reliability, and the relationship between the preventive maintenance cost and the corrective maintenance cost, an optimization model of equipment maintenance period is established. A computational experiment shows that this model provides a rational approach to determine reasonable maintenance period and maintenance management decision-making.

articleTitle: Empirical analysis on the effects of logistics industry on economic growth in Jiangsu Province
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The logistics industry is closely related with the growth of national economy. After analyzing the relationship between the logistics industry and the economic growth in Jiangsu Province, this paper establishes a model of logistics and economic growth, with cargo turnover expressing the logistic performance and gross domestic product (GDP) representing the development level of national economy in Jiangsu Province. The stability analysis of this model indicates that the logistics industry in Jiangsu Province has made continuous contributions to economic development in this region in the past 20 years. Hence the paper concludes that such stability is significant to the development of logistics industry in Jiangsu Province.

articleTitle: The study of customer system robustness based on the negative word-of-mouth
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to study the robustness of customer system under the influences of negative word-of-mouth. In defining the combination of total customers of a business organization as customer system, the aggregate behavior of the system is simulated by the cellular automation model. It is found that the robustness of customer system is affect mainly by the closeness of information contact among the subunits and the customer satisfaction as well as it is confirmed that customer system will evaluate to the criticality state in certain condition. The practice implication on the decision of customer retention is discussed on the basis on findings.

articleTitle: Analysis of operating efficiency of Chinese Coal Mining industry
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper makes an analysis and evaluation of operating efficiency of Chinese Coal Mining Listed Companies from 2001 to 2010 by Data Envelopment Analysis. In the same time, it measures the changes of efficiency of coal mining industry by Malmqusit Productivity Index. The study demonstrates that those factors such as regional location and regional distribution have little effect on operating efficiency on this industry. The scale effect was formed, while technical efficiency is relatively low and unstable. And all efficiencies have been improved in 11 companies but MQH in these years.

articleTitle: Visual fatigue diversity research of static and dynamic lighting environment
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This study attempts to investigate the visual fatigue diversity in the static and dynamic lighting environment for the VDT work. Two experiments were conducted in the current study. Five graduate students (4 males and 1 female) were recruited as participants to perform VDT work in this two simulated lighting conditions and detected targets in front of the eye tracker after 30 min, each person 6 times repeated in different environment. The study results showed that, (1) the change of blinking frequency, eyelids open size and pupil diameter was significantly different between this two simulated lighting conditions, (2) both lighting environments also had significant effect on the diversity of the subjective visual fatigue and accommodation-vergence time. Based on these findings, the study implies that the static and dynamic lighting conditions are important for people to prevent visual fatigue effectively.

articleTitle: Body pressure distribution research and zone design of pocket spring mattresses
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With the increased demands on sleeping quality, the zoned pocket spring mattress (PSM) designed and manufactured using ergonomic principles is getting popular. This study investigated the pressure distribution of buttocks and shoulder zones of pocket spring mattresses using a body pressure distribution measure system. Test results indicated that pocket spring type and cushioning material type, and people sleeping positions had the influences on body pressure distribution. A soft PSM had a lowest peak pressure in the buttocks zone, and a medium elastic PSM had a lowest peak pressure in the shoulder zone. Based on the experimental results, an optimal design scheme for zoned pocket spring mattresses was proposed.

articleTitle: Gray relative analysis method for group decision making based on gray linguistic set
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In this paper, we take a deep look into the concepts of gray linguistic set and gray linguistic numbers. Aiming at solving multiple criteria decision making (MCDM) problems in which the criteria weights are unknown, the total deviation is firstly maximized. Then the gray relative analysis method (GRAM) is applied, and finally we obtain the relative gray correlation in order to compare the result. The example shown at last illustrates the whole idea and expresses the availability and feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: A contractor prequalification model based on triangular fuzzy number and TOPSIS
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Contractor prequalification is the process of choosing the competent contractor to bidding, during this process, the construction owner should to evaluate many aspects of contractors' abilities, such as financial standing, technical ability, experience and credibility. All these criteria both have quantitative and qualitative criteria, the qualitative criteria often difficult to be quantified, and it is a difficult task to determine one common scale of appraisal for all the criteria. So in this paper the author use the linguistics variables to evaluate the criteria that the given contractors satisfying and the importance weight of the criteria, then translate the linguistics variables into triangular fuzzy numbers, and using the TOPSIS method to calculate the fuzzy positive ideal solution and fuzzy negative ideal solution and the relative closeness to the ideal solution by every contractor, finally the most competent contractor is found.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of robotic arm manipulators control system under multitasking environment
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: To observe the performance of PC based robot manipulator under general purpose (Windows), Soft (Linux) and Hard (RT Linux) Real Time operating systems (OS). The same open loop system is observed in different operating system under multitasking environment. The Data Acquisition (DAq, PCL-812PG) card is used as a hardware interface. This experiment shows that the real time error (Jitter) is minimum in RT-Linux operating system than any other Soft Real-Time operating systems. Delay analysis of this supervisory system is calculated in RT-Linux operating system.

articleTitle: A dynamic mechanism of risk allocation of construction project from perspective of incomplete contract theory: A theoretical model
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Proper risk allocation (RA) can promote project management performance by means of contract clauses, but the existing researches were mainly on the philosophy of one-time and static RA, which hindered the project management performance improvement persistently. On the basis of literature review, the paper pointed out the characteristic of dynamic RA , and further analyzed the RA contract clauses of incomplete contract nature, and established a theory model of dynamic RA in construction project which includes initial RA and risk reallocation, which has important significance on reasonable RA in the process of contract negotiation between the project owner and the contractor.

articleTitle: Business-model dynamics: A case study of Tencent
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: A company with a proper business model appears to have advantages over one with perfect profit model. This paper develops a new framework for explaining how enterprises adopt business-model dynamics to impact their development process. In this paper, to demonstrate how the process occurred we present a longitudinal case study to find out how Tencent acted in every stage. We explore the history of Tencent and analyze his choices and consequences in the view of business-model changes. Our findings indicate that enterprises prefer avoiding major revisions in their business-models, rather than exploring a new one. This forms a major challenge for managers to make a strategic decision.

articleTitle: Armed forces knowledge management risk evaluation based on FNN
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: According to the risk theory, propose the definition of armed forces knowledge management risk. On the basis of that, the risk factors of the armed forces knowledge management were analyzed, and the armed forces risk evaluation index system was constructed. Based on the fuzzy feature of the evaluation index, fuzzy mathematics and neural networks were integrated to established the fuzzy neural network (FNN) knowledge management risk evaluation model. And through the example, it illustrates the applicability of FNN in the application of evaluation on armed forces knowledge management risk.

articleTitle: Hybrid VNS and memetic algorithm for solving the job shop scheduling problem
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The job shop scheduling problem (JSP) is focused by many researchers which is well known as one of the most complex optimization problems due to its very large search space and many constraint between jobs and machines. It is quite difficult to achieve optimal or near-optimal solutions with single traditional optimization approach. Memetic algorithm (MA) is a hybrid algorithm that combines the local search strategy and global search strategy. In this paper, an novel hybrid algorithm combined variable neighborhood search (VNS) algorithm with memetic algorithm is proposed to solve the JSP. The neighborhood functions is generated by exchanging and inserting the key operations which belong to the critical path. The minimizing makespan is considered as optimization objective. Lastly, benchmark problems is computed, and the results demonstrate the proposed hybrid algorithm is effective and efficient for solving the JSP.

articleTitle: An improvement diploid genetic algorithm for job-shop scheduling problem
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Due to the complexity of JSP, there have some improvement. This paper brings up an improvement diploid genetic algorithm. This algorithm is based on the research which comes from GA. This method uses diploid dominant and recessive operation to inherit and retain the excellent individual genes. With the operation method of using convergence and dissimulation in MEC, the direction of evolution has been improved. The operation of dissimulation construct competes in different populations and the global research. This method improves the algorithm of total convergence and ability of overall research. The improvement algorithm overcomes the prematurity and the poor results of average fitness and genetic algorithm. The results of effectiveness have been shown in simulation experiment by using this algorithm.

articleTitle: Study on risk scenarios of project failure based on Monte-Carlo simulation
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Project failure is a common outcome in complex large-scale project system because of the extensive risks. In this paper, risk scenario, which is one of the fundamental parts in risk analysis, is proved useful to estimate project failure risk. Based on the scenario theory in product system, this paper provided a methodology for identification of project risk scenario in project system. An approach based on Monte-Carlo simulation is used to generate scenarios and their frequencies. Besides, the importance measure for project risk scenarios was defined at a normalized way in the simulation environment. At last, a computational study was given to illustrate the approach, in which schedule and cost risks were taken into consideration.

articleTitle: Driver's car-following and lane-changing models: An experimental study
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Car-following and lane-changing models are important for traffic flow study. Some parameters in existing models are believed to be related to driver's characteristics, such as experience, age, personality, and culture. This paper conducted an experimental study to measure some key parameters of six typical driver groups characterized by their experience and attitude towards risks. Based on the measured parameters and revised models, a microscopic traffic simulation system, with defined types and numbers of driver agents, was developed. The simulation system and method can be used to study the effects of administrative and technical countermeasures aiming at improving traffic flow safety and efficiency performance.

articleTitle: Assembly line balancing and simulation optimization of the TM921C mobile phone assembly line of DFTX company
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Assembly lines are traditional and still attractive means of mass and large-scale series production. With the emergence of organization form of the assembly line, an important decision problem, called assembly line balancing problem, arises and has to be solved. In this paper, based on the traditional technology of industrial engineering, a method combined the simulation optimization is proposed to solve the problem. Firstly, the process analysis and the work study are used to collect the basic data of line balancing. Secondly, analysis the bottlenecks on the assembly line and apply the relevant skills of industrial engineering to optimize these workstations. Thirdly, find out and decrease the waste in the assembly line. At last, the visualization simulation of production line system is discussed in the paper, and the application of simulation-optimization line balancing method is proposed in order to evaluate the project of improvement.

articleTitle: Study on inventory decision under demand uncertainty based on evidence theory
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The inventory decision under demand uncertainty has long been a hot issue in both academic researches and management practices. Many scholars have done a lot of researches in this area. An evidence combination method based on evidence theory is introduced in this paper, in order to find a new way to solve this problem. A numerical example is also given in this paper to demonstrate the validity of this new method.

articleTitle: A novel vehicle assignment method for automated material handling system in semiconductor manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In semiconductor manufacturing, a diffusion tool is characterized by its long-processing time of 6 to 12 hours with the process flow being highly re-entrant, thus making it a form-batch operation. With the use of form-batch, wafer lots are temporarily stored in the stocker and are delivered to diffusion tools when the Work-In-Process (WIP) pool reaches 4 to 6 lots. As a result, diffusion tools wait for long wafer delivery time due to the low-efficiency AMHS vehicle assignment method, thus greatly impacting transportation and production efficiency. A novel vehicle assignment method is proposed to improve wafer lots' transport time. Unlike the existing vehicle assignment method, which sequentially assigns empty vehicle to a load port, our proposed method calls several empty vehicles to move to a load port to simultaneously execute transport jobs with the goal of shortening a vehicle's arrival time. To aid in our research, we performed simulation analysis of an AMHS for a diffusion area. The simulation outcome indicated that a substantial improvement in AMHS transport performance was achieved with implementation of the novel vehicle assignment method.

articleTitle: Reliability study of reconfigurable unit in auto-sorting system of post office
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The reliability analysis of reconfigurable unit of auto-sorting system in post office is studied base on fault tree analysis and set pair analysis. Analysis results provide the basis for optimizing self failure diagnosis auto-sorting system design; therefore, the success possibility of reliability and maintainability can be improved.

articleTitle: Developing green supply chain management strategy of hotel-centered in vegetable and fruit purchasing and recycling
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The main purpose of this study is developing green supply chain management strategies of hotel-centered in vegetable and fruit purchasing and recycling. According to our another study, Constructing the Green Supply Chain Model of the International Tourist Hotel in Casting Service, we suggest 12 strategies for hotel industry to develop hotel-centered green supply chain management in this paper.

articleTitle: The control of moral hazard in PPP project renegotiation
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The proportion of the renegotiation in PPP (public-private-partnership) projects was gradually increasing year by year, and the presentation of the adverse selection and moral hazard problems were also increasingly prominent. Moral hazard in the renegotiation not only led to the loss of social surplus, but also resulted that both sides could not get their maximum benefit in the long run. Government regulation, public supervision and incentive mechanisms were important factors which affected private enterprises to take opportunistic strategy or cooperative strategy in the renegotiation. After the renegotiation happened, through the qualitative and quantitative analysis on factors relevant of private enterprises' moral hazard, the government could make response measures related to the maximum degree of inhibition of private enterprises' moral hazard in the renegotiation.

articleTitle: Simulation research of warehousing logistics layout based on Tabu algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Warehouse Logistics Management is an important link in the business operation. Due to the lack of the systematic planning and scientific management, problems of incomplete marks, unfixed places for storage and the overlapping in the picking routes, etc. always exist. On top of analyzing the problems existing in the warehousing, the paper will further discuss about replanning or reorganizing of the layout of the warehouse logistics by rezoning goods according to their weight based on the priority principle. It shall establish cost constraint model based on Tabu algorithm and make the simulation research. The research suggests that the improved layout plan of warehouse logistics saves the total cost and drastically enhance the storage efficiency.

Author Keywords: Tabu algorithm Layout of warehousing logistics simulation

articleTitle: Analysis on key variable-oriented typical archetype of high college and university competitiveness based on system dynamics
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In the paper, takes high college and university in Jiangxi province as an example, based on the survey in the targeted high college and university and systematic analysis on the high college and university actual situation, with the help of the literature review, research methodology and analytical framework of the competitiveness, the paper established the eight influencing factors that acted on high college and university competitiveness, according to the theory of system dynamics, built level-rate units of system dynamics and eight level variable-into-tree models, and classified all the archetypes into four groups according to key influencing factors that play an important role in improving competitiveness of high college and university. At last, the paper built positive feedback archetypes that in accordance with the actual situation of high college and university, which reflect the feedback, dynamical and complicated relation between all influencing factors.

articleTitle: Evaluation of delayed product differentiation structures for coordinating product, process and supply chain design
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: There could be considerable benefits in designing supply chains structures taking into account the design of the product and the design of the manufacturing processes. The revised structures involve delaying product differentiation until later production stages. We develop models representing possible implementations of the delayed product differentiation structures and compare their performance in total supply chain costs involving the cost of expected customer waiting times. Some numerical experiments were designed to investigate how different factors affect the performance of structures. We also offer guidance to managers using reasonable structure for a balance between customization and responsiveness.

articleTitle: Enterprises competitiveness in regression analysis based on customer loyalty model
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With the increasingly fierce market competition, enterprise pay more and more attention on customer relationship management. Customer loyalty, can effectively enhance the competitiveness of enterprises. This paper describes the research model of customer loyalty, and with the findings of the insurance companies, the formation of customer loyalty, impact factor and enhance programs is discussed in detail. Adopt empirical methods, such as the questionnaire survey to collect data, factor analysis to identify variables, a regression model. Explore notable influence on customer loyalty respectively for the different drive variables. The paper not only innovated the theory of customer loyalty, but also to have innovated instruction value for business practices.

articleTitle: Management information system of activities-based quality-cost
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Quality-cost management is one of the basic functions of quality management. With the rapid development and popularization of information technology, quality-cost management extends from product layer to operational level. From the view of process quality management, architecture of activities-based quality-cost management system was proposed, framework of activities-based quality-cost management was preliminary established, accounting principle, basic steps and characters of activities-based quality-cost management were analyzed, and the implementation scheme of activities-based quality-cost management was advanced.

articleTitle: Study on transportation vehicle routing optimization model of erdos mining area
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper analyzes the logistics mode present situation of Erdos mining area, proposes the “delivery - to take coal” two-way transportation mode, designs the improved genetic algorithm for the problem, establishes the mines VRP - SDP problem mathematical model, uses MATLAB software programming and simulation run, obtains the optimal solution of the problem.

articleTitle: The research of resource distribution in product life cycle management—The potential value of waste industrial products use “again”
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: According to the current situation of lacking of resources and environmental degradation, it puts forward to making use of the interaction, recombination, revivification and energy transfer of the waste components of industrial products, which depends on analysis about the potential value of industrial waste products and relevant theory about management of product life cycle. That is all in order to deal with the potential value of industrial waste products optimally and use them “again” better.

articleTitle: Using Bayesian networks to built a diagnosis and prognosis model for breast cancer
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In recent years, the breast cancer has become one the most common cancer among women. The challenge faced currently is how to implement the early detection and accurate diagnosis for this disease. In this paper, we first introduced the definition of Bayesian network and discussed its advantages in the fields of medicine diagnosis and prognosis. Then, the original breast cancer data records used for case study are collected from the first affiliated hospital of medical college of Xi'an Jiaotong University, China, which are also discretized to build the standard modelling dataset. At last, the physical BN model, living BN model, test BN model, diagnosis BN model and prognosis BN model are learned from the dataset respectively for each treatment process of breast cancer. These BN models can help doctors to estimate the state of cancer by inputting corresponding patients' condition parameters.

articleTitle: Automobile cab packaging study based on driver simulation
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: A framework was presented, which could rapidly establish the basic packaging scheme of cab and corresponding design tools by simulating the main driving postures. The factors need to be considered in the simulation are analyzed, as well as cab packaging parameters. With reference to the joint probability distribution of multidimensional anthropometry variables, Monte Carlo simulation was used to generate sample populations for each gender respectively using the 1988 ANSUR database. Drivers' main postures were simulated currently using UMTRI's CPM model, which acquired the distributions of body characteristic points of driver populations. The theories for establishing the cab basic packaging scheme and corresponding design tools based on the distributions of body characteristic points of driver populations were studied. With the simulation using two real cars' packaging parameters, the results showed good accordance with those calculated according to SAE recommend practices.

articleTitle: Dimension extraction from three dimensional (3D) hand data without prior manual landmarking
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The development of three dimensional (3D) scan technologies makes the anthropometric measurement more efficient and accurate. These markers on human hand are used to facilitate data collection and measurement. An approach of dimension extraction from three dimensional (3D) hand data without prior manual landmarking was proposed in this paper. This is accomplished by developing soft package under the aids of Unigraphics. The first step is to translate the original scanned STL file into the point clouds format. To identify the landmarks from the data cloud point without reference is not an easy task and may involve human errors. So secondly, the program identifies landmarks with the reference of 2D hand image. Subsequently, the program segments the hand into several regions and builds the finger coordinate to bring convenience the dimension calculation. Finally, the program calculates the hand dimensions and save the results for future work. The preliminary results were shown in this paper. The efficiency and robustness of our method deserves more investigation.

articleTitle: The pricing mechanism of the building energy efficiency services based on principal-agent theory
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Through selecting principal-agent theory to analyze the building energy efficiency services, this paper points out that the current contract pricing process does not fully consider the asymmetric information, there is no rational pricing mechanism adopted to avoid the adverse selection and moral hazard. We find that the specific risk assessment can be analyzed by the dynamic risk-sharing model. The risk assessment is determined by the risk characteristics of different project and the contractors' risk aversion.

articleTitle: Balancing analysis and improvement for commercial vehicle assembly line
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This thesis focuses on the certain condition of the commercial vehicle assembly line, applies the balancing heuristic search algorithm consistent with the structural characteristics of the assembly line. On this basis, the assembly line can be balanced. And by using the Hungarian method, the appropriate personnel assignment can be done for the bottleneck workstations. By doing this,every workstation in the assembly line can be balanced,and the whole production efficiency can be improved obviously.

articleTitle: Construction project bid evaluation optimization model based on the method of ELECTRE- I
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: How to take reasonable and scientific decision-making method to select the better limited bidding schemes is a main question in the project bidding evaluation. This article introduces the ELECTRE-I method, on the basis of building indicator matrix, determine higher-level relations between different bid schemes, through accordance and disaccord examine, and seek for the non-inferior scheme subset unceasingly, finally, determine the best bid scheme. This method considered the actual situation and the value preference of construction units and overcame the supplementary situation between evaluative indicators, and it will provide a new method basis for the decision-makers.

articleTitle: Optimal control in variable-speed fan stations
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
