abstract: This paper presents a kind of optimal control method for variable-speed fan stations with the same model fans, and gives the minimum total power consumption. The optimal control method is given for the fixed total flow. The conclusion can also be applied to the energy optimization of other general devices..

articleTitle: Innovative study on material technology in jewelry exhibition design
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Taking jewelry exhibition design as the example, it discusses and analyzes the innovative application of material technology in jewelry exhibition design through the case, and expounds basic concepts and methods of jewelry exhibition design. It also analyzes and studies the material technology in jewelry exhibition design, and puts forward that the jewelry exhibition design shall not only pursue the packaging form and style, but also follow the requirements of intelligence, multi-function, environment friendly, composite, low-carbon and low cost. Moreover, the confirmation of material technology is the substance and technical conditions of product design. The exhibition design can be converted into physical product only through material and technology, while the material and technology realizes their values through design.

articleTitle: Value engineering applied at the construction planning stage
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on the life cycle of architecture this research is designed to study the construction of a super-height building. It serves as an example and discusses the effects of Value Engineering when applied in the planning stage after systematic evaluation, including the creative model, cost analysis, matrix evaluation and major factors analysis. A pre-cast external wall was used in high-level architecture to replace the complex external wall system. It turned out that the cost of external walls was reduced by 43%, which was equal to 4.1% of the total construction cost, or about NTD forty-three million Yuan. Therefore, VE when applied to the planning stage of construction was extremely effective, and the overall cost reduction showed VE to be worthy application for architecture designers and construction manager.

articleTitle: ANP-based fuzzy matter-element model for Gas Enterprise Risk Assessment
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The establishment of Gas Enterprise Risk Assessment Model is an important basis for Enterprises to implement risk management decisions. We make use of some research methods, such as systems analysis and empirical analysis for Chinese gas enterprises own characteristics and adopt a combination of ANP and fuzzy matter-element assessment method for the establishment of the urban gas enterprise risk assessment index system in the paper. Based on the risk assessment index system, combining with the gas corporate social welfare, market competition and other characteristics, we build the gas enterprise risk assessment model that took into account the complex network relationship among the various risk factors and their fuzziness, and it provides bases for the gas enterprise managers to do quantitative analysis of their own risk.

articleTitle: Research for strategic transformation of auto manufacturers based on the Low Carbon Economy
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The research is aiming to explore the low carbon road for auto manufacturing enterprise. It introduced the concept of low carbon economy, and analyzed China automobile manufacturing enterprise developing low carbon economy status using the method of SWOT. Constructed the conceptual model of strategic transformation of auto manufacturing enterprise from the perspective of low carbon economy: taking low carbon strategic as pivot, taking “people, finance and material” as longitude, taking “produce, supply and sale” as latitude, longitude and attitude are interaction. The auto manufacturing enterprise strategy transformation from the perspective of low carbon economy was divided three levels: The company strategy low carbonization transformation, the competition strategy low carbonization transformation and functional strategy low carbonization transformation. And it was divided into “produce, supply and sale” low carbonation and “people, finance and material” two dimensions. This paper analyzed the key path of strategic transformation of auto manufacturing enterprise from the perspective of production low carbonation, process low carbonization and “supply and sale” low carbonization: developing new energy vehicles, implementing systemic green manufacturing and promoting components remanufacturing.

articleTitle: Research on the triangle distribution model based on third-party logistics alliance
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper takes vehicle distribution of TPL as the object of study, discussing the solution to the arrangement of vehicle routing problem which is based on “multi-deport” vehicle distribution of the triangle network. As for the actual situation of vehicle distribution, clusters the supply and demand nodes into sliced area in order to form triangle distribution model and realize the triangle closed-loop route of vehicle distribution within pickup and delivering. By comparing relative advantages and disadvantages of the traditional distribution model and the triangle distribution model, stimulation the improvement of ant-algorithm, this paper finally analyzes the results of stimulation. The simulations results show that the triangle closed-loop model of vehicle distribution can reduce unload ratio and the cost of transportation, which means improvement of full-load ratio and achievement the optimal allocation of transport resources.

articleTitle: Study on construction supply chain cost management based on lean thinking
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Currently, cost management is playing an import role in building the overall competence of construction supply chain (CSC). In order to solve the major problems of cost management in our CSC, we propose that lean thinking be applied to CSC cost management so as to improve cost competence of our CSC by eliminating all forms of non-value added activities and wastes across the entire supply chain. This paper first analyzes the major problems of our CSC cost management. Then it introduces the idea and characteristics of lean CSC cost management. Finally, it elaborates four main aspects of implementing lean CSC cost management, including lean procurement cost management, lean design cost management, lean construction cost management and lean service cost management.

articleTitle: Six-Sigma™ implementation: Resource-Based View perspective
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This study identifies and prioritizes enabling factors based on the different objectives of Six-Sigma™ implementation. Four categories of enabling factors were identified from the lens of Resource-Based View (RBV) Theory. Interviews with twenty-three Six-Sigma™ experts were carried out to answer the proposed research questions. Analytical Hierarchy Process (AHP) is then applied to prioritize the relative importance of the enabling factors (different types of resources needed) based on three expected outcomes of Six-Sigma™ implementation project. The results show that `soft diamension' of resources is more important than the `hard dimension' when financial benefits and company image are considered as the key expected outcome. This study contributes to the existing body of knowledge by evaluating and prioritizing enabling factors reflecting by grounded theory and expected outcomes at firm level from experts' experience.

articleTitle: Analysis on the opportunities and risk which the logistics of e-business rise to the credit business of commercial bank
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: China's logistics industry is still in early development of an extensive at present, the problems that lack of socialization of logistics demand and insufficient supply of specialized logistics capacity exist simultaneously. As a comprehensive application of information technology, e-business is the revitalization of the logistics industry and important means of realizing modern logistics industry in transition. Through the analysis of logistics industry in the development of e-business trends and the discussion on modern logistics industry development opportunities and risk, this article provides recommendations for product innovation and risk control of commercial bank.

articleTitle: A holistic approach for integrated solid waste management system of Kolkata municipality corporation area
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The generation of large quantities of MSW in Kolkata has become a serious environmental issue. Urban local bodies, though committed to their services, are finding this issue difficult to manage properly due to the growing magnitude of problems. The major problems in MSW management at Kolkata are due to lack of waste segregation at source, low percentage of house-to-house collection, large number of open vats, low operational efficiency of waste transport system with old vehicles, low collection efficiency in newly added areas, and an inefficient informal recycling system. In the area of processing and disposal, many changes must be implemented including transformation of an informal to a formal recycling system; construction of a newly engineered landfill site with liner, leachate collection, and treatment facilities; enhancement of the composting system; implementation of a CH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> recovery system; and the introduction of vermi-composting in a decentralized manner. In the future, an on-line management information system needs to be effectively implemented to optimize daily operating resource allotment and make the Kolkata solid waste management system effective and sustainable.

articleTitle: Based on the theory of TRIZ in innovation design of the washing machine
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: As TRIZ conflict resolution theory as the guide, according to its application design process and technology conflict resolution methods, aimed at reverse-force cylinder washer which exists in the traditional shortcomings, and feasible design scheme of innovation. From a new Angle, and related software idealize analysis designed, so as to obtain new roller-type washing machine, a new method of design of innovation.

articleTitle: Simulation and optimization of service system for restaurant
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Service system is analyzed, optimized and evaluated by discrete event system simulation method and classical Industrial Engineering. By analyzing element of system, process, layout and related data, simulation model of some restaurant's services system is build, and by Em-plant simulation software, bottle-neck problems of services system is found. Then improved project of services system is presented by Industrial Engineering method. In the end, result of improvement is evaluated by simulation method. The research showed that services system can be effectively optimized by combining simulation method with IE method.

articleTitle: A research on customer satisfaction with household appliances industry service
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With the rapid development of China's economy, the service industry in China plays an important role in the domestic economy. Competition among enterprises is gradually transformed into the competition on quality of services. Customers are the final recipients of products or services, but also an important resource for the development of enterprises, customer satisfaction and customer loyalty are the fundamentals of enterprise development. Taking sales and service center of a household electrical appliance enterprise for example, through surveys of customer satisfaction on sales and service, modeling the path of the factors which influence sales and service quality, and using partial least squares method, the thesis analyzes the aspects and factors which influence the satisfaction of this sales and service center, identify the strategies to enhance sales and service sectors of this enterprise, thereby enhancing its competitiveness in the market.

articleTitle: Nonlinear prediction of gross industrial output time series by Gradient Boosting
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Predicting gross industrial production is helpful to design plan in development zone. History data in Jinchuan district, Hohhot, were collected. BDS, Ljung-Box, Box-Pierce, White's and Teraesvirta's neural network test and surrogate data test were combined to selecting a proper model. According to phase space reconstruction, function fitting was finished by Gradient Boosting. The results showed that nonlinear dependence existed in series. The production in 2015 was predicted to be 6937977 ten thousand Yuan.

articleTitle: Performance model of knowledge workers based on balanced scorecard
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to assess the performance of knowledge workers properly, a modified balanced scorecard model is set up which mainly comprised four perspectives: achievement, team work, communication, knowledge. It is more related to the traditional balanced scorecard. According to the characteristics of knowledge workers in different companies, especially in learning organization, the improved balanced scorecard model is more connected to the strategy activities and has deep relationship with knowledge management. As a performance measurement and strategy management system, the new balanced scorecard model will use nine steps to evaluate the performance in knowledge organization, and it can be also applied to appraise the value of knowledge workers in the learning organization.

articleTitle: Statistical process control of multistage processes with Bayesian sequential bifurcation
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Multistage process quality control has received much attention in the last two decades. In this article, we provide a statistical quality control scheme for multistage processes based on the state space model and Bayesian theory. The posterior probabilities of each possible fault scenario are evaluated. Whenever the fault scenario associated with the largest posterior probability exceeds certain threshold, the control chart will give out an alarm. Numerical analysis proves that the new method has satisfactory diagnosis power. Besides, detailed derivation of the fault propagation pattern of the Kalman-filtered residuals in presence of mean shifts is also presented.

articleTitle: Thoughts on quality management of manufacturing enterprise under low-carbon economy
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The important significance of low-carbon economy to ecological environmental protection and social, economic development has drawn more and more attention by the public. In the low-carbon economy, what role it should play and how should it be improved for quality management, is one of the major issues in manufacturing enterprise. This paper analyzed the relationships between quality management and low-carbon economy, and investigated how to improve quality management from the perspective of product lifecycle.

articleTitle: Frequency regulating effect on microwave assisted magnetization switching for two particles
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper Considers the interaction of exchange and dipole existing between two particles and that the smallest field reversal, the angle of the magnetic field added, the exchange effects strength and other physical quantities impacting on magnetization switching are Discussed.

articleTitle: Modeling for supplier evaluation and management based on TAD of three-dimensional
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: As an open complex system, the supplier evaluation system should be a multi-dimensional space system, which can not be viewed merely as a square, this paper introduces supplier evaluation and management model based on TAD of three-dimensional. TAD model is a three-dimensional frame structure, made up by time, attributes and decision points, each of which contains its own dimension and scalable level. This model builds complete, integrated provider assessment system in order to achieve management objectives accurately and effectively from the full life cycle perspective of suppliers, to support purchasing decisions.

articleTitle: Simulation platform oriented to traffic control and guidance coordination system
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Urban traffic control and guidance coordination system is an important part of Intelligent Transportation System. Aiming at testing and validating problems of traffic control and guidance coordination system in laboratory, this paper mainly discusses the design and development of simulation platform oriented to traffic control and guidance coordination system as well as the mechanism of on-line operations between virtual and real systems. The foundation is provided for the algorithm and equipments of system by establishing a virtual simulation platform, which can co-exist with real traffic control and guidance coordination system.

articleTitle: Research on the developing of the Tourism Cluster in Binhai New Area of Tianjin
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: A lot of current research on Tourism Cluster is characterized by a vital shortage in application-orientation, which make the pure theory hard to put into practice, therefore loses the vitality of those theories. This thesis firstly introduces the main theory of Tourism Cluster, then based on analyzing the status quo of Binhai New Area, explores the main structure of the Tourism Cluster in Binhai New Area. Finally, the author puts forward the development tactics of the Tourism Cluster in Binhai New Area. This research attempts to make a breakthrough from a more application-oriented perspective, in the hope that some operable ideas might be utilized in practice.

articleTitle: Differentiation and analyzed of production system accident-causing mechanism
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In this paper, four important factors-human, machines, environment and management have been analyzed anew to study the influential mechanism of production system security. A production system accident-causing model is created with management be used as the control factors. Logic operation method is adopted to simulate the model. The simulation results have showed that the model can explain system accident occurrence mechanism better. At last, some control measures are put forward to the production system on the basis of the model.

articleTitle: Optimizing and restructuring the cleaning teeth motion flow in the stomatology hospital
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The paper analyzes the cleaning teeth motion flow of dentist by observing the process of cleaning teeth for the patient in the stomatology hospital with the basic industrial engineering theory and method. It studies also dentist and nurse's collaborating operation of cleaning teeth. It establishes a new cleaning teeth motion flow by optimizing and restructuring. The research indicates that comparing new cleaning teeth motion flow to the old one before improvement. The dentist's operation time is saved 25 seconds. The movement time is saved 8 seconds. The waiting time is reduced 276 seconds. The dentist and nurse's total operation time are reduced 309 seconds.

articleTitle: Evaluation method research of human safety behavior based on rough set theory
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The field test of comprehensive psychological measuration scale for safety behavior to 237 miners of different work types was carried out, so knowledge system about miner safety behavior indexes were constituted. By the rough set theory, the core attributes were worked out through the attribute reduction to the index knowledge system and the significance degree value of every condition attribute element was known by calculation. Finally, the index evaluation method of human safety behavior situation was designed. Actual measurement showed that this method can be used to make survey with accurate evaluation result easily.

articleTitle: A research into the attitudes of college students towards a career in the Pulp and Paper Industry in Metro Vancouver, Canada
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: It is important but difficult for the Pulp and Paper Industry (PPI) to attract college students in Canada including Metro Vancouver. This paper aims to find out the reasons for this difficulty, identify solutions and make recommendations to enhance the attractiveness of PPI to students, using Crosstabulation Analysis in SPSS software and other analytical methods. This paper introduces industry background, the survey and research. Four Conclusions were arrived at. First, the supply of college graduates to the PPI won't increase. Second, some factors significantly influence students' career choice. Third, students' attitude toward the PPI is more positive. Fourth, many students lack knowledge about PPI. The paper concludes with some recommendations for enterprises in PPI, including to whom it should deliver and ways to deliver industry information, important factors and actions to attract college students.

articleTitle: Labor productivity influencing factors analysis and its improving countermeasures study in automobile manufacturing enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Taking FAW Car for example, the connotation of labor productivity and its evaluation methods in automobile manufacturing enterprises are studied in this paper. Dualistic contrast compositor is used to identify the main influencing factors of labor productivity and IE is used to study the improving countermeasures. This research is of great significance for enterprises to improve their operation efficiency and keep sustainable development.

articleTitle: Cost control of Digitalized Factories
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: By analyzing the features of Digitalized Factries(DF) and the main distinction between the DF and traditional manufacturing, the paper analyzed aspects of DF, which including the low cost running in cost design, cost control of production and management, networked marketing, digital supply chain and cost management of information systems. And the paper discussed more scientific measure to continually reduce the operational cost of DF.

articleTitle: Practice teaching system research for Industrial Engineering
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Industrial Engineering is a highly practical major, and only through practice teaching can really cultivate professional talents for enterprise business. Combined with the characteristics of industrial engineering major, this paper constructs practice teaching system based on teaching practice and theory courses, and analyses the practical teaching process and the system of curriculum in order to promote and optimize the practice teaching of industrial engineering major.

articleTitle: The organization of regional industry ecosystem: Structure and evolution
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Using integrated evolution theory and complex system theory, the paper tries to understand the structure and evolution with in China regional industry ecosystems. With a case study of Tianjin, which has two important Areas —Tianjin Ziya Venous Industry Area and Binhai New Artery Industry Area, the paper regards it as a regional industry ecosystem and divided its development and system evolution as five stages, and then explains the casual factors leading to change in it. The paper focuses much on the venous industry and artery industry coupling which facilitated adaption to changing environment.

articleTitle: The demand forecasting of the multi-echelon inventory in the regional logistics network
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The article studies inventory demand forecast in regional logistics network of retailers, distribution center, and suppliers. It considers the demand difference between distribution center, suppliers and retailers from the perspective of supply chain, and according to different level of demand, determines the relationship between the shortest circuit matrix and demand mapping in regional logistics network, based on which a multi-echelon demand forecasting model is built and the accurate inventory demand of every level is obtained. At last, we prove the correctness and feasibility of the model through a case.

articleTitle: Research on the interaction between foreign direct investment and localized industrial cluster
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to study the interaction of foreign direct investment and the localized industrial cluster in China, and to strengthen the technology innovation capability, based on relative references, qualitative analysis is employed to analyze the interaction mechanism of foreign direct investment (FDI) and the localized industrial cluster. With relevant econometric model-building methods, a model of interaction situation between foreign direct investment and the localized industrial cluster is established; some relative data from high tech industrial clusters is adopted; utilizing the methods of stability test, co-integration test and least square technique, empirical analysis is employed to analyze the interaction system of foreign direct investment (FDI) and the localized industrial cluster. At last, some empirical conclusions are reached.

articleTitle: EG model of Haitai: A new method of promoting the development of national e-government
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on the actual situations of e-government in China, this paper focused on the bottlenecks in the process of e-government construction and improvement. To explore a low-cost and high-yield e-government model, Haitai digital EG Model was initially proposed in this paper on the basis of “digital campus” e-government, which was suitable for China's situations. This paper contributed at implementing e-government in China and providing reference to e-government's construction and development in the new period.

articleTitle: A study of system equipment accelerate degradation reliability
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: System equipment level products are consists of many components, including many failure mechanisms and degradation patterns. It is hard to carry out experiments on them. Previous research are based on the competition failure between sudden failure and degradation failure, in order to do further research, this paper proposed the degradation competition failure problem. First, do some theory research of the multi-degradation channels independent and related, then make quantitative analysis on reliability and reliability life based on competition failure of multi- degradation patterns. For accelerated degradation, put forward some solutions and ideas. Using the accelerate model to estimate the variance-covariance and some parameters, then analysis the reliability of the hole equipment. At last, using some examples to prove the effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: On-line of modeling ship manoeuvring motion by using least squares support vector machines
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: System identification combined with free-running model tests or full-scale trials is a kind of effective methods to determine the hydrodynamic derivatives in the mathematical models of ship manoeuvring motion. On-line support vector machines is proposed to identify ship manoeuvring motion model and ship motion first-order response model based on free-running model tests and full-scale trials, respectively. Established real-time online ship manoeuvring motion model can more accurately depict ship attitudes in time and have better robustness. The simulation results demonstrate the validity of the proposed identification algorithm.

articleTitle: Study on service management innovation of service outsourcing enterprise based on knowledge value chain
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With the rapid development of new economy era, knowledge management and service management innovation is the competitive advantage of soft power. Based on the knowledge value chain theory and the characteristics of the service outsourcing enterprises, the paper builds service management innovation model based on knowledge value chain, and analyze how to use knowledge management theory to guide service outsourcing enterprises practice, as well as make a detailed classification concerning the innovation capability of service outsourcing enterprise.

articleTitle: The effect of government satisfaction on collective action intention—Panel data analysis(2007–2010)
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This article examined the effect of government satisfaction on collective action intention under Chinese background by panel data analysis (2007-2010). Results demonstrate that among the variables work-life satisfaction, economic situation of country/region, economic development anticipation, social justice have negatively significant effect on collective action intention (p<;.05). The social stress and income level do not (p>;.05). The government satisfaction has moderate effect between the antecedents and collective action. The fit index of the model is good.

articleTitle: A discussion on the necessity of the differences between Chinese ASBE (2006) and the IFRS — Based on the Hofstede's culture theory and Gray's accounting values
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: China issued a new set of Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (ASBE) in 2006 and this ASBE are substantially in line with IFRS. Based on the cross-cultural work of Hofstede, we figure out different results of cultural values between China and world average and these cultural factors make accounting follow different patterns in different parts of the world, so a few important differences between the ASBE and the IFRS are suitable for China. We can't fully adopt the IFRS.

articleTitle: FCE on the risk of operating environment assessment and improvement in the destruction of special dangerous goods
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Through discussing and analyzing the risk factors in operating environmental of the special dangerous goods destruction (OEDSDG), the paper identified the possible causes which led the accident. At the same time, consulted LEC evaluation ideas, combined with features of various factors, it proposed to use fuzzy comprehensive evaluation (FCE) on OEDSDG, and then found effective control measures to improve the operation safety. Finally, the paper took the OEDSDG of G class toxic substances as analysis case to verify the method reasonable.

articleTitle: On dynamic extension of design symbols in interior design
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With the development of science and technology, the static design symbols of interior design have been difficult in expressing the concept of information intelligent integration in contemporary design. In order to make the conveying of diversified information more efficient, design semiotics should look for new ways in the field of interior design, derive new dynamic static symbols from original simplex static symbols.

articleTitle: Research on decision to delivery model of SG Iron & Steel enterprise
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The logistics business outsourcing is increasingly developed to be the trend of enterprise logistics management in the 21st century. Although there is a large scale of logistics outsourcing, more companies feel low-satisfaction about logistics providers. Taking a steel production company as the research object, with quantitative analysis methods, which will help to design the effective logistics business outsourcing operation system and build up the relative model according to the specific operation of the actual situation of the enterprises. Through certain of example models analysis, which will also clarify the necessity and feasibility of logistics business outsourcing which shows the theoretical and practical significance for the companies during the period of transferring from self-steering to logistics outsourcing.

articleTitle: A research on increasing revenue and reducing expenditure of land resources under the perspective of system approach
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The present paper aims to provide system design and policy recommendations on increasing revenue and reducing expenditure of land resources by means of productivity conversion system, institution system as well as operation system. The land is a significant resource in economic activities, yet the supply of land is far from measuring up to its limitless demand due to its rigidity feature, hence the rational utilization of land resources can alleviate the contradiction between them. This paper carries out a research on increasing revenue and reducing expenditure of land resources from the perspective of system theory, from which claims that innovation can be obtained from productivity system and institution system.

articleTitle: A mathematical programming approach for bi-levels tree hub location network
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: We design an optimal tree hub location network containing bi-levels, hub nodes and non hub nodes. Often, the cost of connection link between two places is very high. Due to take over problem, some nodes play role of hub. Hub nodes act switching, transshipment, and distribution of people or commodity. A route between all nodes should be existed in the network. So, transportation network must be graph with minimum number of arcs while spans all nodes. There is no cycle in this network. Here, we propose a mathematical programming model for a network considering optimal location of hub facilities where all connection links in the network are in the form of tree. Our aim is cost minimization using minimum spanning tree (MST) method in the whole network.

articleTitle: The research on constructing Tianjin Highway Information Management Platform
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: 21 century information industry will become the world's leading industry. Highway Information Management Platform is an integral part of the information age. By analyzing the information management center in Tianjin highway information management status and problems, the paper proposes to construct a platform for information management using information technology to improve management and road capacity, so that road users feel safe, comfortable and efficient and achieve people, Vehicles, roads harmonious development.

articleTitle: Availability for repairable redundancy system with the restriction of spare parts
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The availability for repairable redundancy system with the restriction of spare parts is researched. In order to solve this problem, first, the elementary theory of availability is expatiated. Then the calculation model is constructed, which has consider the unit' connection style and the restriction of spare parts. Basing on the analyzing mentioned above, the method of how to calculate the availability is given. Experiments show that the model works well and this result establishes good base for further research in relative problems.

articleTitle: Comprehensive evaluation for quick response designing and manufacturing system
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to evaluate a Quick Response Designing and Manufacturing System(QRDMS) roundly and objectively, a hierarchical and comprehensive evaluation index system for QRDMS is constructed, a multi-level fuzzy comprehensive evaluation approach based on analytic hierarchy process (AHP) is proposed in this paper. Then, an example is used to illustrate the proposed approach, and results indicate that the proposed approach is able to evaluation performances of QRDMS effectively and reasonably.

articleTitle: Research on the application of knowledge management process model in commercial banks
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on the reality of commercial banks' knowledge management in China, this paper defines the knowledge capital of Chinese commercial banks, analyzes its unique characteristics, and establishes the knowledge management process model for commercial banks as percipience, initiatives, implementation and improvement stages. The internal mechanism of this model indicates that knowledge management is consisted of access, sharing, analysis, application, evaluation, motivation, innovation and protection of knowledge.

articleTitle: Analysis of the management and evaluation of city house type design
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Housing is a fundamental issue for national lives. House types are the basic unit of urban residence and the design of the house affects the quality of life. However, the previous research tends to identify performance only on the basis of design experience. The management and evaluation of house type design should deep on the basic need of resident's living which was composed by various activities. So, a systematic study of living behavior and its relationship between house types need be discussed for the house type design. According to spatial combination theory, the paper simplifies the house type design flow into the selection and combination of various behavior units, and takes it as the basis for the management and evaluation. Finally, based on the analysis of design flow of city house type and applied the value engineering theory, the paper put forward a evaluation method to estimate the house type design.

articleTitle: Fuzzy real option analysis for highway project based on credibility theory
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Because of the uncertainty in the construction project investment, real option analysis (ROA) is favored by people than the traditional discounted cash flow method (DCF). Due to its huge amount of investment, long construction period, Irreversible investment, highway project has much more uncertainty. Taking into account the actual situation, such as the total investment, completion time, operating costs and other variables in the decision-making is not a fixed value, this paper characterizes the project's cash flow and investment costs as fuzzy variables. A fuzzy real option value analysis model for highway projects is formulated for this problem.

articleTitle: The “hold up” effect of terminals on TD development
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper firstly analyzed serious of problems in the development of TD-SCDMA. Secondly, through the questionnaire, the China Mobile TD-SCDMA' (the most influential telecom operators) and the 3G iPhone' impact on the development of 3G are analyzed, finding mobile terminals have a “Hold-up” effect on TD development. At last, the paper gets a conclusion that the market rather than the technology is the key factor in the 3G, and even in 4G era.

IEEE Keywords: Time division synchronous code division multiple access

articleTitle: Highlight of risk on automation system failure and human capabilities
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper intends to highlight the function allocation (FA) issues that relate to the human capabilities needed in a situation that FA was not properly handled for new technology. In many FA papers, automation was discussed and is considered a major concern for FA. The problems will be discussed with the introduction of the FA gap concept and further studies are suggested.

articleTitle: Safe and efficient communication study based on hydrological data measurement of Laxiwa Hydropower station
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper discusses the hydrological data measurement on LaXiWa Hydropower station,which is also related to the research programs based on communication security issues and high performance. Firstly, it provides us with the framework of information integration, and then discusses from three aspects, namely, sensor selection and security coding scheme, the industrial Ethernet security configuration policies and MFC routing network design, about data reliable and secure transmission, as well as the sensing unit which provides reliability design of the dual redundant backup solutions and software strategy for enhancing the system safety and reliability.

articleTitle: Efficiency evaluation of commercial bank based on DEA
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Scientific efficiency evaluation of banks' input and output is of great practical significance, for reasonable structure and layout of the banking sectors, the effective use of human resources and fund efficiency improvement. In this paper, human resource, capital and technology efficiency and scale efficiency evaluation on Tianjin Branch of Minsheng Bank of the branch's were computed based on DEA method and evaluate its effectiveness. The level of branch efficiency was reflected by comparing with each other. It is of important guiding significance to improve banks' human resource and financial management.

articleTitle: The impact of supply chain control on supply chain relational risk An empirical investigation from manufacturing firms in China
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper studies the correlation among supply chain control, trust and supply chain relational risk, using factor analysis and regression analysis. The study was conducted by investigating 115 manufacturing firms in China. The findings support the hypothesis that supply chain control can effectively prevent supply chain relationship risk, where trust plays an important mediating role.

articleTitle: The research base on the application of supply chain management in plant procurement management
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Scientific management of plant is an important factor in the success of manufacturing enterprises, and improving the level of plant management will help enterprises achieve their business goal. Merge the ideas of supply chain management and epurate the module plant management, and construct plant management in the supply chain operations reference model is proposed based on the equipment “push-pull combination” mode of procurement, Then in-depth analysis of procurement management and plant management business between the data flow, effectively improve the function of equipment management structure. Constitute the client/server and browser/server architecture mixed mode, which in the original construction plant management based on the data plant management platform for plant management in the process of data synchronization and information sharing. Its purpose is to apply advanced management ideas to change the traditional procurement of equipment management of information technology to improve the level of plant is significant.

articleTitle: A study on organizational management optimization for new car product developing projects
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Our country's industry has been developed so rapidly that auto production and sales capacity increased year by year. Meanwhile, small-displacement car has come to a high developing stage in the market, and the requirement be putting forward higher on organizational management of new product developing projects. The paper analysis organizational management status and problems on new car product developing projects, and then build project platform organization structural in order to organizational project management. At last, analysis of the organizational platform model for new car product developing project about its operation, responsibilities and Advantages. Optimizing the project management organizational structure provides strong warranty for the rapid replacement of new car products and for the sustainable development of the car companies.

articleTitle: FRACAS design for railway freight cars
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Vehicles' reliability, availability, maintainability and safety (RAMS) have become increasingly prominent in contradiction with life cycle cost on account of both speed and load rising in railway transportation. Meanwhile, the Failure Report Analysis and Corrective Action System (FRACAS) is the foundation of RAMS. FRACAS organization and its responsibility system are proposed and established by the analysis of freight failure information management status. Taken Relex FRACAS as the software platform, contents, requirements and formats based on collection and transmission of failure information are customized by product structure tree and failure criterion. On the basic principle of “the information feedback, the closed-loop control”, failure closed-loop management is realized by defining FRACAS workflow throughout products testing and their operations. The application rules of failure information are proposed, which can be realized that failure statistics analysis, trend analysis, reliability and maintainability predication. Finally, a uniform database and knowledge base can be used to supply information support for railway freight car RAMS design and analysis as well as maintenance support strategies made.

articleTitle: Efficiency management within an industrial environment
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Power conservation has become a high priority to Industry due to recent environmental assessment and electricity prices. This research aims to demonstrate to Industry the many simple and cost effective ways to increase their industrial efficiency with simple modifications, as well as making them more aware of common installation errors that significantly increase power consumption. This has been accomplished with the design and construction of a test rig capable of producing the desired test results which simulate Industrial usage. This paper contains the results obtained from testing a variety of couplings and belts under different running conditions. A comparison of the efficiency of the different belts, at different tensions, showed very distinct advantages and disadvantages of each belt. The coupling testing was conducted under conditions of misalignment, and resulted in distinct differences in the efficiencies of each coupling at the different degrees of misalignments. All results obtained are analyzed and discussed in the relevant sections.

articleTitle: Industry technology road-mapping research based on complex system modeling
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In the 1970s, as an effective and powerful management tool, technology road-mapping was first developed and used to support integrated product technology planning at firm, sector, and national level. Despite the widespread use of road-mapping as a management technique, research in this area is relatively sparse. This paper proposes an idea that industry technology road-mapping is an open complex giant system modeling, a system emergence outcome, a system emergence model based on TRM core competitive is built, and explaining further that industry core competitive comes from a system emergence that key elements are interrelated, interdependent and interacted.

articleTitle: Analysis on risk status of local government financing platform based on GA-PSO mixed planning algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With the government's increasing marketing regulation for real estate and tightening monetary policy, the risk of local government financing platform is increasingly prominent. This paper makes a quantitative analysis for the risk of local government financing platform based on GA-PSO mixed planning algorithm, on the condition that the risk has been qualitatively proved in the educational circles. In this paper, firstly status and cause of risk for the platform, and then GA-PSO mixed planning algorithm is introduced for quantitatively analyses of current situation of the local government financing platform over the country. At last, by analyzing the results, the conclusion is made that the risk of local government financing platform is quite high and measures should be taken immediately for prevention and governance1.

articleTitle: An analysis of the function of industrial engineering in equipment manufacturing industry based on DEA
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Industrial engineering is a subject dealing with the optimization of processes or systems. The equipment manufacturing industry is the core of manufacturing. Its development influences the comprehensive competitiveness of a country. This article analyzes the current status of equipment manufacturing industry of China and points out its problems. At the same time, the article combines the practical situation of the enterprise that the author works in, discussing how to apply industrial engineering to optimize the layout of plant, the arrangement of equipment, the productivity and the economy of man-hour. The application of industrial engineering in the enterprise makes delightful progress.

articleTitle: Reducing the Computation of the linear complexity of upv -periodic sequences
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: We present a fast algorithm that reduced the computation of the linear complexity of the up<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">v</sup> -periodic <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup> sequence under gcd (u, p) = 1 to the computation of maximum of some linear complexities of p<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">v</sup> -periodic sequences over F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</sub>. After combining with the Berlekamp-Massy algorithm or generalized Games-Chan algorithm, we could efficiently compute the linear complexity of p<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">v</sup> -periodic sequence. Thus we present an efficient and attractive algorithm for calculating the linear complexity of up<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">v</sup> -periodic sequences.

articleTitle: Research on the material flow stability of by-products in the industrial symbiosis network —Based on the construct and analysis of the mode by the management agency's modulation
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on the situation of the industrial symbiosis network (ISN), for the improper flow of information, the paper uses the coordination function of administrative organization as a tool, and analyzes the influence on the stability of by-products material flow by administrative organization. From the statistical aspect, through building modeling of material stability of by-products, and analysis of theoretical mode and its parameter influence, we then further find the by-products administrative organization is capable of coordinating the by-products material flow within the network between the enterprises, removing the variance of by-products material flow, and then promoting the stability of the by-products material flow between the ISN node enterprises.

articleTitle: Revelations from the project management of developed market economy government investment
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Government investment is an important way of national macro-control and economic intervention. Between government investment and economic growth exists the relation of mutual promotion and mutual constraint. In view of the organization and implementation of project management of several developed market economy government investments, the main model of government investment has some common characteristics, including relative centralization, profession, prevention and supervision. The first model of China's “Agent System” is closer to the management model of developed countries. This paper tries to analyze the shortcomings of existing models in China, put forward some revelations of the experience of developed countries to the government project management reform in China and development prospects.

articleTitle: The application of MOD method in assembly Balancing
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on the principle of Ergonomics, the flow process and rhythm on assembly line in any company are measured and analyzed carefully by MOD method and problems of the work distribution, operation ways, working hour in the assembly are point out. According to the action economy principle, the paper presents an improvement to the above-mentioned, which play an important part in reducing the job time and enhancing the whole assembly line balance. Through the contrast and analysis between old and new projects, it proves that the improvement in effect is very obvious.

articleTitle: The legal research on intellectual property rights in global supply chain integration
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The competitive advantage of global supply chain integration management mode was derived from patents, technical secrets and other intellectual property acquisition; however, there were some intellectual property problems in the big external environment and small internal supply chain environment, by which the cooperation risks between enterprises were increased. Criteria standardization, monopoly of intellectual property, openness of technical standards and improvement of patent licensing system were researched in this thesis. The corresponding measures and advices were proposed to cope with the Intellectual property ownership, definition and protection problems between supply chain members in the process of global integration.

articleTitle: Planning and optimization of assembly line simulation
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The assembly line in manufacturing, especially in the manufacture of electronic products occupies an important position. Considering complex optimization problems in assembly-line planning, establishing a mathematic model about assembly-line balancing planning, applying genetic algorithms which is based on feasible operation sequence could help to acquire static optical solution of operating balance planning. While building dynamic simulation of the production-line to authenticate and evaluate the Dynamic performance of production line running. The results fed into the planning process to fix the static planning, consequently improve and optimize the overall design of assembly planning.

articleTitle: The studies on coordinated behaviors of small and medium sized enterprises in the environment of supply chain
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Systemically examine and study the dependant perception difference between enterprises in the supply chain environment and the influence for the coordinated behaviors of small and medium sized enterprises by such perception difference. Also the article conducts the demonstrated analysis and testing with the use of the pair data of coordinated enterprises of supply chain of the relevant industry supply chain in Xi'an district manufacturing.

articleTitle: Capital & labor input and the improvement of the capacity of the independent innovation in automobile industry
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper intends to construct a comprehensive evaluation system from the perspectives of innovation input, innovation development, innovation output, and innovation management. It arrives at a conclusion that capital & labor input are the most important factors in this evaluation system by AHP. The correlation of the capital & labor input and innovation output is proved by the method of grey relational analysis with the conclusion that the capital & labor input are the breakthrough of the innovation development.

articleTitle: Study on performance evaluation of effects on integration management of engineering projects in China
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on combination of related foreign theories and engineering practices in China, an index system of project performance evaluation has been explored and constructed. Furthermore, we applied the index system of performance evaluation to the cases according to their actual situations. The effectiveness of the index system of engineering projects was confirmed, and effect of integration management of engineering project was proved in practice.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis and improvement for Li / MnO2 cell production line based on Fault Tree Analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This article describes how to apply the FTA on the reliability analysis and improvement of Li / MnO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> cell production line. According to working principle of Li/MnO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> cell automatic production lines, it makes quantitative analysis for the reliability of production lines with FTA, then obtained the rate of system failure and the module of the largest failure rate. And then propose the corresponding measures to improve the design and improve its reliability. Therefore the reliability analysis for Li / MnO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> battery production line base on FTA has important research value and application prospect.

articleTitle: Inspiration discovery based on related domains
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: For academic scientists, it is not satisfy to meet their researches requirements only finding out the basic scientific research activities recent years. The future of research in this field, evolution of the hot spot and the research front of relevant fields has the same Ref. value for current field researching. To solve these problems, we use inspiration discovery method by mining and clustering analysis the hidden information of related literatures from the particular research areas' classic journals and high-ranking conferences with a designed visual interface. The experiment results show the proposed method, on average, improved the detection precision to 92.86% and reduced false alarm rate of discussed candidate outliers to 0.0074%. Findings showed the proposed method could provide with valid depictions of future research cross different domains.

articleTitle: Price discrimination game of duopoly telecommunication operators based on system dynamics
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The main factors and their interrelationship that influence the Telecom operation are analyzed firstly, and then the cause-and-effect diagram and the competitive model of duopoly telecom operators are established based on system dynamics. The number of users and turnovers within price discrimination strategy and non-price discrimination strategy are simulated. Conclusions indicated that for a single telecom operator, the number of users will decrease but the turnover will increase under the price discrimination strategy. For duopoly telecom operators, their turnovers will be lower under the price discrimination strategy compared with that under the non-discrimination strategy. The turnover of the operator which adopts the price discrimination strategy will be higher on condition that the opponent adopts non-discrimination strategy. Because of their egoism, the duopoly telecom operators always take the price discrimination strategy, which can lead to the waste of telecom resources and bring about “prisoner dilemma”.

articleTitle: An empirical study on the influencing factors of migrant workers' income from human capital & social capital—From 548 rural migrant workers' investigation samples in Jiangxi province
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Migrant workers' wages are directly related to their life quality and happiness index in the city, which is an important factor to promote the social systems engineering of the peasant workers' citizenization. The influencing factors of migrant workers' income include Macroscopic factors and Microscopic factors. Macroscopic Factors, such as national economic development level, the industrialization process, labor market's structure and the scale, non-agricultural Labout market wages, and agricultural market and policy environment, etc. Microscopic factors, which reflects personal factors of the Migrant workers, such as level of education, training skills, ages and working experience, and so on. With the Multivariate Linear Regression Model and Multinomial Logistic Model, the Microscopic factors of migrant workers' income are analyzed in this paper based on empirical research through 548 migrant workers survey data in JIangxi province, and some corresponding conclusion are obtained and effective countermeasures are put forward.

articleTitle: Eco-efficiency evaluation of an eco-economic system—Case study of Tianjin ZIYA circular-industrial park
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The development of circular-industrial parks is the effective way to achieve sustainable development, which is the direction of modern industry. Nowadays, how to evaluate the performance of circular-industrial parks quantitatively and scientifically becomes one of the research focuses. Eco-efficiency is the effective index which can be used to evaluate circular economy. It is a bridge and a quantitative description of the interaction between environment and economy. Based on the method of eco-efficiency, a set of eco-efficiency indicators of circular-industrial parks are set up in this paper, and then the eco-efficiency indicators of Tianjin Ziya circular-industrial park are measured and evaluated as a case study, so as to assess the comprehensive performance of the circular-industrial park by quantitative analysis, and provide some information for decision-making.

articleTitle: A research on the optional mode and strategy of developing Supply Chain financing in Tianjin Binhai New Area
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Tianjin Binhai New Area plays a strategic role in the development of the whole city, and lots of SMEs serve as accessory manufacturers, downstream dealers and “middlemen” for large groups. Numerous studies analyze how Supply Chain Financing helps SMEs get financing support in this area, however, there are seldom researches taking how to combine various financing products with the booming logistics industry into account. This paper analyzes the characteristics in this area and the background of developing Supply Chain Financing, and it propounds a Unified Credit Supply Chain Financing Mode, and then gives some recommendations to relative participations.

articleTitle: Research on the performance evaluation system of private enterprise based on AHP and PCA
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The paper is from the basic principle of the social expectations which an enterprise is obliged and guides the private enterprises to develop in the direction of state and society warfare. It has built the performance evaluation index system objectively after analyzing the desired goal of contemporary social and cultural environment. In addition, it also obtained the first-hand data of the evaluation system through the social survey, then we apply the AHP on the 56 reviewers to achieve the index weights set of enterprise performance evaluation. We analyzed the data obtained from Principal component analysis to determine the weight index. Where after, the objective correction of weights index is conducted in the AHP-based evaluation system. The above has not only formed the enterprise performance evaluation system based on the subjective and objective Evaluation but from the other side verified the rationality of evaluation index system.

articleTitle: Study on production management mode based on the JIT Delivery-oriented in Automobile Parts enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: According to the concept and characteristics of JIT Delivery-oriented, combined with the thinking of supply chain and value chain management, the primary and secondary activities which impact JIT Delivery-oriented in Automobile Parts enterprises are analyzed in this paper. And production management mode based on the JIT Delivery-oriented in Automobile Parts enterprises is constructed. The mode was implemented in an automobile parts enterprise, and achieved good results.

articleTitle: Study on decision mechanism choosing by cost model for functional organization
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on the analysis of the character of functional organization, a model for calculating the cost of functional organization is designed in this article with the parameters of the organization information and the relationship among departments. The cost of functional organization is analyzed under different decision mechanism on the base of which some tactic is advanced for functional organization to choose decision mechanism.

articleTitle: The production and inventory planning based on seasonal variable delivery time
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The effect of the seasonal variable delivery time (SVDT) on the production and inventory planning is studied in this paper. We investigate two situations of SVDT subjecting to linear function and non-linear function and conclude that the fluctuating of the delivery time can influence the production system severely. Dynamic programming method is adopted to solve the problems and numerical example is presented.

articleTitle: Research on the impact of frequency on switching speed of the magnetic moment for a isolating particle
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The minimum switching field threshold and switching speed are important parameters for the magnetic recording in writing. This paper presents the dynamic behavior of an isolating magnetic moment. The impact of the magnetic field of microwave applying order on the switching process of an isolate particle is investigated.

articleTitle: Research on the Chinese Eco-City construction from the angle of industrial agglomeration
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The construction and development of Chinese Eco-City are closely related to the support of industrial development. Generally, it is considered that the highly industrial agglomeration helps to coordinate the relations between urban economy and urban environmental development. In order to verify this view, an index CR<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup> measuring the manufacturing industrial agglomeration was brought forward in this paper. The comprehensive CR<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup> index and the comprehensive index measuring the Eco-City construction level were established by using principal component analysis (PCA) method. Then the relations between manufacturing industrial agglomeration and Eco-City construction were illustrated with the quantitative method. The positive effect of manufacturing industrial agglomeration on the Eco-City construction was clarified, which further perfected the Eco-City construction theory and tried to propose a new perspective for the study of Eco-City system construction. Finally, the execution of sustainable development strategy for Chinese Eco-City was promoted by pushing forward the rational industrial agglomeration in provincial areas.

articleTitle: Some problems of the balance model of economy
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: We discuss some problems of the balance model of economy such that the testing of productivity, product and pricing control, acceleration of computations.

articleTitle: An empirical study on the effect of electric power industry regulation reform
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: To accomplish the goal of “11th five-year plan”: cutting energy consumption per unit of GDP by 20%, our country implements the “energy saving” plan actively. But in 2008, there were 24 provinces forced to wind up electricity using because the total power amount fell behind the economic development. Under the current background, this article adopts China's power industry data from 1990 to 2008, and uses ADF and Engle-Granger measurement methods to analyze the effect of regulation. After the study we found: China's electric power industry regulation significantly increases total power amount of the electric power industry in the statistical meaning, and reduces the electricity price level. Overall, the effect of the electric power industry regulation is obvious, but there are still some problems existing, for example, the price of electricity does not match with people's living standards, the total power amount can not keep up with economic development and so on. Therefore, this paper provides some policy recommendations to the further power industry reform in China.

articleTitle: Microcosmic lay of Industrial Cluster Innovation: The research of inter-organizational knowledge innovation network
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on Knowledge Innovation and Biological Evolution theory, drive and shape five processes:motivation, invention, implementation, theorization and internalizaiton. address the evolutionary model of inter-organizational knowledge innovation and give the entry points of inter-organizational knowledge innovation network. Classify the network: Toyota Network and Silicon Valley Network. Analyse the two networks for China development.

articleTitle: Application of the Data Envelopment Analysis in analysis of cost and profit
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: DEA (Data Envelopment Analysis) is an effective system analysis method in recent years. By comparing other comprehensive evaluation methods, DEA approach to solving multi-inputs, multi-outputs problems, have an absolute advantage. This paper improves the original model, and constructs cost efficiency DEA model combining with the general assessment of cost effective method. By solving it, we can actually find cost effective evaluation index, so that the application of DEA model further promotes. And through the application of a case, this paper illustrates the method with high maneuverability and a certain degree of rationality. Therefore, the proposed method for optimizing decision-making unit, reducing resource input and improving output levels has the economic significance and reference value.

articleTitle: Planning and implementation of self-reconfigurable robots' collaboration function
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Self-reconfigurable robots is a micro-robot team with self-reconfiguration capabilities, strong flexibility and concealment and so on, it has broad application prospects in military reconnaissance, disaster relief, space operations and other occasions. in recent years, it becaming one of hotspots in the field of robotics research. But a single robot has poor perception capacity of environmental information and impaired, so that the application of micro-robot has been greatly restriced. By planning and implementation collaborative function of self-reconfigurable robots, such as collaborative decision-making, collaborativeorientation, collaborative terrain reconnaissance, remodeling and more impaired functions, we can effectively enhance self-reconfigurable robots ability to adapt to dynamic environment, improve the overall performance of self-reconfigurable robots, and expand the robot's applications.

articleTitle: Research on the application and optimization countermeasures of auto parts Milk-run logistics mode
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Taking an independent auto manufacturing enterprise as an example, this paper studies the connotation, application methods, procedures and outer logistics optimization effect of milk-run, and establishes an auto parts milk-run direct sending system planning model to realize minimum transportation expenses under the condition of maximum vehicle load rate. The main influencing factors in implementing milk-run and logistics optimization countermeasures by using IE are also studied. This research is of great significance to the survival and sustainable development of an enterprise.

Author Keywords: planning model of direct sending system

articleTitle: Landmark automatic identification from three dimensional (3D) data by using Hidden Markov Model (HMM)
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
