abstract: 3D anthropometric data can be obtained more easily than several years ago, but to process 3D data is challenging and landmark identification is one of the most challenges. Traditional methods need to manually paste markers on landmarks of the subjects. It is time-consuming and greatly impacts the efficiency of future data analysis. Numerous methods for landmark identification have been proposed, but none with high efficiency, good robustness and strong adaptability has been found yet. In this paper, an approach combined spin image with Hidden Markov Model (HMM) together to automatically identify and locate facial landmarks from 3D face data was proposed. Two hundred 3D head data of young male Chinese were analyzed. Under Unigraphics software, data noise and redundancy were removed and 3D head models were generated. Spin image was adopted to describe the 3D facial landmark local features. With visual check, we defined our facial landmarks and calculated spin images of the facial landmarks. Subsequently, we created a Hidden Markov Model for each landmark, and then used 90 samples as training data to train the model. At last, 60 heads were used as testing samples. Preliminary results show that spin image is highly efficient and robust to pose and lighting. As for HMM, the maximum landmark recognition rate reached 98.33%. There were two landmark HMM models (right orbitale and left cheilion) successful other two models (sellion and right cheilion) quality in general, and the rest of the models had low recognition rate. Further investigation is necessary to evaluate the feature descriptive ability of spin image in future. There are also several aspects related with HMM need to be investigated, such as the convergence of Baum-Welch algorithm and initialization parameters of B etc. Also enhancing efficiency and robustness and using our method to identify other landmarks of human body segments is worth more investigation.

articleTitle: The evaluation of the performance of 360 degree feedback system in insurance industry - a case study of a life insurance company
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The objective of this study is to comprehend questions out of the 360-degree feedback introduced to the performance appraisal of case and seek a strategy to solve them. The methods adopted include in-depth interview, questionnaires, and the focus group. First of all, we reviewed literatures regarding to the evaluation system to realize basic concepts and theories and then looked for some inspirations for the evaluation system in this case study from reviewed literatures. Based on the CIPP model evaluation developed by Stufflebeam, the questionnaire of “evaluation model with the 360-degree feedback introduced” prepared in this study was supplied to subjects employed by the life insurance company. The purposes include to unearth any barrier during execution of a project and to supply recommendations from derived conclusions as references to modify the process of executing the 360-degree feedback for performance appraisal.

articleTitle: A life cycle cost-based product design approach through integral architecture
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Life cycle cost is one of the most important factors to be considered in a product design process. This paper presents a mathematical model to cooperate life cycle cost into product design process through the methodology of integral architecture. First, we define a function-function matrix to show the revenues of coupling an interface, and an interface-interface matrix to show the coefficients influencing the global performance. Based on these matrices, we present an optimization model to try to get a low level of life cycle cost without too much local performance lost. Data can be collected by the method of design structure matrix. And several special cases are used to show the performance of this model.

articleTitle: Healthy emotional intelligence and effective leadership
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Healthy emotional intelligence (EI) is key to success for an effective leader whether in organization, industry or politics. Healthy EI also contributes to personality development and have positive effects on other health related factors. The aim of current research is to gauge the impact of healthy EI on effective leadership. TEIQUe instrument is used to survey project leaders from technical organizations. Effective and successful leaders have a higher ranked healthy emotional intelligence. The research predicts positive relation between healthy EI and effective leadership. Analysis has also been done on various demographic data and it also verifies the hypothesis. Only 26% of variance in effective leadership has been significantly explained by the emotional intelligence but 74% is still unexplained. It implies that there are some more variables vital in explaining effective leadership. The area of research is limited to the leadership in technical organizations only.

articleTitle: The research of Auto manufacturing enterprise brand crises on gray correlation analysis method
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This article based automotive brand 2004-2010 crisis. It was using the gray correlation analysis method to qualitative analysis of internal and external factors about the crisis caused by the Auto manufacturing enterprise brand and to calculate the correlation of Auto manufacturing enterprise brand crises, as well as, the associated discharge order. It provides guidance and reference to prevent Auto manufacturing enterprise brand crises.

articleTitle: Human Resource Management practices and work environment in China and India
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Human Resource Management practices are shaped by the work environment and culture of a specific country. “Localized” HR practices also determine, to a large extent, organizational effectiveness. Nevertheless, with present milieu of globalization and internationalization of businesses the pressure to adopt best practices and follow some form of international standards has become the norm. This is especially in the interest of companies who are either on the path to “globalization” or intend to go that way. Both China and India have strong indigenous cultures and work environment that has led to creation of unique Human Resource Management systems and practices in the organizational reality of each country.

articleTitle: Intelligent city - Tianjin: The system analysis of intelligent community public service
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With the promotion of the intelligent city of Tianjin, one of the great challenges of the intelligent government services is the consummation of intelligent community platform. This paper reports on the role of intelligent community and operating mechanisms. The online and offline communication would be the key point of the intelligent platform service. The information technology infrastructures were built in some demonstration area. But the old communities are the main part of all communities in Tianjin, and there are quite a lot low-income, older and technology-challenged citizens in all communities. A primary challenge for the development of intelligent city is the participation by low-income, older and technology-challenged citizens. Intelligent platform in communities is playing a role in supporting e-participation among older, technology-challenged residents, and also is connecting residents, business and government. So the intelligent community platform should be build both in infrastructure aspect and management aspect in all community.

articleTitle: The optimization of the knowledge diffusion processes and an innovation service relationship model in the context of social networks
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The diffusion path of innovative knowledge is influenced by the topology structure of social networks, whereas the efficiencies of diffusion and its value-realization are determined by the inter-node service innovation relationship. The structure of social network affect innovation diffusion respectively by ways of knowledge features, node income expectations, connected intensity and structural holes, etc. The optimization of service innovation can promote the effectiveness of node connections through service relationship adjustment mechanism. In particular, the principal-agent model of service innovation which is based on social capital emphasizes the role of core actors, claims for expectation adjustment of the related actors to overcome diffusion inertia, thereby promote regional knowledge sharing and realizing knowledge chain value optimization; And the interactive relationship service model which is based on connection status pays more attention to the positive effects of social innovation platforms, in promoting social network structure upgrading and over-all knowledge innovations.

articleTitle: Research on design and optimization of municipal pipe networks wireless monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: A wireless monitoring system consisted by microcomputer MSP430F149 processors and CC1100 wireless modules is developed as to meet the requirements of the development of modern municipal pipe networks. Emphases of this paper are placed on strive to attain technical breakthrough of the optimization of wireless communication protocols, the optimal design of soft ware and communication protocols, and finally, the feasibility and reliability of the outcomes is tested through practical experiments. The results show that the system realizes automated real-time monitoring, and it embraces merits of timeliness, high efficiency, low energy consumption, low cost, accuracy, convenience, etc.

articleTitle: The port competitive strategies research based on hotelling model
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The strategies of two duopoly ports which are characterized by different quality, network externality coefficient, compatibility, switch costs were studied after Hotelling model with Vertical product differentiation (port logistic service differentiation) and quadratic transport costs was introduced. For two ports, their locations and competitive in price were chose simultaneously. Equilibrium market strategies of duopoly ports with Horizontal and Vertical product differentiation are obtained. Under the assumption that duopoly ports would choose their maximal horizontal product differentiation (maximal location differentiation)the influence of network externality coefficient, compatibility coefficient and switch costs on the duopoly' competition equilibrium was analyzed. According to the results, in competitive environment, port should concern its own price advantage change, which will raise with the increase of its own network externality coefficient, compatibility, switch costs respectively and which will reduce with the increase of competitor's network externality coefficient, compatibility, switch costs respectively.

articleTitle: A theoretical model on the social networks of entrepreneurs, the exchange of social resources and the economic performances of enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: By embedding economic and hierarchical resources in social networks, this paper builds a resource exchange model with resource preferences and resource reproduction. With the equilibrium, it analyzes the effect of social networks, resource status quo and entrepreneurs' individual characteristics on firm economic performance, discusses the relationship between entrepreneurs' individual characteristics and the directions of the growth of firm economic performance, and gives a condition under which resource exchange results in a growth of overall economic performance. The results show that (1) information cost (entrepreneur's bargaining power, the degree of the preference to hierarchical resources, the ability of hierarchical resource reproduction, the ability of economic resource reproduction) has a negative (positive, negative, positive) effect on firm economic performance; (2) greater differences with regard to the degree of the preference to hierarchical resources and the ability of hierarchical resource reproduction and the ability of economic resource reproduction make inter-firm economic performance comparison go oppositely, and (3) the condition for resource exchange to make overall economic performance grow is that more economic resources shall be allocated to the party with stronger ability of economic resource reproduction in the exchange. These results answer the theoretical question of “what resources entrepreneurs prefer to, how they get them from social networks and how their actions influence firm economic performance”.

articleTitle: An empirical study on the competitiveness of Small and Medium-sized Manufacturing Enterprises in China
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper proposes an index system of comprehensive competitiveness assessment for the Small and Medium-sized Manufacturing Enterprises (SMMEs) in order to assess their competitiveness rationally and make the competitive strategy accordingly. An assessment model of SMMEs competitiveness based on BP Neural Network is built on the basis of weighting indices by Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) method and calculating SMMEs competitiveness comprehensive index which breaks through the limitation of conventional assessment methods, and also inducts the sensibility analysis to discriminate the importance of each index in the assessment index system. The effectiveness of our methodology was verified with an empirical study by using the data of 135 listed SMMEs which are from annual report in financial database of cninfo consultation. The results indicates that the Artificial Neural Network model can accurately realize the non-linear reflection from input index to output index, and it can avoid the random and subjectivity when determining the indices weight. Consequently, the assessment model of SMMEs competitiveness based on the Artificial Neural Network plays an important role in forecasting the competitiveness comprehensive index, discriminating the importance of each assessment index and discovering the competitive advantages and disadvantages, which is useful to provide a scientific basis for drafting the relevant competitive strategy and improving the competitiveness for the SMMEs.

articleTitle: A mathematical model for reconstructing the conventional assembly system
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In the dynamic and complex market environment, the conventional conveyor assembly line can no longer meet customers' demands effectively. The way of dismantling the conventional conveyor assembly line and redesigning a flexible manufacturing system has been attracting an increasing amount of attention both in the academics and production practices. Such an advanced manufacturing system simultaneously achieves flexibility and efficiency. In this paper, we investigate the problem of how to dismantle the conveyor assembly line into assembly cells. A comprehensive mathematical model incorporating two problems of how many assembly cells should be established and how many workers should be assigned to each assembly cell is developed. Then, an industrial case is discussed and the computational result is compared to that due to Kaku's model. The computational performance shows that the proposed model is effective and practical in resolving the problem of how to reconstruct the conventional assembly system.

articleTitle: A new consulting mode to improve the level of China railway consulting industry—Sino-foreign joint consulting
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In these years, China has made greater investment into railway projects, especial the high-speed rail projects, to adapt to the rapid economic development and to meet the demand of improving people's life. This creates a vast market and favorable opportunities for China's railway consulting industry. However, after joining the WTO, China has opened its construction market to the whole world, which brings both opportunities and challenges to China's railway consulting industry. This article describes the development of China's state railway consulting industry, analyzes its current status, achievements, opportunities and challenges, and on this basis, introduces a Sino-foreign joint projects consulting model. Considering the actual situation in China and the projects' status, we should give full play to the role of joint consultation, to optionally absorb and apply the advanced technologies and mature experience of management abroad and thus to practically and significantly promote the development of China's railway consulting industry.

articleTitle: Orientation of market allocation in China's financial development
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This article uses the provincial panel data in China to test the functions of the country's financial system. Results show that after the reform of financial liberalization, the financial system has begun to play its role in resource allocation, and has promoted economic growth through both capital accumulation and technical progress. However, the financial marketization degree is not high and technology absorption capacity measured by financial development level remains poor. Thus the financial system did not contribute to the promotion of technical progress and economic growth.

articleTitle: Main memory databases for enterprise applications
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Enterprise applications are traditionally divided in transactional and analytical processing. This separation was essential as growing data volume and more complex requests were no longer performing feasibly on conventional relational databases. While many research activities in recent years focussed on the optimization of such separation particularly in the last decade databases as well as hardware continued to develop. On the one hand there are data management systems that organize data column-oriented and thereby ideally fulfill the requirement profile of analytical requests. On the other hand significantly more main memory is available to applications that allow to store the complete compressed database of an enterprise in combination with the equally significantly enhanced performance. Both developments enable processing of complex analytical requests in a fraction of a second and thus facilitate complete new business processes and -applications. Obviously the question arises whether the artificially introduced separation between OLTP and OLAP can be revoked and all requests be handled on a combined data set. This paper focuses on the characteristics of data processing in enterprise applications and demonstrates how selected technologies can optimize data processing. A further trend is the use of cloud computing and with it the outsourcing of the data centre to optimize cost efficiency. Here column-oriented in memory databases are helpful as well as they permit a greater throughput, which in turn enables more effective use of the hardware and thus saves costs.

articleTitle: An analysis of enterprise network formation mechanism on the perspective of temporary cluster: A case study of Shanghai and Chengdu trade fairs
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper summarizes the progress of international research on temporary clusters and development tendency of trade fairs, with information collected on three international trade fairs which took place at Shanghai and Chengdu. We discuss how the function of trade fairs work on concentrating global-dimension enterprises in such a short time which produce so much information exchange and knowledge transfer. We consider, international trade fairs, this kind of temporary clusters have played an irreplaceable role on knowledge innovation and the diversity of enterprise networks. In other words, this kind of temporary clusters which create `global buzz' by face-to-face contacting exceed the boundary of permanent clusters, and become a complementarity of permanent clusters.

articleTitle: Case study on optimization strategy of utility of coal mine crisis reduction capability
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Using the empirical research methods, the optimization strategy of coal mine crisis reduction capability utility was discussed from the perspective of the coal mine employee utility. Five elements of coal mine crisis reduction capability were put forward which consist of environmental preparation, organizational preparation, personnel preparation, competitive preparation and learning preparation, as well as four elements of staff utility of coal mine which consist of enterprise and job satisfaction, communication satisfaction, benefit satisfaction and promotion satisfaction. The questionnaire was designed based on the Likert six-point scale. JCMG was chosen as sample, then statistical method, reliability analysis and Structural Equation Method were used to analysis the data. The conclusion of the optimization strategy of the coal mine crisis reduction capability based on the utility was obtained: first, strengthening the coal mine crisis study; second, promoting the competitiveness of the coal mine; third, concerning employees' enterprise and job satisfaction to influence the environment preparation element; forth, special concerning the coal mine employees' promotion satisfaction to prevent the negative influence.

Author Keywords: crisis reduction capability of coal mine

articleTitle: Stability analysis of supply chain collaboration for project
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to ensure supply chain collaboration stability, ant colony optimization algorithm was used to study construction supply chain operational efficiency, to determine the dynamic operational errors of construction supply chain. Neural network and data mining technology were used to forecast the investment risk of construction project, to determine the forecasting errors of construction project investment risk. Rough sets and neural network technology were used to evaluate the risk of discrete non-deterministic characteristics in construction process, to determine the risk evaluation errors of construction process for project. Fuzzy neural network with chaotic time series was used to forecast the construction demand of project in a certain period of time, to determine the errors of demand forecast in construction supply chain. Bessel function was used to analyze the stability of construction supply chain collaboration under internal load and external load. Above-mentioned errors is overlapped, and input to Bessel function. System control theory is used to analyze stability state of construction supply chain under the impact load, to determine the method of construction supply chain span.

articleTitle: Brands leaping and bounding based on disruptive innovation — A case study of FAW own brand Pentium
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In the current fierce international environment, Own brand has embodied a country's economic strength. It is hard to achieve leapfrog development for the own brand relying on traditional maintaining innovation. The article expects from the effective combination of technology and market on disruptive innovation to explore the new leap-forward developing path. Further analyzing from the theoretical and actual case; draw the conclusion that the disruptive innovation integrating with disruptive technology and the Blue Ocean market strategies is the effective path selection for the development of independent brands by leaps and bounds.

articleTitle: The impact research of the natural environmental conditions on the storage of the Missile in China's coastal areas
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The environmental stress Missile suffered during the storage period is an important factor in their failure. This paper firstly introduced the significance of the reliability of the missile storage, and then described the natural environmental factors of the coastal areas. Finally, the failure mechanism and failure modes of the missile in these natural environmental factors were researched. Based on a coastal city of a typical year, temperature and humidity data impact analysis was carried out.

articleTitle: Research on improving the innovation capability of SMEs in Fujian province from the perspective of TIM
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper studied the innovation characteristics of small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in Fujian province, then it applied the theory of TIM to analyze the main problems existing in innovation of SMEs in Fujian province. At the end, corresponding measurements were put forward to improve innovation capability of SMEs in Fujian province from the perspective of TIM.

articleTitle: Method study of calculating and controlling work-in-process
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The focus of this paper is to study two methods of calculating the work-in-process as applied to manufacturing system. A teamwork chart is given to figure out the composing and related quantity of work-in-process when we focus on comparatively simple process or parts of a complex process. But when we focus on more complex production process, an I-O curve is introduced instead of teamwork for more easily studying the quantity of work-in-process. Moreover, the paper discusses the main factors which affect the quantity of the work-in-process and illustrates how to better control and monitor them.

articleTitle: Price formation and its dynamics in Dutch auctions
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The research uses flower auction data from KIFA to study the price formation process in Dutch auctions. Using ARIMA model, we find that the auction prices are highly correlated and the prices follow an AR(1, 0, 0) process with coefficient 0.583. Based on it, we construct multiple linear regression equations and analyze the effect of some factors on the auction prices. The result shows that the average auction price on the previous day and the first five auction prices today have a positive impact on the tendency of the auction price today. Meanwhile, the ratio of demand to supply quantity also has a significant impact on the auction price.

articleTitle: Research on the disassembling methods for product components based on green design
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: To achieve the product green design, from the view point of disassembly after the product retirement, the article studies disassembly sequence of products and indexes related to disassembly process respectively and makes a comprehensive evaluation. And on the basis, it puts forward reasonable and feasible measures. Finally it combines examples to verify the methods.

articleTitle: The evaluation research on livable city based on multiplication model and AHP
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Through the systematic analysis, a conceptual model assessing Livable city is established to revalue the cities of China. Elements contributing to quality of livable environmental status are carefully selected and then the evaluation index system is established according to the model. The weights of elements are calculated based on AHP. In order to get more logical results, the appropriate evaluation model-Multiplicative model is chosen to analyze. With several Chinese cities for case study, the result shows that the evaluation model can be regarded as a kind of relatively scientific method in evaluating urban habitability.

articleTitle: Study in system simulation of the service core process planning based on the 4S shop
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to achieve the virtual manufacturing (VM) technology, we need to carry out different aspects of scientific research<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>. This paper focuses on the virtual production planning in the manufacturing enterprise. The reasonableness of production planning program is evaluated by the Witness simulation software and data prediction. Finally, that will make out the balance of logistics, energy and time; eliminate bottlenecks problems in discrete production systems; find out the optimal solution by the theory of TOC and green performance; improve efficiency and assess a variety of the equipment and process design.

articleTitle: The research of the application domain of lean design
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Lean production is a scientific management method that has been proven in practice. By nature, lean production is a kind of philosophy, and spirit. The core of it includes waste elimination, continuous improvement, and the pursuit of excellence. Therefore, the range of the application of lean production should not just be limited to the manufacturing process, and it should extend to design process so as to eliminate waste from the source. This is the thought of lean design. This paper elaborated the concept of lean design, analyzed the application fields of lean design, and indicated that it is the only way to establish lean enterprise that make comprehensive lean design for enterprise.

articleTitle: A novell shop planning algorithm based on judge mechanism
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: By introducing judge mechanism into the encoding of genetic algorithm, we developed a novell evolutionary algorithm to solve the Job-Shop problem. The algorithm is the combination of GA and Heuristic Processing's feature. In some extent, the actually result of scheduling showed that the method is perfect on running time and global optimization.

articleTitle: Application of double hidden layer process neural network on wood drying modeling
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Aiming at time-varying and complex nonlinear characteristics in the wood drying process, a double hidden process neural network was introduced into wood drying modeling. Time-varying and complex nonlinear characteristics of wood drying were considered adequately in wood drying model by time series data of main influence factors fitted to time-varying functions as network input. The concrete modeling process and learning algorithm were given. The effectiveness of method is proved by ash wood drying. It provides a new way for complex system identification.

Author Keywords: Double hidden layer process neural network

articleTitle: Research on China's marine industrial structure optimization based on circular economy
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: China's marine industrial structure is approaching to be reasonable, while the total value of marine economic output is expanding unceasingly and major marine industries are under relatively stable development. This paper attempts to be guided by circular economic principles and uses gray relation analysis as a way of analyzing correlation between contributions of marine GDP and changes of China's marine industrial structure, and get the conclusion that China's marine second industry makes the greatest correlation to contributions of marine GDP. Furthermore, some countermeasures of marine industrial structure optimization are presented.

articleTitle: The short-term life prediction model of gearbox based on chaotic neural network
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Since faults of gearbox occurred randomly during the normal status, chaos theory was chosen to analyze the nonlinear characteristics of vibration acceleration signals for gearbox. The short-term prediction model of chaotic neural network for gearbox life was proposed based on chaotic time series. In the model, the chaotic time series phase space was reconstructed as the input vectors of neural network, and the predictable step of gearbox was set as the output vectors of neural network, then the short-term life of gearbox was obtained. The results of the simulation on the vibration acceleration signals of the test-gearbox showed that the model is more effective and accurate compared with the traditional neural network prediction methods.

articleTitle: Sustainable design principles and methods for product development
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Sustainable design approaches consider the environmental impacts of products during their whole lifecycle. The application of sustainable design leads to the development of more environmentally benign products and processes. Principles and methods of sustainable design are discussed in this article. The goals of sustainable design are reducing or minimizing the use of non-renewable resources. The aims and the scope of sustainable design should not be developed separately from those of traditional design. Instead, they should be an evolution and an extension of traditional design. Sustainable design without any cultural meaning or aesthetic considerations will not be acceptable by the society at all.

articleTitle: Study on the dynamic mechanism of highway's standardization management
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The current study is designed to ensure highway enterprise's business actives to run orderly, efficiently and coordinately, and to achieve sustainable development of the industry. According to the running mechanism and dynamic factors of highway's standardized management, a dynamic mechanism model of highway standardized management is constructed. Combining these results, such as local standards are promulgated, the construction industry, investment diversification and diversification of business are formed in a province. The correctness of this model has been proved.

articleTitle: The gray relativity analysis of our nation high-tech industry
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The development of our nation high-tech industrial plays an important role on the restructuring of China's industry and the expanding economy. It's subjected to capital investment, labor, technical standards, import and export trade, and many other factors. This paper uses the gray relativity model to study and prove the high-tech industries associated with the degree of each index.

articleTitle: Efficiency evaluation in key disciplines scientific research based on DEA and SFA
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Discipline scientific research level is an important manifestation of integrated academic strength in higher educational institutes. This paper establishes an evaluation system for key discipline scientific research level, in combination with the comprehensive investment project in Tianjin municipal universities during the “11th Five-Year” plan, and measures scientific research input and output efficiency of 58 key disciplines in 15 universities based on DEA and SFA methods. Then it carries out correlation analysis and consistency test for the two types of efficiency values and rankings. The result shows that input and output efficiencies have significant difference in numerical sequencing but have good consistency in terms of efficiency ranking.

articleTitle: Optimization of production line based on IE method: A case study
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to solve production problems of X Company, such as capacity can't satisfy customer's need, low productivity, and high defective rate, the production line is analyzed and improved by Industrial Engineering method, Such as Work study, Facility planning, Human Factor and so on. Based on roundly analyzing product, quantity, route, layout, productivity, quality, and by improving material transportation way, optimizing key process, improving production line's layout, and improving quality, various waste are eliminated, and material handlings and work environment are optimized. It indicates that quality, productivity and cost is effectively optimized by the IE method.

articleTitle: Research on improving prediction of demand for common components through aggregation effect—Simulation based on linear trend of ols method
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The shift the prediction object from the final product to the common component makes better use of the aggregation effect. In this study, the mutually independent demands for all the products with linear increasing trend is generated by the method of Monte Carlo Stochastic Simulation. Using the prediction method of ordinary least square, the comparison is made with two prediction results. One of which is to predict final products demand, then the total demand for common components of all the products is calculated based on the Bill of Materials, and the other is to predict the demand of common components directly. The following conclusion is drawn that the direct prediction of the demand for common components could take advantage of the aggregation effect more sufficiently. This study also discusses the influences of correlations of the product demands, the fluctuation degree, and the number of the common components, etc. on the aggregation effect.

articleTitle: Rice protein level affects cholesterol metabolism
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: To examine the cholesterol-lowering potential of rice protein at different dietary levels, 20-week-old male Wistar rats were fed cholesterol-free diets containing 14% rice protein (RP) or 28% rice protein (RP-H) and 14% casein (CAS) for 2 weeks. Compared with CAS, RP and RP-H exhibited the significant hypocholesterolemic action in adult rats, reflected mainly the significantly diminished contents of non-HDL cholesterol. Hepatic total cholesterol, particularly esterified cholesterol accumulation, was significantly lowered in adult rats fed RP and RP-H than those fed CAS. Fecal neutral sterol excretions were stimulated with the increasing RP level. As a result, the apparent cholesterol absorption was effectively inhibited with the increasing RP level. These results demonstrate that dietary level of RP can regulate cholesterol metabolism and plays a major role in the modulation of cholesterol absorption.

articleTitle: Study on the simulation of coal enterprise ecosystem
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The dynamic Simulation of coal enterprises is proposed with system dynamics. Having been proved effective, Zaozhuang Coal Mining Group is applied as an example to carry out case study on four behavior patterns simulated. The results demonstrate that this model is available and can be implemented to simulate, predict and analysis the future development of coal enterprise ecosystem with sound suggestions.

articleTitle: Product lifecycle oriented quality management system for supply chain
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: For the dynamic and variable environment of supply chain, how to assure product quality in the total product lifecycle within the operating process of supply chain, is a difficult problem that a supply chain enterprise must face. A new quality management mode is proposed, which constructs and runs product lifecycle oriented quality management system for supply chain, integrated several key enabling technologies such as collaborative quality design, intelligent process quality control and product lifecycle oriented quality evaluation. Finally, the prototype system of intelligent process quality control is developed by applying the development mode of JSP+Servlet and the network function interface of Java and Matlab, which was introduced as an example of some Heavy Machinery Ltd to demonstrate the rationality and validity of the method.

articleTitle: A stochastic dynamic programming model for multi-site capacity planning in TFT-LCD industry
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This research focuses on the multi-site capacity planning problem in TFT-LCD industry under stochastic demand. TFT-LCD industry becomes a critical industry in Taiwan and has the following characteristics: (1) complex product hierarchy and product types; (2) coexistence of multi-generation manufacturing technologies in the multi-site production system; (3) rapid changing and stochastic markovian demand. In this complicated environment, the capacity planning which balances demand and supply is encountered by TFT-LCD industry. It is to simultaneously make a robust capacity allocation plan and capacity expansion policy across multiple sites against stochastic demand. In addition, for the TFT-LCD manufacturing, the demand situation follows Markov properties in which the correlations of the demand variations in the consecutive periods are high and the demand status in next period is stochastically determined by the present one. In this regard, two-stage stochastic programming traditionally neglects dynamic capacity adjustments in response to new available demand information. Therefore, this study constructs a stochastic dynamic programming (SDP) model which considers many TFT-LCD practical characteristics and constraints to generate a dynamic capacity planning policy as the demand in each period is revealed and updated. In the end, a numerical example is illustrated to prove the feasibility of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Board composition and performance of tourism firms: Evidence from panel data of listed tourism firms in China
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper investigates the impact that board composition has on firm performance in a sample of listed tourism firms in China during the period 1992-2009. The results show that there is significantly negative relationship between Tobin's Q and CEO duality, while there is no statistically significant relationship between ROA and CEO duality. Board size has strong negative impacts on both Tobin's Q and ROA, while board independence has positive influence on both Tobin's Q and ROA of tourism firms.

articleTitle: Working face layout optimization of bucket wheel excavator systems based on reliability analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on the current situation which the bucket wheel excavator systems can't been arranged according to the previous design scheme at Heidaigou Open-pit Coal Mine, three feasible alternatives to arrange bucket wheel excavator systems are put forward. Then their reliability is calculated, and the optimal alternative is recommended according to the calculated reliability. Finally the economic benefit is estimated if the recommend alternative were put in practice.

articleTitle: The comprehensive evaluation of Henan High-Tech Zone “second-time pioneer” ability and the construction of Innovative Science Technology Park
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: China is in the development of the economic transformation and innovative national construction, in this context, based on the consideration of comprehensive evaluation index system of national High-tech Zone and existing statistical indicators of Henan High-tech Zone, this paper constructs a comprehensive evaluation indices system that can fully embody second-time pioneer ability influenced by the technology innovation elements, and uses the method of entropy weight to evaluate the “second-time pioneer” ability of four national High-tech Zone and seven provincial High-tech Zone in Henan province, in order to provide guidance for the construction of Henan Innovative Science Technology Park.

Author Keywords: Construction of Innovative Science Technology Park

articleTitle: Analysis on reasons for reserved water in water rights allocation
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In initial water rights allocation, defining reserved water is not only internal requirement of national water rights system, important security in case of water-supplying crisis, but also consistent with the connotation and essence of sustainable development. Some water statutes and policies have already suggested reserving water in case of emergency, and practice proves that reserving water is feasible. Based on the theory of social net-welfare, reserved water can be used for regulating water rights market and helps realizing Pareto improvement finally.

articleTitle: The route choice of SMEs' technological innovation and its empirical study—Taking SMEs in Fujian Province for example
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper analyzed the main problems in technological innovation of SMEs in China, and pointed out the significance of studying the route choice of SMEs' technological innovation. Through summarizing the existing research results, it presented 5 optional technological innovation paths which SMEs could choose in their growth process. At the end, case studies were conducted to discuss how SMEs could correctly choose the technological innovation path in different growth stage, by taking SMEs in Fujian Province for example.

articleTitle: Equipment status evaluation based on grey - clustering analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The most common ways to evaluate device status include the analytic hierarchy, fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method and fuzzy analytic hierarchy. However, it would not be able to determine which category the object should belong to when the computed membership has no significant difference. In view of the limitations of theses method, this paper presents an evaluation based on grey clustering evaluation. Our way is to build whitening weight functions and their inflexions from the past maintenance data first, And then application of entropy-right method to determine each index weight of the evaluation. Finally, determines whether the device need for maintenance according to the result based on the operation of whitening weight functions and entropy-right method using real - time data of a specific device.

articleTitle: Geothermal heating system economic model optimization based on improved genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This study built an economic model of the geothermal heating system by the annual cost method. The strengths of genetic algorithm and simulated annealing were integrated and utilized in the economic model. A case study verified that the optimized economic result and searching speed can be achieved by improved genetic algorithm.

articleTitle: Product improving design based on TRIZ/VE
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to help designers to find the need improved objects correctly during product design, a product improving design frame based on TRIZ/VE is presented. This frame is based on product function analysis model which is built according to product components' interrelationship. And it integrates TRIZ ideal final result (IFR) concept with Value Engineering to calculate and evaluate function value resulting in discovering the problems components with lower value for improving. A practical example of hydraulic reciprocating piston rod seal system is provided to illustrate the validation of the model.

articleTitle: Research on site selection of appliances to the Home Appliance Going Rural enterprises' distribution center
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Home Appliance Going Rural policy is an important measure of promoting the construction of new socialist countryside, improving farmers' living quality, expanding rural consumption and promoting economic growth rapidly. This paper analyzes the characteristics of the regional logistics, takes service costs as the objective function and then establishes the model of multi-distribution center location that fits rural markets under the rural background. Then the model is solved by simulated annealing algorithm to get the optimal location program. Last, it illustrates the adaptability of the model with the example.

articleTitle: The government behavior in the development of indemnificatory housing in China
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on brief description of the development of China's history ofindemnificatory housing, this paper focused on the dilemma and the government behavior in the development of indemnificatory housing, getting a conclusion that the local governments' object of pursuit high growth of GDP and the land finance is the main course of the plight. Then the paper analyzed the necessary to address the middle-income groups of public rentalhousing. Finally, we get that goals for local governments should be transferred to pay more attention to improve the people's livelihood and make policy recommendations to ensure the effective implementation of the construction of public rental housing.

articleTitle: The supplier switching of retail enterprise
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The retail enterprises try to find suppliers who provide products with lower price and good quality in their business operations. In this paper, the supplier switching of the retail enterprise is analyzed and researched. The entrant supplier's defective rate can be considered as his private information, considering the incentive compatibility constraint and the participation constraint, the retail enterprise's supplier switching model is established. And through the analysis of the objective function and the constrain conditions of the supplier switching model, the optimal switching ratio to the entrant supplier is obtained, a numerical example verify the result of the retail enterprise's switching ratio.

articleTitle: Research on quality control of ship painting based on improved scatter plot
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The core question in quality management is the quality control to improve satisfaction. The improved scatter plot is put forward to make up for the limited analysis of two factors in scatter plot, through which the location, related process and frequency of defects can be found easily and intuitively, it is positive to improve quality management. Taking painting in shipbuilding as a case to analyze, the results show that it can effectively improved the quality of work, reduce costs and shorten production cycle of ships through using of the improved scatter plot.

articleTitle: Vehicle routing problem considering load cost
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: When researching vehicle routing problem the cost is always taken into account. In this paper the load of vehicles is considered. On the basis of this, a model of vehicle routing problem is constructed. An example is illustrated to prove the model proper.

articleTitle: A new model of knowledge innovation in enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: SECI model has a significant impact on knowledge innovation. Previous knowledge management studies are mostly based on this model, but SECI model doesn't give a detailed explanation of how knowledge innovation happens. This paper draws on the main theories of SECI model and makes an in-depth analysis of knowledge innovation. Based on this we pose a new model of knowledge innovation which combines the knowledge subject and object.

articleTitle: Study on leaning methods for kansei quality management of food products
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The study on leaning methods for kansei quality management of Chinese food products has captured constant attention, as Chinese enterprises are endeavoring to improve kansei quality of food products and thus refine the people's lifestyle. In this thesis, the author applies both questionnaire and model analysis to compare kansei quality of certain tea drinks, evaluates kansei quality of Chinese food products, explores leaning methods for kansei quality management of tea drinks, and gives a close examination of kansei quality management process. The methodology of industrializing kansei quality management is confirmed. The intrinsic link between kansei quality management and lean thinking lies in realizing the exact kansei quality expected by customers. Creating kansei value is fundamental to understanding and improving the relation between enterprises and customers. Leaning methods for kansei quality management are a basic form of knowledge integration, a thinking strategy geared up for improving product quality, enhancing product competitiveness and creating world-class consumer brands. In essence, it is a philosophical business approach benefiting everyone involved.

articleTitle: Discussion and research on the high building fire escape devices and TRIZ
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: It discusses the status quo of escape system under the trend of the increasingly high building fire nowadays, and researches its feasibility and operation advantages and disadvantages with TRIZ theory. It makes relevant investigation and research in combination with a part of urban high buildings and the latest escape facilities. Besides, it makes certain preconceptions and prospects on the development of the future high building fire escape system.

articleTitle: Image texture recognition method research based on Wavelet Technology
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In image retrieval and identification technology, image texture feature extraction and recognition is a better way. Texture is a feature which is common and difficult to describe in the image. Texture feature extraction and recognition is an important part of image retrieval study based on content. This paper utilizes Wavelet Technology, proposes a texture feature extraction and recognition algorithm based on Wavelet packet transform and singular value decomposition, and by measuring calculation distance of European space, obtain the image which is closest to sample image.

articleTitle: Technology transfer of foreign direct investment in China-based on two-sector model
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Foreign direct investment (FDI) inflow increases greatly since China's openness and whether FDI is conducive to promote China's technology advance via technology transfer still remains a controversial issue. The paper first uses a classical two-factor production function which divide the economy into domestic and foreign sector, then augments the model, taking into account the externalities by technology transfer of FDI to domestic sector. Using provincial panel data, results indicate that positive FDI technology transfer prevails across China, and much higher in coastal regions due to better economic and FDI performance than that that in middle and western regions.

articleTitle: Improved theoretical and mathematical model for individual stress study
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In the development of stress, domestic and overseas scholars have put forth several major theoretical models: Stimulating Theoretical Model, Response Theoretical Model, CPT Theoretical Model and System Theoretical Model. Each model has its own unique, but also has its weaknesses, which make the application value of stress theory far below it should be. On the basis of existing stress theoretical model, this paper proposes pressure cylinder stress theoretical model. It takes the individual in the stress environment as the center, and has considered the complexity of the individual psychological behavior and environmental factor. Pressure cylinder stress theoretical model takes individual physiological variables as indicators of stress response, then establish the mathematical model, which can more accurately reflect the stress intensity and individual stress.

articleTitle: Bi-level programming model and algorithm weighing features and price of iron ore for pig iron cost
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Many scholars and practitioners have done a lot of research to minimize the procurement cost of iron bearing material (abbreviate:IBM), which accounts for a large proportion in the pig iron cost, subject to maintaining the features of IBM. However, the triangle effect, three points of which are the price of IBM (procurement cost), its features (ore grade in particular), and pig iron cost, becomes significant with shortage and price rise of iron ore, where the effect of the features on pig iron cost through productivity, product quality, and auxiliary material consumption, is complicated. A model was established in this paper to minimize iron cost, and quantitative analysis of the triangle effect was also done. Finally, the model was solved by the improved complex method proposed previously by the author, and the numerical example illustrated that the model and algorithm are effective.

articleTitle: A look at the development and countermeasures of medium-sized and small property rights transfer agencies
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The Chinese property rights market has undergone more than 20-year exploration and practice. It has now become the foundational capital market and is playing a vital role in China's market economy construction. But the agencies - serving as the functional transfers in this market - are varying significantly and out of balance, especially for the numerous medium-sized and small property rights transfer agencies. This article firstly deals with the classification into the present development situation of the property rights market nationwide; and then emphatically analyzes the main problems existing in the development of the medium-sized and small property rights transfer agencies; finally some countermeasures are put forward for its development by exemplifying some functions that can be provided for them.

articleTitle: The extension of the function of CNC milling machine—Slotting key-groove replaced by CNC milling machine
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on actual production's needs, the function of CNC milling machine is extended to slotting process. By analyzing the functions and features between two machine tools, making technological transformation in main components and equipment, product performance is acceptable. The replacement between CNC milling machine and slotting machine leads to improve efficiency.

articleTitle: The study of destructive measurement systems
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Modern quality management decision making typically requires a great amount of data. It goes without saying, of course, that the quality of those decisions is itself dependent on the level of quality of the data that forms the underlying basis for the decisions. Since data generally result from measurement, effective and efficient measurement systems are critical components of the quality toolkit. To ensure that the appropriate measurement system is in use, it is important to know whether the measurement process is properly classified as non-destructive or destructive. This distinction will affect the necessary format of subsequent data analysis and thus the basis upon which quality decisions emerge. Of the two types, destructive measurement systems have received far less attention. This paper aims to address that gap by illustrating an appropriate method for the analysis of data obtained from a destructive measurement system with an example from the electronics industry.

articleTitle: An estimation of jatropha yield as an alternate fuel resource through the concatenated rule sets
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The supply chain of jatropha has got much attention due to the issues related to alternate fuels demand. The cultivation of jatropha seed and its yield estimation of jatropha in near future will have more rigorous effect. Cultivating jatropha seed in the unutilized land can improve the alternate fuels production. In this paper the estimation of jatropha yield is focused. The yield is mainly depending on the climatic and various other attributes. Hence the yield is estimated based on the major attributes that affects the jatropha seed growth. The identification of major attributes is being carried out with the Matlab software using Adaptive Neuro Fuzzy Inference System (ANFIS). Based on the attributes identified a general heuristic rule has been framed to estimate the total yield of jatropha. The computations of yield estimation is being carried out with the logic of concatenation using MS excel. From the yield estimation results, the future production capacity of jatropha in any given land can be justified.

articleTitle: A conversion analysis on the test of the concrete strength by noumenon sampling
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: A new method for testing the concrete strength which is called noumenon sampling was put forward. Strength data from concrete specimens was processed by the error theory in order to explore this method in testing the strength of concrete. The conversion relationship between the strength of noumenon sampling specimens and the strength of standard maintenance specimens was explored by correction coefficient and regression analysis. The two revised results were compared and analyzed. Result shows that the correction precision of the regression equation is more perfect.

articleTitle: The application of WSR methodology in the improvement of cigarettes quality
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Taking a cigarette factory as an example, this paper uses the method combining the WSR methodology in systems science with the cause and effect diagram in quality management to systematically analyze the factors affecting the cigarette quality from the aspects of Wuli-Shili-Renli, and finds out the main factors that affect the cigarette quality, then gives the cause and effect diagram that improves the cigarette quality. It points out that the key factor to improve the cigarette quality is to put the technology of SPC (Statistical Process Control), especially the technology of the control chart into the real-time control of the production process. Finally some effective suggestions to improve the quality of cigarette are put forward from the system point of view.

articleTitle: Experiment research on electronic image stabilization of omni-directional camera system
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: A electronic image stabilizing method for omni-directional camera system is put forward in this paper. The omni-directional camera system has an advantage of nearly 360 degree camera angle. Due to the fact that omni-directional image sequence can not be observed easily, we first translate the omni-directional image sequence into the objective original image sequence and then study image stabilization. The omni-directional image unrolling algorithm and image stabilizing method are analyzed in depth in this paper. Based on gray projection algorithm, image stabilizing method in omni-directional camera system is proposed. The hardware of the system is composed of omni-directional devices, CCD, image acquisition card and computer and the software program (DirectShow platform via VC++). Experiment results indicate that it is a practical method to realize electronic image stabilization in omni-directional camera system. Meanwhile it is a method characterized by high speed and accuracy as well.

articleTitle: Deploying Six Sigma in Motorola supply chain HR management —Exemplified by Motorola ISC DL workforce strategies
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: As globalization brought competition in international market, enterprises have been trying to gain highest customer satisfaction with lowest input. Through continuous practices, they gradually recognized that high quality and low cost are not incompatible with each other as what they thought to be. In other words, high quality and low cost can be achieved at the same time. The Six Sigma management strategies which were originated in Motorola perfectly proved their reorganization. However, Six Sigma is not merely a means of quality control; it has developed to be a systematic way of continuously process improvement. Entitled the Whampoa of HR, Motorola HR function is well-known for its high-skilled management. One of its secret is the application Six Sigma. For example, in a Six Sigma project, Motorola HR innovatively figured out the strategy of job evaluation, workforce planning, among others, to provide its Integrated Supply Chain with flexible DL workforce.

articleTitle: Research and implementation on framework of service-oriented production management system
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: After the disadvantages of traditional production management system are analyzed, a new solution is outlined for the system in this paper, which uses the cloud computing architecture based on service and described in detail. At last, the feasibility and advantages of this solution are shown in this paper by theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Decision-making support info-structure in enterprise risk management
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This article aims to address a info-structure to turning the situation of company from “data rich” to “knowledge rich”. Such model provides a new solution for companies to use both historical data and continuously updated project management data of enterprises to support project decision-makings. By using networking system, companies could mature their project management and increase the rate of success during conducting projects.

articleTitle: Indentify bottleneck and optimal study on logistics in low carbon timber production
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The study object of this thesis is the system of timber production in logging enterprises. In view of current situation of timber production logistics, find out and optimize the bottleneck of influencing the development of low carbon in timber production logistics by using the TOC theory combined with the energy consumption, making it comply with the trend of low carbon logistics development.

articleTitle: Emergency evolution analysis in the city
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: For the occurrence and spread of emergency described, this text based on the urban traffic network, gave the expression of Emergency site and defined the transportation parameter and the judgment matrix in the emergency condition. By appearing the method that control emergency spread, the method could extract some crossroads and roads they were affected by emergency, depicted scope and degree that the emergency influenced, provided a reference for further analyzing the trend of emergency.

articleTitle: Core competence evaluation of paper making enterprises — An empirical analysis based on the listed companies
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The study constructs an evaluation system of core competence of paper making companies based on the traditional core competence theory. By analyzing the data of listed paper making companies with factor analysis model, ten indicators are integrated into four factors, namely Value, Growth, Integration and Uniqueness which constructs the core competence of paper making companies. The results showed that Sun Paper Stock Co. Ltd, Huatai Stock Co. Ltd, Chenming Paper Holdings Co. Ltd, Yinge Industrial Investment Co. Ltd and Bohui Paper Industry Co. Ltd have core competence. Last, the study evaluates the origin of the core competence of paper making companies.

articleTitle: Organizational performance evaluation of power supply with partial least-squares regression
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Power industry plays an important role in the development of China's energy industry. Organizational performance means that administrators use evaluation index system to evaluate the overall effect of the organization's operating results. Organizational performance management can focus on performance of the organization, a department, and processes to build a product or service. Partial least squares (PLS) regression is a recent technique that generalizes and combines features from principal component analysis and multiple regression. In this paper, we first established a supply enterprise performance evaluation index system. Then using partial least squares regression model, organizational performance of a number of Inner Mongolia Electric Power Corporation power companies were quantitative evaluated.

articleTitle: Research on control system of processing high-order aspherical with numerical control tangent method
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: According to the principle of high-order aspherical machining by numerical control tangent method, an open numerical control system was designed based on UMAC. In the composition of hardware, the function, features and variable applications of the servo axis card was introduced in detail, with the standard of the choice of man-machine interface illustrated. In software, the functions of the operating system, development tools and the dynamic link library were integrated, and the modular method was adopted to design the system management software and full-time control software. The innovativeness of the control system is displayed in the breakthrough in that the position control method in the traditional CNC numerical system controlling motion nodes by full-time rate control, the Hidden Markov model theory was introduced to realize ahead forecast compensation, enabling velocity to be controlled continuously, and therefore improve the accuracy of machining surface, and in the meantime this method can be expanded into all applications of speed servo, which improves the accuracy of locus control.

articleTitle: A new kind of retailer supply chain system model
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In this paper, a retail supply chain system model, FROM-SCM was provided according the actual situation of China's retail enterprises. The commodity demand forecasting, pricing and discounts, and order policy, and other key issues to improve the model and its realization in FROM-SCM based on TEI@I methodology were discussed. A new kind of retail supply chain management model that can optimize integration of external resources, greatly improve the efficiency of the supply chain was certificated by empirical research using FROM-SCM model.

articleTitle: The hardware design and application of CAT system for electro-hydraulic servo value
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: By comparing the differences between several CAT in the test system for electro-hydraulic servo valve, we present a overall design of automatic test system based on virtual instrument technology. For requirements of the different indicators to the test of dynamic and static performance and solving practical engineering problems of actuator drift, we design a current source controlled by program to set actuator in the zero position. The CAT system for electro-hydraulic servo valve provides good performance in the implementation of manufacturing.

articleTitle: Supply chain coordination and risk sharing with considering internal and external quality fault and return policy
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper studies a supply chain quality coordination and risk-sharing problem. We find when the supply chain is coordinated under internal and external quality fault existing, it can be obtained the optimal profit, order quantity and risk sharing of the supply chain parties for each. And when the supply chain is coordinated and the item has not been sold, the supplier should allow the seller return his order item with wholesale price. The total optimal expected profit is smaller when internal and external quality fault is appeared but the risking share is larger. The risk sharing is positively correlated with the fault rate but is non-correlated with the return policy. The risk sharing of the supply chain is also positively correlated with the wholesale price, retail price and the seller is not zero risk sharing<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>.

articleTitle: Research on the impact and countermeasures of the common volatility of the Southeast Asian stock markets upon the stock price transmission of China's monetary policy
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With the world economic integration, the economy between China and Southeast Asian countries is more and more closely related, and there have been a lot of documents on this issue, but the research on the impact of the Southeast Asian stock markets upon the transmission mechanism of China's monetary policy is still blank. This thesis, firstly, uses the econometric method to analyze the common volatility spillover of the Southeast Asian stock markets upon China's stock market; secondly, it discusses the stock market transmission theory of China's monetary policy; finally, it analyzes the impact of the Southeast Asian stock markets upon the stock price transmission of China's monetary policy and puts forward some countermeasures to effectively exert the influence of China's stock price in the monetary policy transmission.

articleTitle: A pattern based approach to workflow structure analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Reference workflow model are a popular tool for business process reengineering (BPR). A good reference workflow model should not contain structural problems, e.g. deadlock or unfinished instances. Therefore, the structure of the reference workflow model should be verified to effectively facilitate BPR projects and reduce the errors of workflow system implementation.
