This work presents a novel pattern-based Petri Net (PN) structural analytical approach. Several workflow patterns and their PN-based identification algorithms are also developed. An approach to transform a PN model into a pattern-based process diagram (PBPD) is specified. Via the PBPD, several structure-related flaws, such as deadlock and improper nesting, are analyzed using a Split-Join Routing Table (SJRT). The PBPD can also reduce the complexity of a PN model and enhance the analytical efficiency. Finally, an industrial reference model is used as an empirical case to verify the proposed approach.

articleTitle: A hybrid genetic algorithm based on dynamic coding of bargain model in inserting order
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In this paper, a new method to solve the hybrid genetic algorithm based on dynamic coding by bargain model in inserting order is proposed. A new coding method for the inserting order is presented also. Corresponding crossover and mutation operators are given. These operators can easily keep the feasibility of solution. They can also satisfy the stochastic demand of genetic algorithm. Finally, an example for a workshop inserting order is given. The results show the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: E-commerce recommendation system based on CBR and web log mining
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The recommendation service is an important part of E-commerce. After analyzing the feasibility to combine CBR (Case-based Reasoning) and web log mining with recommendation system in E-commerce, we integrate the two techniques into E-commerce recommendation system effectively, and propose a framework for the recommendation system adopting B/S structure and design thought of multi-layer. The key technologies of the proposed framework are also given.

articleTitle: Transformation of economic development and activity-based management
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: How to apply appropriate cost management mode so to obtain a sustainable competitive advantage is an important issue faced by Chinese enterprises. This paper shows the influence of transformation of economic development on enterprises' cost management, analyzes the shortcomings of traditional costing mode; then the paper describes the advantages of activity-based management. The paper focuses on the application of activity-based management in the enterprises in the transformation period of economic development and provides the concrete steps. In the end, the paper shows the special attentions in applying activity-based management.

articleTitle: Genetic algorithm-based systems modeling in traders' evolution mechanism
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Technology of system simulation has become the important tool in studying various systems, particularly the complex systems. In this paper the method is applied to the construct an artificial stock market system and simulates the evolution of traders combined with genetic algorithm (GA). Then we can observe the macroscopic behavior of the artificial stock market from bottom to up and the impact to the stock market from traders' evolution mechanism of personal learning.

articleTitle: Modeling the value creation through business models: Cases study of Estee Lauder and L'Oreal
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Business models are widely referred as the `logic of the firm' - how it operates and creates value for its stakeholders. The paper, based on the CR Framework of business models, identifies the components of business models and models the value creation relationship among them by demonstrating business models of two world famous cosmetics companies. The results of the empirical analysis exhibit fully the good applicability of CR Framework for characterizing the logic of the firm.

articleTitle: The study of Color and sound conversion based on perceptual characteristic
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With the development of computer technology, multimedia technology as well as digital art has demonstrated unprecedented inclusiveness and creativeness. How to make computer satisfy people's identification and feedback characteristic in a better way has become an issue that is in desperately need of solution as well as development orientation in the future.

articleTitle: Effect of management safety enforcement on safety performance
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on safety climate and system theory, system dynamics models of production and compliance behavior were built. The effect of several safety management methods and policies were simulated and analyzed with different amount of work production assignment. The artificial result showed that management safety enforcement was less efficiency to compliance behavior when the task assignment changed randomly than which increased regularly. Other safety management strategies should been taken for complementary to make organization safety.

articleTitle: Technology innovation problems research in chain link of Commercial Aircraft Corporation of China
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Commercial Aircraft Corporation of China as the subject of our country that carry out medium-large airliner of Large plane major projects should promote international competitiveness though Independent innovation. And as an Aircraft manufacturing enterprise, its technology innovation in chain mainly reflect in technology chain. So which mode to choose in independent innovation is a very important decision since deferent kinds of production-study-research cooperation mode in deferent link dominate differently according to the role which controls dominant power. In recent years, many disputes in the course of research cooperation make a direct impact on the effect of production-study-research cooperation. This paper proposed the idea which mode should choose in industry chain and several promotion strategies to the company in its process of production-study-research cooperation.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the coal industrial safety: Based on the data envelopment analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Coal industrial safety is important for the coal industry to develop healthily. In this paper the Data Envelopment Analysis model is applied to evaluate the coal industrial safety in China. The evaluation result shows the coal industry is basic safe at the present time and in the near future. The coal industry can develop more safely by improving the competitiveness, gaining the scale benefit and applying advanced technology.

articleTitle: Economic lot scheduling problem with allowable shortage: A multi-objective approach
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Economic lot scheduling problem (ELSP) in a multi-objective approach is surveyed in this study regarding deteriorating items and allowable shortage using extended basic period (EBP) approach under Power-of-Two (PoT) policy. The goal of this research is minimizing number of items stock out throughout each period and cost of such schedule, i.e. setup cost and holding cost including deteriorating factor. Two multi-objective algorithms, i.e., non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm (NSGAII) and non-dominated ranking genetic algorithms (NRGA) is employed to approach this goal. Computational experiments demonstrate that these meta-heuristic multi-objective algorithms can solve such a problem with satisfactory results.

articleTitle: A novel IS/IT outsourcing service vendor selection method based on fuzzy axiomatic design
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to find the appropriate IS/IT outsourcing service vendor, this paper researches the evaluation and selection problem in outsourcing service. The purpose of this study is to investigate a fuzzy multiple criteria decision-making method for evaluating and selecting outsourcing service vendor. The IS/IT outsourcing service vendor selection procedure and related criteria are presented. Then, a novel fuzzy method based on axiomatic design (AD) and fuzzy axiomatic design (FAD) is proposed. The linguistic evaluation information given by the decision makers are transformed into the form of triangular fuzzy numbers. Based on the fuzzy axiomatic design, the information content can be obtained. The evaluation results of the IS/IT outsourcing service vendors can be obtained through the proposed fuzzy method based on the FAD. Finally, an illustrating example is given to show the feasibility and practicability of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: The distribution mode analysis and optimization modeling of regional Fast Moving Consumer Goods
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Aiming at the current situation of long delivery cycle time, blind disorder distribution in the supply chain distribution patterns of the single species regional Fast Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG), and a secondary distribution model is constructed through analyze the logistics, information flow and other constraints of the distribution pattern. In this model, the distribution center location is based on the minimizing the total cost of distribution, and select the best distribution centers and the optimal allocation relationship between distribution centers and retailers in the provided area. On this basis, use the GA toolbox in the MATLAB to encode and solve. Finally, an example proves this model is correctly and effectively through the estimation of the total costs which is obtained from the optimal scheme.

articleTitle: Analysis on regiment maintaining factory maintenance support capability under battlefield conditions
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: As a certain battle for example, regard the regiment maintaining factory maintenance support task as a hypothetical cause, and according to the rule that the index of maintenance support capacity required under battlefield conditions which changes with time and the relation between the supply and demand of maintenance support capability provided by regiment maintaining factory, analyze the rule of regiment maintaining factory maintenance support capability under battlefield conditions. Based on the definition of some parameters and the devising of reasonable hypothesis, establish a model which can parse the regiment maintaining factory maintenance support capability under battlefield conditions, moreover, analyze and solve this model. Finally, propose two methods to improve regiment maintaining factory maintenance support capability by means of quantitative and qualitative analysis.

articleTitle: CAPP systems in China_ Issues and solutions
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The paper gives an account of the functions of CAPP systems, pointing out their merits and shortcomings. The main problems of the conventional CAPP systems are biased to product process technology design against the amassing, analyzing and management of relevant know-how about product manufacturing. In the opinion of the authors, ideal CAPP systems should integrate process technology innovation, design, optimizing and management so as to provide enterprises abundant technology resources. Then they will greatly benefit the continued development of enterprises.

articleTitle: Method and model on site selection of aviation spare distribution center of military aircraft
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Aviation spare support is the main part of materiel support work and has direct influence on the completion of campaigning and training mission. The paper deeply studies the method and model on site selection of aviation spare distribution center of military aircraft and explores its new method and means. This has significant meaning on the scientific site selection of distribution center and improving the effectiveness of aviation spare support work. According to the features of aviation spare support, the paper takes the factors of mission succeed rate, economic and damage degree of roadway in wartime into consideration, puts forward the method on site selection of aviation spare distribution center of military aircraft and builds the model of site selection. The paper verifies the scientificity and validity of the model by a specified example.

articleTitle: Machine reliability system based on diagnosis and prediction
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The current trend demonstrates expense in the mechanical engineering aspect the growth important machine tools life cycle. Because the main customer more and more concentrates in the machine tools reliability and the cost, Even usually supplies the engine bed the small and medium-sized enterprise to need to give more attentions to their product life. Considering these requirements, The manufacturers may set their current service activities and improving their long-term customer retention. The goal of the research project is a machine tool diagnosis and prognosis of system development. That will help to maintain the improvement activities.

articleTitle: Parameter analysis of hot plate in lithography process based on regression orthogonal experiment design
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In lithography process, wafers need to be baked on the hot plate. There are very high requirement to the temperature uniformity of hot plate surface. To the problem of choosing design parameters, the orthogonal experimental design method was used, the simulation software ANSYS was applied, the design parameters on the various conditions were analyzed, Then a regression model was obtained based these simulation data. It is consistent between the result of regression model and the result of simulation. The regression model indicates a better choice direction of the design parameters of hot plate.

articleTitle: The applications of ergonomics in the design of dimension series
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In the design of the product, not only the performance and structure of products but also the dimension series should be designed. In this paper, we discussed and analyzed the problems in the design of dimension series. According to the principle of Ergonomics, we put forward a design method of the dimension series based on the measurement of human body sizes. And the design methods of types and size of the product were discussed. Finally, we improved the structure of products series for a enterprise using our method. Taken as a example, the process of calculation was described in detail.

articleTitle: Systematical Analysis of the Mechanism of the large-scale construction industry core competitiveness
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: On the basis of the research of the large-scale construction industry core competitiveness, we have reviewed the competitiveness classic analysis new industry competitiveness frame was made. On this basis, summed up the large-scale construction industrial competitiveness impact factors and measurement indicators systematical, set up a large-scale construction industrial competitiveness formation mechanism model; using structural equation model to Empirical analysis large-scale construction industry empirical data. The results showed that the direct impact to the local large-scale construction industry competitiveness from regional environment, factors of production, industrial organization three latent variables. Finally, we made the analysis and research prospects.

articleTitle: A learning-based framework for manufacturing system design
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Existing literature suggest that learning occur at three levels: individual, team and organizational. Although there have been theoretical models at all three levels, the research efforts to integrate them are limited. This paper proposes a learning-based framework that integrates previous learning theories at different levels. The framework was then used to explain how to overcome learning barriers in various aspects of modern manufacturing system design.

articleTitle: The effects of service quality and customer satisfaction on customer loyalty in steel company services
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Steel industry is an important enterprise in Taiwan. Owing to the keen competition, how to maintaining old customers becomes a crucial issue which the industrials need to confront with. Many research works in service industry found a relationship between profit attainments and the concepts of service quality, customer satisfaction and customer loyalty. However, there was seldom studies conduct to steel industry. The purpose of this study was exploring the casual relationships between service quality, customer satisfaction and customer loyalty in steel industry services. A total of 218 subjects were voluntarily participated this research. Questionnaire was used for Data collection. LISREL method was used for causal relationship model testing. The LISREL model verification results showed that the χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> was 109.46 (df = 57) and the overall goodness-of-fit indices (GFI) was 0.930, which indicated an empirical good fit with the model. The analyses show that the service quality, and customer satisfaction of steel industry service has a direct relation with customer loyalty, and the service quality could has an indirect effect on customer loyalty through customer satisfaction. This finding would be a reference for management in the steel industry.

articleTitle: Game playing analysis of the government and the media for food safety emergencies response
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: China is in the economy transition and social transformation period. At this phase, food safety incidents emerge in endlessly, causing more and more consumers complaints, so the government increases management on food safety emergencies, and the media focuses on food safety emergencies. This paper mainly discusses food safety incidents from their transmission. Firstly, it analyzes the role of the government and the media in food safety emergencies; Secondly it uses Game Theory, Supply and Demand curves to indicate that the government should moderately supervision the media, meanwhile, the media should guarantee reports authenticity in food safety incidents. Finally, it Proposes strategies on improving the relationship between the government and the media on food safety emergencies.

articleTitle: A study of influential factors of real estate prices in Xi'an
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Taking nine districts and four counties of Xi'an as the research objects, with the empirical study, this paper studies the influences of real estate prices in Xi'an. On the basis of referencing many previous research results, selecting the important indexes influencing the development of real estate market, processing the data with factor analysis, and on the basis of factor scores, analyzing the important influences of real estate prices in districts and counties of Xi'an, this paper puts forward countermeasures and Suggestions to stabilize the real estate prices at last.

articleTitle: Identification, judicial review and application of blasting seismic safety
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The disputes about blasting seismic safety are always dissolved with the help of judicial identification. Identification is a kind of technical judgment made by the judicial appraiser through adopting scientific technology or professional knowledge to identify the truth. The identification suggestions can be adopted and trusted in judicial activities only after they have passed the judicial check. After that, they can show the probative force as evidences. It is proposed by taking a practical case that identification suggestions should be reviewed by rules-important facts in entity, such as qualification of the appraiser, execution of rules for the identification procedures, obedience to the identification basis etc, and important procedures such as the conformity of the examination on the evidence. The basic features of the judicial identification are reflected by the regular reviews. Besides, importance must be attached to the scientific review on the identification suggestions. The essential attributes of the judicial identification can be reflected by the scientific review, thereby, manifesting the value and meaning of judicial identification.

articleTitle: Research on EPCM project procurement risk based on TOPSIS and RBF method
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Procurement is a core link under the EPCM model. Identifying and analyzing procurement risk is of significance to make sensible procurement decision. This paper analyzes the procurement risk under the EPCM model at first. According to the above, the writer proposed a procurement risk assessment model based on TOPSIS and RBF method, and connected with the engineering examples, made empirical analysis based on a certain amount of project procurement statistics data. The whole research shows that the new method leads to a more efficient and exact assessment for the procurement risk under the EPCM model, and meanwhile, it could provide strong support structure for the implementation of integrated procurement risk management and the establishment of financial risk early warning mechanism.

articleTitle: Research on assembly line balancing based on labor proficiency
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Difference of assembly time, which dues to varied labor proficiency, has impact on efficiency of assembly line balancing. Two different working teams may even result in imbalance of assembly line. On account of this problem, this paper took axle assembly line of an axle assembly plant for example, conducted proficiency tests of the two working teams and calculated the assembly time of each worker on every station on the basis of regular assembly line balancing, followed by overall optimization using genetic algorithm which makes productivity of the two working teams more balanced, so as to can achieve the optimization of assembly lines.

articleTitle: Due-date assignment and single-machine resource allocation scheduling with deteriorating jobs
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper investigated due-date assignment and single-machine resource allocation scheduling problems with position-dependent deteriorating jobs. Two generally resource consumption functions, the linear resource consumption function and the convex resource consumption function, were explored. The objectives were to determining the optimal due-date, the optimal resource allocation, and the optimal job sequence so that the cost function associated with the job's due-date and the processing time reduction as well as job absolute value in lateness will be minimized. We showed that the proposed problems are polynomial time solvable.

articleTitle: The equipment maintenance materials supply chain integration
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The equipment maintenance materials (EMM) supply chain is a kind of service supply chain(SSC) The EMM supply chain has its own inherent characteristics. The EMM supply chain should be integrated according to these characteristics. The integration content is provided from four aspects of information integration, process integration, organization integration and supplier relationship management. The aim of precise EMM support will be achieved through the information integration, logistics integration and organization synchronizing operation.

articleTitle: Operating efficiency evaluation of urban logistics enterprises based on the Data envelopment analysis model
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to evaluate operating efficiency of urban logistics enterprises, Data envelopment analysis (DEA) model is established. This model calculates overall efficiency, technical efficiency, scale efficiency and scale benefit of four logistics enterprise respectively. Then some feasible measures are given to nonDEA effective enterprises to make them be DEA effective. While the relationship between operating efficiency and resource allocation efficiency is analyzed, this paper also gives some advices about logistics industry development that are referred to the decision department of enterprises.

articleTitle: Pricing and revenue management in communication networks
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Pricing plays an important role for the design, operation, and management of communication networks. The goal is to achieve a good network performance by allocating the scarce resource to fulfill different users' qualities of services while keeping in mind the incentives of different network entities. Network pricing is a cross-disciplinary research area and requires deep understanding of both networking technology and microeconomics. We provide a survey for recent results, trends and developments in this research area.

articleTitle: Failure mode analysis of NC Turret based on random fuzzy method
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Using the randomness and fuzziness theory to analyze the typical failure mode in NC Turret, it builds the occurrence chance model under the condition of randomness and fuzziness. Based on the results of comparatively analyzing the occurrence chances and occurrence frequencies, we could grasp the overall failure occurrence of NC turret in this model, finding out the failure mode influencing the NC Turret reliability the most. The conclusions can provide useful basis for further improving the reliability of NC Turret.

articleTitle: Current situation and suggestions of public bicycle project management in Hangzhou
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Hangzhou public bicycle project, as the largest public bicycle project in the world so far, though has received some good comments since its operating, is doubtful among many citizens. This thesis analyses the current situation of project management in the following four aspects: market management, operation management, human re- source management and economic management. Afterwards, the thesis argues the problem that exists in the project management, and gives some suggestions on outsourcing renting sites, the extension projects and rising rental deposit.

articleTitle: Research on the evaluation of enterprise knowledge integration capability based on Fussy-GRNN
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Knowledge integration is an important research topic in the field of Knowledge management. Knowledge integration can help improve the level of knowledge management, enhance the capability of knowledge innovation and the capability of technological innovation, and form the core advantages. Therefore, how to evaluate the enterprises' capability of knowledge integration becomes an important issue for enterprises. This thesis builds an evaluation index system of enterprises' capability of knowledge integration, and proposes the evaluation model of enterprise knowledge integration capability based on Fussy-GRNN. And this paper conducts an empirical research. The method overcomes some deficiencies of the existing methods, and has some significance for the evaluation of enterprise knowledge integration capability.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation method of remaining useful life prediction based on pseudo life
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on analyzing existing metrics for prediction performance evaluation, features and defects of these metrics are summarized. A new performance evaluation method of remaining useful life (RUL) prediction is proposed, which can be used before the end-of-life of a product. The evaluation principle of this method is described in detail. A new evaluation metric named fluctuation coefficient of pseudo life is also proposed on the basis of related definitions. This new metric can be used in integrated evaluation for a prediction system. The detailed evaluation flow of this method is given. Finally, a case of RUL prediction for aircraft battery is given, and quantitative performance evaluation of RUL prediction is made by calculating this evaluation metric. The evaluation results show this new method is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: How to promote knowledge flowing in regional innovation network effectively?
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The regional innovation network is the carrier of the regional innovation system. The efficiency of knowledge flowing in the network decides the quality of the regional innovation network, and is the origin of the regional competitive advantage. According to the different characteristic of vary types of knowledge, this article proposed some target-oriented advice to promote the knowledge effective flowing in the regional innovation network, in order to realize that the knowledge can be renown unceasingly and keep positive cycle in the regional innovation network.

articleTitle: The development and state and countermeasures study of modern service industry in Guiyang City
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Guiyang, a central city of southwest China, must accelerate the development of modern service industry and put it in a more prominent position. Guiyang is facing the 12th five-year plan before the opportunity of the comprehensive reformation, which should rely on the unique climate and geographical advantages to enhance the level of development and competitiveness of services. At the same time, breaking the old service system, improving the comprehensive service system for tourism, building logistics hubs in the city, constructing the service centers which cover the surrounding areas, developing the modern service industry personnel and constructing the open services. To analyze the modern service industry in Guiyang, with the help of the 12<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> five-year plan of Guizhou Province, we have proposed three strategies for the development and acceleration of modern service industry in Guiyang.

articleTitle: On relation between Work Study and safe-efficient coal mine
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Under the new situation of coal mine safety developing and coal production increasing rapidly, the author analyzed coal mines safety status, coal mine human error and underground production operations problems, clarified that the meaning of Work Study is in accordance with the connotation of safe-efficient coal mine construction in China, and defined the connotation between safe-efficient Coal mine and work study, pointed out that using Work Study method can achieve the purpose of optimizing mine work procedures, methods of operation and operational actions, improving worker productivity, reducing the exposure time of risk in the work space and fatigue, and at last achieving safe-efficient coal mine production goals.

articleTitle: Co-integration analysis between performance of business incubator and incubation fund
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on the data of business incubator's performance and incubation fund, the dynamic interactions are studied between performance of business incubator and incubation fund through co-integration test. The results indicates that long time dynamic co-integration relationship exists between graduated tenants and incubation fund and in the short term the change of incubation fund has a strong impact on the number of graduated tenants. The paper also finds that there is no long-term co-integration relationship between the total income of tenants and incubation fund.

articleTitle: Study of indirect benefits of RFID deployment: The case of the chemical substances supply chain in the European Union
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In this paper we are interested in RFID deployment in supply chains. We start by studying the exploitation of these technologies to improve specific logistic missions and from a global manner we present the enhancement of supply chain management relying on these technologies. We propose to study a supply chain of chemical substances in the European Union. Then, according to the REACH regulation, companies that manipulate chemicals must develop reliable risk management policies. To comply with these requirements, the deployment of RFID provides indirect benefits such as traceability and real time inventory of goods along the supply chain. Though the potential benefits of these technologies, it is important to study the cost of the RFID integration in the supply chain.

articleTitle: Coordination management of resource network planning method and application
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: For resource coordination and management of large construction machinery in engineering projects, the revised dual node network was used to program the distribution and use of large machinery, and to design the distribution process of network planning. On the basis of rational multitasking allocation with network planning method, the target procedure was tracked and controlled to reach the goal of dynamically dispatching management of large machinery. Also, the coordination method of large machinery between multi-projects was explored. Example was given to show the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Research on time-frequency characteristic of transmission quality problem diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to assure the gearbox quality, it is a key step for most transmissions manufacturers to do the quality detection on the end of assembly line (QDEAL). Aiming at the most universal problem in the course of QDEAL-Knock, and the generating mechanism is analyzed; a detecting method which combines wavelet transform with traditional time domain and frequency domain analysis is developed; and the time-frequency characteristic which can denote transmission's knock problem is advanced. Finally, there is an experiment to examine the detecting effects of this method. The experimental results show that the time-domain information and scale-frequency characteristic, we can intuitively detect the generation of knock problem and confirm the location of knock based on the method developed in this paper.

articleTitle: Empirical research on operational efficiency of the logistics enterprises based on DEA
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on the relevant studies from both home and abroad, this paper takes the operational efficiency of logistics enterprises as the core concern of the research model. All the research samples are drawn from China's listed logistics enterprises. After analyzed relevant data in different perspectives, this paper finally chooses the approach of Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) to build the model. Based on the results of this model, problems in a given logistics enterprise can be easily identified. In particular, through quantitative study, an enterprise could get a clear and accurate picture of the gap between itself and other ones in the same field, and thus facilitate further improvement of operation efficiency.

articleTitle: The research of coordination between open-pit mining and railway transportation based on coupling theories
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: On the basic of the analysis of the situation of the railway transportation and the keys of the open-pit mining management- producing and outward transportation, choose the key parameters and improved efficacy coefficient method to make quantitative process and analyze the coordination degree between them with the coupling theories. The main contents of the research contain the choice of the system parameters and the standardization of different parameters, and introduce the capacitive coupling theory to make the quantitative analysis of the coordination degree of the system and influence of subsystem and parameters on the system. Moreover, reflect the current production capacity through the test model, the model is confirmed which can be used with reality and the strategies of the enterprise are given.

articleTitle: Information description solution at coordinating level based on grid system and ebXML standards
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Collaborative manufacturing can shorten the cycle of product development and production. Based on grid system and ebXML standards, this paper puts forward the information description solution at coordinating level to provide a unified framework for cooperators to share and exchange information.

articleTitle: Empirical study on relationship between board structure and firm's intellectual capital performance
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The main purpose of this paper is to investigate the relationship between board structure and firm's intellectual capital performance. Data consists of 73 firms are drawn from IT industry. Empirical analysis is conducted with a linear multiple regression model. Findings from empirical analysis indicate that relationship between board structure and firm's intellectual capital performance isn't statistically significant. Accordingly, we analyze the factors that probably affect the findings.

articleTitle: The optimal ordering strategy under the GBA in more than three retailers
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: GBA(Group-Buying Auction) is coming to be an important part of online auction. Most of the previous studies about retailers' ordering strategy were in two retailers, and the current conclusion is that the retailers will buy more products in the GBA mechanism than in the fixed-price mechanism in the case of two retailers. As long as the threshold is not too high, the profit and the service level of the retailers can be improved. This paper studies the optimal ordering strategy based on GBA in more than three retailers, and the previous conclusion still tenable in this case.

articleTitle: Innovative resources within industrial clusters: How they are agglomerated and diffused
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper reviews the definition of innovative enterprises, innovative clusters and innovation resources. Then it develops four mechanisms about the impact of innovative enterprises to innovative clusters on the agglomeration of innovative resources. It also analyzes four pathways for innovative enterprises to affect the diffusion of innovative resources. Finally, it proposes three policy recommendations to help to foster the development of innovative clusters.

articleTitle: Prediction of financial time series based on information granulation
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The prediction of financial time series produced by the stock market has been the research focus of scholars. However, we can not accurately predict the fluctuations in the future in most cases. In this paper, we try to apply information granulation in the prediction of financial time series. First, we fuzzy grain the financial time series. Then, we use RBF neural network which has good ability of nonlinear mapping to predict future trend of fluctuations and fluctuating range. Simulation result shows that this method can accurately predict the trend of fluctuations and the fluctuating range, which can provide reliable reference for the decision makers of investment.

articleTitle: Discussing the model of the industrial symbiosis networks
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper defines the industrial symbiosis (IS) networks, points the factors that influence the development of IS networks in Industrial Parks, and discusses the mold that the networks can exist. Finally, the paper emphasizes that the factors should be coordination in industrial parks so as to make such networks stabilization and development step by step.

articleTitle: Study on visual search strategy for three-target search task
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Visual search tasks are widely used in various industries and they have been studied extensively and theoretically in the area of human factors. An experiment was conducted here to investigate the visual search strategy for a search task of three targets with identical difficulty. Thirty students participated in this experiment whose ages ranged from 21 to 27 (16male, 14 female). The results obtained revealed that participants tended to use random search strategy in this experiment. The regression models pertaining to the relationship between cumulative detection probability and search time for three targets were also given in the paper.

articleTitle: Effects of organizational culture on psychology of employee commitment
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Organizational culture strongly affects the organizational commitment of employees. Healthy organizational culture and environment bounds the employees to that organization which also results in decrease in turnover. Psychology plays a vital role in employee's commitment to the organization. There are many factors of organizational culture which are having direct relation with the employee's commitment. In this research three factors; participative environment, diversity and flexibility are studied with their impact on organization culture. Study carried on sample of 210 employees working in four different organizations. Results of the present study show that participative environment has maximum impact and flexibility is the least influencing factor of the organizational culture.

articleTitle: Shenyang demand forecasting for housing based on GM (1,1) model
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Demand for housing refers to affordable demand for housing for a given period of time in particular areas. Sales area of housing can be regarded as demand for housing in this article. Based on the historical data and current condition, the article focuses on the establishment of GM (1, 1) forecasting model, which can be exerted to make short-term forecast for housing demand in Shenyang from 2011 to 2015. After error inspecting of forecasting model, the obtained results has reached level 1 accuracy. Besides, the forecasting results can provide data support and theoretical basis for government, developers and buyers in regulating housing market, verifying development scale and purchase of housing.

articleTitle: The model for the optimal procurement in steel slitting and distributing centers
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Decreasing the purchasing cost can be an efficient way to gain higher profit in steel slitting and distributing centers. With customer's orders becoming smaller and smaller and the restrictions of production, purchasing plan has become more and more complicated. This paper focuses on making a purchasing model considering the restriction and the minimal purchasing amount of coils. The results will be valuable for the lean procurement management of the center. This study is adverse to the two dimensional cutting stock problem.

articleTitle: Research on promotion strategies and approaches of core competence for construction enterprises based on delta model
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper analyzes the evolution of strategic management analysis model and puts forward core competitiveness strategy in construction enterprises is comprehensive system that includes three connotations: best product, total customer solution, system lock-in. The strategy combinations and approaches of core competitiveness are proposed in this paper based on delta model finally.

articleTitle: Research on technical preparation process optimization of complicated military equipment
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to simplify operation sequence and shorten preparation time of current technical preparation for complicated military equipment, optimal preparation process was studied based on P.E.R.T theory and Optimized Process Model. The results show that equipment maintenance efficiency and technical preparation capability of maintenance unit can be improved according to the optimal preparation process.

articleTitle: The study in Economic Feasibility for OTOP's Distributed Location of Chonburi Province in Thailand
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: One Tambon One Product (OTOP) is specialized products of each sub-district (Tambon) that promote their own culture through the maintenance and development of indigenous skills and raw materials. OTOP products can be foods or handicrafts. This research aims to propose a suitable location for OTOP's distribution center of Chonburi province with economic viewpoint. Geographic Information System (GIS) and Analytical Hierarchy Process (AHP) are major tools used for location analysis. Five key factors (transportation, tourism, manufacturing, public utility, and land use) are considered in this study for representative of stakeholders' need. From the analysis, Pattaya is selected with the highest score 34.9882%.

articleTitle: Empirical analysis of location choice of foreign direct investment
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Japanese FDI in food has increased very rapidly in East Asia after the Plaza Accord in 1985. This paper tries to analyze an empirical study of the factors that influence the location choices of Japanese food foreign direct investment in East Asian countries. We found that wage rate, infrastructure, openness, market size and raw materials index are the determinant factors in deciding the location choice of Japanese food investments in East Asia.

articleTitle: The lightweight design of the inner framework of the opto-electronic stabilization platform based on finite element analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The airborne opto-electronic stabilization platform should have the characteristics of high requirements for stability, tracking accuracy and lightweight. In order to verify the rationality of the main load-bearing structure, the inner-gimbal, finite element analysis was performed. Because of the poor working conditions of the airborne opto-electronic stabilization platform and the wide range of working temperature variation, -45 °C ~ 60 °C, according to the actual working environment, air-resistance and temperature were added to the loads of the inner-gimbal in analysis. What's more, based on the analysis results, lightweight design was performed to the initial model and 64.37% of mass was decreased. The remarkable effect was obtained. This research is going to be instructive to design and production of the airborne opto-electronic stabilization platform in the future.

articleTitle: Accounting analysis on activity cost in logistic enterprise
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Activity-Based Cost is widely used in enterprises in the United States, Japan and European Union. It is essentially different from traditional methods in perspective and approach. Indirect cost accounts for a comparatively higher percentage in logistic enterprise's total cost, whose greatest feature is that it is without inventory cost. This article considers the characteristics of cost structure for logistic enterprise and derives a practical logistic enterprise activity cost accounting model from basic activity cost model. It also presents a case study in which makes simulation calculation of existing logistic enterprises' product cost.

articleTitle: Application of activity-based costing quality cost accounting research
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Chinese current domestic quality cost management is still in the initial stage, having a lot of problems in theory and application. This paper analyses the feasibility of the activity-based costing method in quality cost management, taking a large foundries in domestic for an example, applying activity-based costing for accounting quality cost, providing accurate cost information and data basis for quality improvement work.

articleTitle: Research on entropy production of maintenance support system based on maintenance task analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on the situations of support resources occupied or consumed in support activity, driven by support activities, integrating the material maintenance task analysis (MTA) outcomes, the changes of the resources in support activity can be analyzed, simultaneously the calculation and distribution of the entropy production of service- and consumable-resources can be separately given. In this paper, a new support activity -based method for describing the states of the support system and statistical characteristics of the entropy production of the support system are treated as new indexes for evaluating support systems. Utilizing engineering cases of MTA, this paper analyzes the actual significance of indexes above, as well as validates their feasibility and effectiveness. Therefore, this paper can provide development departments with effective theoretic and technical supports to design and determine support concepts.

articleTitle: Application of grey relational analysis in cognitive ability evaluation of operator
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: It was proposed that grey relational analysis method was adopted to comprehensively evaluate the cognitive ability of the operator aiming at the condition that human cognition ability has characteristics of multi-factor, incomplete information and the like, and example analysis was carried out. Firstly, comparison sequence and reference sequence were established according to the influence factor level value of the evaluation object, the correlation coefficient between the influence factor and the optimal index of the evaluation object was calculated, the weight of the evaluation index was combined in order to calculate the correlation degree, and all evaluation objects were sequenced according to the correlation degree. The results show that the method is flexible and accurate with strong maneuverability.

articleTitle: Application of Manikin to the light truck cab design in the Southwest Area of China
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Little attention is given to the regional human diversities and data verification in the light truck cab design and verification applying Manikin. In this paper the relevant theories and methods of Ergonomics and somatic data in GB10000-88 were adopted, combined with the light truck of an automobile company in the Southwest Area of China. First, the somatic data in the southwest area were studied taking the influence of wearing shoes into account. Then, southwest three-dimensional manikin in the UG / KF platform using somatic data was established, and thus put the manikin into a light truck cab for cab design and verification. Besides, the model of regional manikin is provided considering that the manikin could be adapted to the regional workspace design.

articleTitle: The analysis of musculoskeletal disorder in workers in the food and baking industry
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The food and baking industry is part of the national livelihood. In recent years, the introduction of a large number of automated machinery, operators maintained unnatural posture in high repetitive work over a prolonged period of time. Along with material handling, it caused excessive use of certain parts of the body and led to the increase of discomfort in the musculoskeletal system. The productivity would hence be affected. The purpose of this study is to increase productivity by improving the symptoms of musculoskeletal disorder in middle-aged workers in the food and baking industry through the investigation of human factors engineering. The study was divided into: (1) The evaluation of human factors engineering and organizational development; (2) The assessment of ergonomics risk factors; (3) Ergonomics hazard prevention and control. Designing the manufacturing process in the understanding of risk factors on the production line, the musculoskeletal symptoms among workers could improve work efficiency hence increase productivity.

articleTitle: Evaluation on the governance efficiency in public hospital
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: China vigorously promotes the reform of the public hospital's management system which regards corporate governance as the core in recent years. However, the current situation of corporate governance in public hospitals remains optimistic. The paper defines the corporate governance of public hospitals and the management efficiency firstly. And the evaluation index system for corporate governance of public hospitals is established based on series of factors, such as the emphasis and the desired effect of implementing corporate governance, etc. And then, the evaluation model is set up using DEA (data envelopment analysis) method, and the case stays also implemented based on the evaluation model. The study puts forward a new perspective of evaluating the efficiency of corporate governance in public hospitals.

articleTitle: Study on government regulation of construction enterprises based on evolutionary game theory
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In this paper, we focus on the need for the regulation of construction enterprises. We study the work of government regulation in China by means of the evolutionary stable strategy, which is the core of evolutionary game theory. Studies show that: there is one evolutionary game solution between the government and construction enterprises. This paper provides a theoretical basis to government so that it can regulate construction enterprises better and more effectively.

articleTitle: Robust solution of bilevel programming under box disturbance and its application in product design
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In this paper, in the light of the bilevel feature in product design, bilevel programming (BLP) with Box disturbance coefficients is proposed, and the robust solution is developed to solve the problem. Meanwhile, a numerical example is showed to elucidate the present method. In addition, according to the complex environment of product design, the approach is extended to the nonlinear BLP.

articleTitle: Unconditioned reflex Demand of instant drinks consumption
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: We know that Demand cannot be created. Usually Marketing Skills focus on discovery/awareness/recall of consumer's demand. Unconditioned reflex behaviors are those driven by natural factors, not referring to those man-made training process/advertising/coupon/price cut/display etc. How to measure this kind of segment market size? This topic is helpful for target design, sales value forcast, supply chain management, ROI research and contributes to avoiding bullwhips effect. The authors try to find instant drink demand model to discover the trend of value due to temperature changing on scanner data of VCS chain store.

articleTitle: Study on survival analysis method for equipment life and its application
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Theory and methods about survival analysis are studied. The usage hazards model is used to determine the reasonable storage of some important equipment. It provides a kind of useful guidance for other equipments' scientific management. It is very important and significant for reasonably decreasing the amount of equipment's ordering and storing with effective supplying.

articleTitle: Analysis of the cost variance with moving weighted average method in logistics
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Through a systematic study of bulk cargo inventory process, the article discovers the change law of bulk cargo inventory cost with the moving weighted average method, analyses the primary causes of financial variance from the view of planned cost, and then proposes a solution to the question of how to analyze and control financial variance.

articleTitle: Application study of cost control in the power supply enterprise
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In the fierce competition in the market environment, cost control is become for each enterprise focus problem. Cost control needs to establish scientific cost analysis and control systems, to let the managers comprehensively understanding company exterior cost level and influencing the company performance of each link, clearly understanding company earnings situation, thus grasping accurate decision-making direction, truly realizing effective cost control. In this paper, the basic principle of benchmarking was introduced. It was explained that the concept, applied steps, and application of the matters needing attention of benchmarking. The principle and method of the enterprise cost control were summarized. It was explained that the concept and procedures, target and the method of cost control. The principle and application situation of the activity-based costing method were discussed. It was principally explored benchmarking application of cost control in a power supply company. The Toyota and Wal-Mart were selected they were the two internationally famous enterprise cost control template. On the basis of comparison and analysis, this paper analyzes the strategies of cost control of the first-class enterprise in the purchase cost, operation cost, and human resource cost of. In combination with the actual situation of a power supply company, and some views of improve enterprise cost control effectiveness are given. The power supply company cost control implementation process model is design. The tenets were expounded of application activity-based costing in a power supply company. The types of operation were divided cost control of the power supply company. Through example of quantitative analysis of the power supply company sales operations cost, the feasibility and effectiveness of the cost control were shows in the power supply company,. According to the specific circumstances of a power supply company, cost control measures have was formulated. This paper thinks that, in order to make power company the relevant costs can “controllable, in control, can control”, should be accomplished “full staff, complete process, comprehensive” cost control. The key of a power supply company cost control is project cost control; the second is the control of the production cost and capital cost.

articleTitle: Comprehensive evaluation method of doctoral dissertation's quality
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: How to improve doctors' quality has been becoming an important task of graduate students' education and degree in China. Meanwhile, the quality of graduate students is embodied by the dissertation. Evaluating doctoral dissertation scientifically and objectively helps to evaluate the quality of doctors correctly. In the paper the fuzzy math model is introduced in order to evaluate graduate students' dissertation comprehensively. The method evaluates doctoral dissertation objectively and scientifically in order to improve the quality of graduate students' dissertation in colleges of China.

articleTitle: Hybrid evolutionary multi-objective approaches to process planning global optimization for complex parts
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Computer-aided process planning (CAPP) is an important bridge between computer-aided design (CAD) and computer-aided manufacturing (CAM) in the computer integrated manufacturing (CIM) environment. Considering the characteristics of multiple constraints, multi-factor, multi-objective and highly nonlinear for process planning, in this paper, a strategy of “decomposition- refinement-integrated” is applied to process planning optimization globally by dividing the process into multiple levels and planning collaboratively between levels, so the combinations of localization and global, serialization and parallel are achieved. The hybrid approach is proposed to incorporate the evolutionary algorithms, multi-objective optimization for process planning and can be able to obtain several satisfactory process plans through specially designed genetic operators and collaborative mechanism. The technique was implemented and the validity of the approach was demonstrated in a case study.

articleTitle: Research of management and building of low-carbon industrial parks
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper firstly introduces the characteristics of low-carbon industrial parks and further analyzes the development status of china's industrial parks. Then, it mainly refers to work idea of low-carbon industrial parks in such aspects as general idea, main objective and working principles. On the basis, it points out the methods of mangement and building of low-carbon industrial parks The establishment of the low-carbon parks not only improves the environment remarkably, but also provides a new pattern for implementing energy conservation and emission reduction.

articleTitle: The analysis of comprehensive income indication present in income statement
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The Financial Management Department made new demands on the income statement of the presentation of format in the <;Enterprise Accounting Standards 3rd Explanation>; issued in June 2009. It requires adding comprehensive income indication in income statement, including two items “other comprehensive income” and “comprehensive income amount”.<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup> In view of this, this paper carries on the preliminary analysis on the necessities and the defects of the problem that comprehensive income indication presented in income statement.

articleTitle: Application of soft computing for the optimal parameter design of weldment
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This research proposes an economic and effective experimental design method of multiple characteristics to deal with the parameter design problem with many continuous parameters and levels. It uses TOPSIS (Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution) and ANN (Artificial Neural Network) to train the optimal function framework of parameter design. It combines SC (Soft Computing) of SA (Simulated Anneal) and GA (Genetic Algorithm) to search the optimal parameters combination for the optimal parameter of weldment. To improve previous experimental methods for multiple characteristics, this research method employs SA to search the optimal parameter such that the potential parameter can be evaluated more completely and objectively. Additionally, the model can learn the relationship between the welding parameters and the quality responses of different materials to facilitate the future applications in the decision-making of parameter settings for automatic welding equipment. The research results can be presented to the industries as a reference, and improve the product quality and welding efficiency to relevant welding industries.

articleTitle: Simulation on order allocation within multi-suppliers of industrial cluster
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The downstream enterprises of supply chain usually order same kind of products from several suppliers within an industry cluster. Two different order allocation strategies considering production status are studied in this paper. The respective order allocation models of a manufacturer with multiple suppliers based on either the production capacity or production load equilibrium are proposed. Considering the uncertainty of demand and enterprises' production capacity, the discrete event system simulation is used to verify that the production load equilibrium-based strategy can not only guarantee the order's on-time delivery from the perspective of the available manufacturing resources, but also lead to promote the whole supplier group's operation level, so as to realize the optimization of the entire supply chain.

articleTitle: The falsification for the applicability of Bayesian causal map applying to the system decision
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This article describes the use of causal map and the Bayesian network diagram, analyzes the applicability of the two tools. The paper proposes the building of Bayesian causal map (BCM). That is the application of Bayesian network in causal map proposed by some scholars at home and abroad. This paper analyzes the applicability of the Bayesian causal map. Demonstrate the contradictions that it can not be resolved through examples. The paper concluded that the Bayesian Causal Map is not an effective tool for probability reasoning, Bayesian networks used in conjunction with the causal map is not meaningful.

articleTitle: Value disruption information management in a supply chain with myopic customers
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper studies a supply chain, in which a supplier wholesales an item to a seller, and the seller competes with a rival for myopic customers. Customers' value of the seller's product can be disrupted with a certain probability. A hybrid game is used to study this supply chain. Under some conditions, we show that the supplier's value of the disruption information increases with respect to the variance of the disruption, and the supplier's value of the disruption scale information increases with respect to the disruption probability and the variance of the disruption scale.

articleTitle: The efficiency analysis on china electric power enterprise by DEA model
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The paper aims to evaluate the efficiencies of the main electric power enterprises. First the paper discusses the difference between CCR model and BCC model. Second, The paper uses both CCR model and BCC model to do company evaluation, including the global technical efficiency and the local pure technical efficiency, so that to also evaluate the company's scale efficiency, which can give a much clear insight on the source problem of the company's low efficiency, and it can give the enterprises some suggestions. Finally, The paper also uses the bilateral model to do group analysis to have a general review of the district efficiency, which can give the China government some suggestions.

articleTitle: A research of starting control based on switch reluctant motor
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Starting control is the key problem of switch reluctant motor control. The follow-up process is as important as the starting. This paper research on this problem, using matlab to simulate the SRM model. With two phase start-up method..Analysis of the current, torque, speed and other parameters. Achieved good result and waveform. Improved system starting ability.

articleTitle: Modeling and error analysis of Time-Driven Activity-Based Costing
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: According to the fundamental principles of Time-Driven Activity-Based Costing, this paper sets up a mathematical model to solve problems on the cost of cost objects and analyzes errors occurred during the implementation process of TDABC. By taking a case, it demonstrates the applications of this model and the effects on cost account by errors. The emphasis is laid on the demonstration of data source in the model's applications.

articleTitle: DEA-based real-estate listed company core competence identity
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The comprehensive assessment is conducted for 20 real-estate listed companies with the application of data envelopment analysis (DEA) model. According to data in the reports of listed companies in 2010, this article aims at the analysis of external expression (input & output efficiency) of real-estate listed companies by setting up multi-input and multi-output indicators. On the basis of the analysis results, it easily initially assesses that what kind of core competence the chosen listed companies have. Meanwhile, the article also puts forward to some methods to optimize resource configuration and improve the performance of listed companies.

articleTitle: Magnetic assembly of nanowires
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Nanowires, an important building block in nanosystems, can now be synthesized with readily tailored composition and subsequent p.hysical properties. A skillful nanowires manipulation technique is the prerequisite for fully exploring the huge potential of the various available nanowires. Here we present a comprehensive review on the magnetic-driven assembly of NWs, especially the ferromagnetic NWs. Both merits and shortcomings of the magnetic approach are included in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on DDSS of fund portfolio management based on agent technology
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to satisfy the demand of fund portfolio management and based on the feature of balancing in the central control and distribution of decision-making, a DDSS scheme of portfolio management for multi-manager teams based on multi-Agent technology is proposed. The scheme provides an intelligence control technology for the above-mentioned balance point, and makes investment more reasonable and controllable.

articleTitle: Cuscore charts detecting spike signals in feedback control scheme
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Integration of statistical process control (SPC) and engineering process control (EPC) is found widely recognition in reducing process variability. The focus in this work is providing a method for detecting spike signals in an industrial process under the feedback control scheme using Cuscore chart. First, relevant works and the Cuscore statistic are introduced, then the appropriate Cuscore statistic that can be used to identify spike signals hidden in an integrated control scheme is derived. And finally, the effectiveness of the Cuscore statistic to detect spike signals is illustrated by simulations.

articleTitle: Special steel enterprise sales optimization research
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Facing the fierce global competition, the enterprise must take the market as the guidance, take the customer as the center, rapid response market demand. This paper established the special steel enterprises, mathematical model of order to optimize the aim of the maximization of enterprise long-term benefits, which optimizes the customers, satisfy the requirements of customers, and the key of full consideration of the enterprise, and all constraint factors in a special steel enterprise applications.

articleTitle: The relocation feasibility analysis for east operation center of Beijing
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper first introduces the situation of Beijing east operation center (EOC). With the EOC lease agreement becoming due, relocation feasibility analysis should be made. Candidate relocation site is proposed and compared with current EOC location. Through engineering analysis, current EOC location is proved to be more cost effective. Then the facility size of current EOC is evaluated considering the increasing volume year by year. It comes to conclusion that renewal of current EOC location is more financial saving and can meet the increasing market requirement.

articleTitle: Improvement on the classroom teaching method of Quality Management and Reliability
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The classroom teaching is the main battlefield that carries out education for all-round development. The reform for the classroom teaching method is the key link that raises higher education quality. This paper considered Quality Management and Reliability as an example and introduced some experience and methods of developing a student's study ability, practical ability and creative ability.

Author Keywords: the reform for the classroom teaching method

articleTitle: The planning optimization for maintenance and repairment of railway-cars in Jinan Railway Bureau
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper first analyzes a few problems deeply and thoroughly. According to the requirement for the car maintenance and repairment in the cause of the transport production in Jinan Railway Bureau, a transport programming is given out for the whole location of the car maintenance and repairment in Jinan West Car-depot with an analysis to the quantity of the car maintenance and repairment task. At the same time, we demonstrate how to set a correct decision-making in the face of new situations and new challenges, and how to optimize the production-organization and how to make a concrete reconstruction scheme in accordance with the railway development as a whole.

articleTitle: Questions that the land-use right belongs to the intangible assets
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
