abstract: As an enterprise's important property, the land-use right's ownership influences its calculation directly, thus the preparation of financial statements and the enterprise's real appraisal directly. By analyzing the difference between the land-use right and the intangible assets' characteristics and the disadvantageous aspects of the accounting calculation, it is concluded that the land-use right should be separated from the intangible assets and be taken as an independent property juxtaposed with fixed assets.

articleTitle: Study on benefit evaluation of forestry investment project in China
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Benefit evaluation method of forestry investment project is studied in this article and the evaluation is considered on the basis of classification management of forestry which is the ecological forestry and commercial forestry. Firstly, the paper analyses the characteristics and decision-making procedures of forestry investment project, and evaluates the direct benefit of forestry infrastructure investment in China. Then concerning commercial forestry investment, the paper primarily estimates on its economic benefit. In accordance with the characteristic of ecological forestry investment, the method of fuzzy comprehensive evaluation is put forward to evaluate the forestry comprehensive benefits. Finally, pointing out the shortcomings and the content for discussing further.

articleTitle: A investigation about the status of safety production management of construction projects in Henan Province
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The safety incidents not only created the huge economic loss but also caused the massive personnel's casualties, have seriously influence to society's stability and advancement. Based on investigation, this paper reveals the main factors of safety risks of construction projects, including the safety control measures are effective, but they exist in name only, have not been carried out or cannot carry out; the dangerous places have no protecting measures or caution symbols; the operators/workers have very low safety consciousness; the operators/workers violate regulations or have very low skill and specialty technical experiences; and the government and supervisory companies have insufficient inspection on site etc.

articleTitle: Integration on supply chain of technology-motivated mergers and acquisition based on the cost synergy
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Technology-motivated M&A (Mergers and acquisition) and supply chain management have been viewed as the main direction of modern business management in the 21'st century. How to realize coordination by restructuring and integrating supply chain in technology-motivated M&A is very important for improving competition and reaching the strategic goal. Through studying the effect of technology-motivated M&A on supply chain, this paper establishes the cost synergy model of supply chain, gives solution methods and offers an example that is being analyzed. Reference value of the studies is given to those enterprises which are going to practice or consider on this topic.

articleTitle: New principle on high-order aspherical machining by CNC tangent method
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In this paper, the new principle which can machine for high-order aspherical surface was described. Three feasible machining techniques, that is to say, the forming methods of the wheel spindle rotating around point Q, M, and the workpiece spindle rotation, were specifically analyzed. In addition, mathematical models were established for the three machining methods, respectively. Finally, we selected the best forming technique, i.e. the forming methods of the wheel spindle rotation around point M, according to requirement of the machining performance, accuracy and dynamic characteristics of the machine tool, and the rationality of the structure, etc.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable manufacturing unit formation technique based on three-stage method
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The article is based on a certain practical production problem of Transmission Co., Ltd. It provides the mathematical description of reconfigurable manufacturing unit formation technology and use IDEF0 for functional analysis. This paper puts forward three-stage method for building units: The first stage is building process route by improving the model of gray- equipment selection model. The second stage is building costs- equipment distribution model based on minimization of cost. The third stage is building heuristics to the balance of unit load.

articleTitle: Research on the influence of employer brand on enterprise core competence: A case study on Doosan (China) Financial Leasing Corp.
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper introduces the related concepts of employer brand and enterprise core competence and avails of theoretical analysis methods to discuss the influence of employer brand on enterprise core competence. The interview method and questionnaire method are combined to research on Doosan (China) Financial Leasing Corp.. And then summarizes its characteristics of superior employer brand and the influence of superior employer brand on enterprise core competence. Based on the theoretical analysis and the case study bringing forward the superior employer brand is of great significance to promote enterprise core competence. The final part discusses the cultivation of employer brand in the present Chinese enterprises and explores the approaches which are fit for Chinese enterprises to cultivate superior employer brand and promote their core competences.

articleTitle: Evolutionary game analysis on quality control of construction project
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to analyze the effect of different behaviors of quality control department and construction contractor on the construction project quality management model, an evolutionary game model of construction project quality management was established. In this model, the effect and position of social responsibility and fines were carefully discussed and the dynamic evolutionary procedure and stable equilibrium of construction project quality control was analyzed. The result shows that the systemic evolutionary direction is not only related to the penalties of shoddy work or cost of inspection on construction contractor as we think before, but also has much more important and profound connection with social responsibility the quality control department and construction contractor have.

articleTitle: Study of the trading behavior on agent-based system simulation
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In this paper, an artificial stock market based on Agent is built combined with system simulation technology. The heterogeneous investors will evolve and adapt to the environment through social learning in the artificial stock market. Public rule set is composed of the trading rule of each investor. And the public rule set evolves by genetic algorithm. This paper analyzes and researches the impact of social learning in the different learning speeds on financial market and micro-level investor.

articleTitle: Process control in the enterprise application of Design and Development
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In this essay, the Research and Develop Department of manufactures and the control of development process is reviewed. According to “7.3 Design and Development” provisions of ISO9000 series standard “ISO9001 quality management system”, quality management system in the process of product development in manufactures is investigated; links in the product development process guidebook are divided; and its conformity to standards is analyzed.

articleTitle: A research of the stochastic U-type assembly line balancing problem
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: U-type assembly lines, as an important part of Lean Production and Just-in-time, have been applied widely in practice. The stochastic U-type assembly line balancing problem is studied in this paper. The genetic algorithm is designed to solve this problem. Benchmark problems are tested to evaluate the performance of the presented algorithm. Furthermore, considering six kinds of complex constraints between task units, the stochastic U-type assembly line balancing problem with complex constraints is proposed and solved by modified genetic algorithm. A case from car assembly is shown to explain its application.

Author Keywords: Stochastic U-type assembly line balancing problem

articleTitle: Applying DEA AR model to evaluating leisure hotels pricing efficiency
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper is applying the DEA to get the pricing efficiency between customer satisfactions and corporate brand image. This paper utilizes triangular Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) to evaluate the efficiency and amount of improvement. Moreover, the original DEA has weakness in the corresponding items compared with other DMUs. Therefore, we apply other DEA AR model in this paper in order to get the accuracy price efficiency for 10 leisure hotels.

articleTitle: Research on life cycle cost of military connected-container and connector
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The life cycle cost of military connected container and connector is estimated and calculated through analyzing the construction of its breakdown structure. It is validated that the military connected-container and connector designed rationally.

articleTitle: Three-proofing technology of carrier-based fighter missile launcher and failure-case analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The missile launcher of the carrier-based fighter, which directly affects the completion of a launching mission, encounters crucial environmental adaptability problems like high temperature brought by the rocket flame and the marine climates, thus requires higher reliability while being compared to most other parts of the fighter. In this paper, the failure mode and mechanism of carrier-based fighter missile launcher caused by humidity, fungus and salt-fog were analyzed first, especially the corrosion problems. Three-proofing structural design and protection technologies were discussed as followed. Optimum material selection principles as well as some new detection measures were put forward at last.

articleTitle: Systematic analysis of the construction of basic shared technology for modern enterprise
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The paper explore and summarize the education content of the basic shared technology of the modern enterprise in the contemporary. According to the principles and the methods of system engineering, the basic shared technology of the modern enterprise can be separated into four subject, design technology, manufacturing technology, management technology, and information technology. Their research subjects respectively are design system, manufacturing system, management system, and information system, namely, four subsystems of a manufacturing enterprise. Thus the content of the basic shared technology of the modern enterprise are divided to four basic embranchments: advanced design system (ADS), advanced manufacturing system (AMS), advanced management system, and information system. Information technology has become the basic tools of industrial engineering. This paper gives mark graph of the basic shared technology in the development process of the modern enterprise based on the information technology, the content system graph of ADS and AMS. The ADS has a three dimension orthogonal system consisting of object; time and method. The AMS has a three levels structure consisted of manufacturing system, manufacturing mode and manufacturing technology. New models of advanced design system and advance manufacturing system have already been used for content system of ADVANCED DESIGN SYSTEM and ADVANCED MANUFACTURING SYSTEM that are the books of national level of China's “Eleventh Five-Year” Program Textbook. And the latter is evaluated as the “Exquisite Opus Textbook” in the national level of China's “Eleventh Five-Year” Program.

articleTitle: The model of AS-AD-BP and the policies effects
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The Stagflation of the 1970s almost crashed Keynesian economics. It is the model of AS-AD that forced Keynesian economics recovered. Today, Keynesians gradually admit that the model of AS-AD is self-contradictory. Since 2007, financial crisis has generated a tendency that Keynesians would have come back onto the stage<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>. But in the real world, all economy systems are open. However, when the model of AS-AD is generalized in the open economy, we found that all of the Keynesian aggregate demand policies do NOT work even though it is used in respectively solving those problems of the short-run economic growth, unemployment and inflation, based on the model of AS-AD-BP, during analyzing the policies effects.

articleTitle: The innovative application to traditional BT mode
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With rapid development of society, construction upsurge appears in many cities. Under such background, the construction has changed greatly. As one new building mode, BT not only can solve government's capital shortage, but also can make best of private enterprises' advanced technology and management experience, so it is being applied more and more widely. But BT mode also has some shortcomings needing to be overcome. This paper first gives a review to traditional BT modes, and then introduces the application of BT in construction of Chong Qing's Chao Tian Men Yangtze River Bridge, which lasted from 2004 to 2009. In the construction process of this project, new innovative management structure and some management methods are put forward, which are improvement to traditional BT modes. Doing analysis to them has great practical sense to project construction and is good to enrichment of BT study.

articleTitle: Efficiency measurement of industrial development zones by Stochastic Frontier Analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Effective industrial development zones should have their own features to be extended. Efficiency can be measured by input and output. The areas of district, investment capital, and total employment were viewed as input variables. Profit and gross production were considered as output ones. Technical efficiencies of fifteen parks in Inner Mongolia were measured by Stochastic Frontier Analysis (SFA). Cobb Douglas cost function was used. The SFA models that were used were the error component mode. The results showed that the Otog, Munsey and Baotou zones had the highest efficiency. Their management modes could be concluded and learned from other zones.

articleTitle: Game analysis of government and company in the prevention of water disaster in the coal mine
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The water disaster restricts the safe production of coal industry severely. During the process of prevention of water disaster, the interest conflicts of every relevant side influence the efficiency of prevention severely. This study selects the local government and coal company as the interest subjects in the prevention of water disaster; firstly the coordination model using the complete information static game theory is established between the two subjects; then the mixed Nash Equilibrium Strategic Function of the model is solved, and the corresponding prevention strategy is proposed according to model's result. Finally the degree of the influence of increase and decrease of the decisive payoff function on the decisions of local government and coal companies is analyzed by this model based on empirical research. The research shows that in order to prevent the coal mine water disaster effectively, it is necessary to strengthen the supervision of the central government to the local government, increase the input of safety investment of coal company actively, and reduce the punishment cost of the local government reasonably.

articleTitle: Network design for reverse logistics and remanufacturing under uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The reverse logistics network design is gaining in importance because of environmental concerns and issues related to social corporate responsibility.. To efficiently implement product recovery activity, a reverse logistics network is needed which can add value to the used products for the resale in new markets otherwise designing such a complex network would be unproductive. In this research, an approach to design a reverse logistics network for product recovery is presented. The approach consists of both mathematical and simulation models. It considers storing, reprocessing, remanufacturing facilities and new module suppliers in the network. The model is designed using MILP for products having modular structure and then solved for different scenarios of uncertainties using simulation. Furthermore, the impact of uncertainty on costs related to a multi-echelon reverse logistical system has been analyzed.

articleTitle: Research on profit incentive mechanism of general contractor and subcontractors dynamic alliance in construction project
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: It is the key of possessing stable subcontractors and establishing a long-term cooperative partnership that to design sound profit incentive mechanisms and to win-win with subcontractors for general contractor. In the incentive contract of owner, based on the incentive theory and principal-agency model, profit distributing models of general and subcontractors in one-off and long-term cooperation are set up. The results show that the greater the contributions and the lower the effort costs are, the greater the distribution coefficient is; Pareto equilibrium effort level can't be paid in one-off cooperation, so long-term cooperation should be established between general contractor and subcontractors. A higher distribution coefficient should be given to subcontractor in long-term cooperation than in one-off, the more the cooperation times are, the higher the distribution coefficient is. The conclusions can provide thoughts and scientific basis for the design of the subcontract.

Author Keywords: general contractor and subcontractors dynamic alliance(GSCDA)

articleTitle: The suitability evaluation of field selection in cropland improvement project
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Field selection is a prerequisite to carry out the cropland improvement planning and design management. Firstly, the evaluation factors are confirmed according to the analysis of the soil conditions for the crops growth and the field conditions for the modern scientific production. Then an attempt is made to draw on the analytical hierarchical process (AHP) and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation in assigning appropriate weights for the various field factors while computing the membership values of cropland suitability in field selection.

articleTitle: Research of management and construction of evaluation system of low-carbon enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: As enterprise is the main body for implementing energy conservation and emission reduction, the low-carbon economic era imposes higher requirements on the development of enterprises. Based on the theoretical studies on sustainable development, circular economy and low-carbon development, this research has made the corresponding theoretical expansion; through the construction of low-carbon enterprise evaluation system, this paper puts forward the corresponding indicators and evaluation standards for enterprise low-carbon development, and measures the key indicators, so as to appraise the low-carbon performance. Therefore, this research has a high theoretical value.

articleTitle: Discrete variable structure control design for APCS of carrier-based aircraft based on dynamic disturbance compensation
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on introduction and analysis of approach power compensation system (APCS) of carrier-based aircraft, the design problem of approach power compensation system via discrete variable structure control theory is researched and figured out with the use of discrete variable structure control theory bases on disturbance compensation. Furthermore, the chattering phenomenon of the proposed variable structure control system is weakened by using hyperbolic tangent function instead of conventional sign function. Simulation results indicate that the new system owns well performance in path tracking and reducing the influence of airflow disturbance.

articleTitle: Human measurement technology based on small sample and its application in human factors engineering
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The current situation of human measurement technology and the shortage of the practical methods are discussed in the thesis. A measurement method based on small sample is given. With the measuring data, it establishes a computer-aided human body biomechanical model in AnyBody modeling system. Finally, some problems of the application of the small sample method in human factors engineering are discussed.

articleTitle: New optimization on miner robot
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Every day many lives are taken or individuals are handicapped due to the existence of mines remaining from wartime. The following robot is an intelligence system designed for detecting mines in an area. This robot is able to indicate the location of mines.

articleTitle: Influences of the location factors on agglomeration of producer services: An empirical study based on the hypothesis of Marshall & Wood
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Marshall & Wood proposed that the location factors of accessibility, proximity and environmental factors are closely linked with agglomeration economies. From traditional location theories, via the data in 12 major cities of China and four linear regression models, this paper quantitatively analyzed the influences of the three types of location factors on the agglomeration of producer services, and arrived at some corresponding conclusions. Meanwhile, the article concretely analyzed the role of each location factor and identified the relatively significant factors for agglomeration in order to make recommendations accordingly and reference for the further development of producer services.

articleTitle: The empirical research on the structure and elements of Vocational Identity for the potential employees
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Vocational Identity demonstrates the psychological features in the formation and specification of occupational choice. It also reveals the potential occupation fitness and stability of job hunters. In this paper a vocational identity model is proposed based on the framework of Dual-cycle model of self-identity. Proceeding from the applicability for practice, empirical research on the structure and element of vocational identity has been conducted by means of Delphi method and questionnaire with potential employees as subjects.

articleTitle: The research framework of engineering cost consultant industrial symbiosis path based on Marshall's Dilemma
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The development target of engineering cost consultant industry (ECCI) is to realize the equilibrium between scale economy and free competition in China, and the solution of “Marshall's Dilemma” is a critical issue in the development process of ECCI. On the basis of literature review of some researches on the solution of “Marshall's Dilemma”, the paper proposed a research framework of ECCI symbiosis path from perspective of industrial symbiosis theory, and further analyzed its critical issues, which has important significance on theoretical study and practical operating in the process of ECCI development in China.

articleTitle: Analyze and evaluate on the investment risks of the Serviced Apartments under the new Real Estate Regulation Policies —Take the developing Serviced Apartment in Jiao Nan as an example
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Since 2010, the Real Estate Regulation Policies in our country have dense issued, continuously increase interest rates and limit to purchase house, but the commercial real estate is not affected. This paper analyses the investment risks of the Serviced Apartments through combining with the latest Real Estate Regulation Policies, mainly though the AHP and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method to give a quantitative analysis and evaluate to the main risk elements of the Serviced Apartments investment. Then take the developing Serviced Apartments in Jiao Nan as an example, and though AHP method obtains the weights of the investment risk factors, based on this, come up to a comprehensive evaluation though setting up the fuzzy mathematics model. In the last part, it proposes the development strategies and recommendations for Chinese Serviced Apartments, which has a reference impact.

articleTitle: Job dimensions of experienced and nonexperienced workers in process innovation: An exploratory study in Chinese furniture firms
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper provides an insight into job dimensions of employees with different work experience in two phases of introducing CIM in four Chinese furniture firms. The findings of the study illustrate that there are negative impacts of introducing the new manufacturing system on job dimensions of workers, especially for the workers without related work experience before starting their current job. The study offers evidences that it is necessary to make appropriate changes from nontechnological aspects to match a technology adoption for a successful process innovation.

articleTitle: Balancing of mixed-model assembly line based on ant colony optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The mixed-model assembly line balancing problem is a typical NP-Hard combinatorial optimization problem. In this article, the mixed-model assembly line balancing problem is turned into a single-model assembly line balancing problem by the prior sequence diagram. Firstly, mathematical modeling is set up with the given takt time, the least number of workstations and the highest assembly line balancing rate as optimization objective. Then an ant colony optimization algorithm is designed for solving such a mixed-model assembly line balancing problem. A VB program is developed and the effectiveness of the algorithm is proved through a number of specific examples.

articleTitle: Proposal of a new principle on high-orde aspherical machining by CNC tangent method
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In this paper, all of the current aspherical proccessing methods were utilized,and the main factors which influence on the annulus corrugation error in the midst of the aspherical turning process were specifically analyzed. In addition, a novel principle for the high-order aspherical machining process was proposed. The recently developed principle could move the turning tool exaclty along the tangent direction of the aspherical track which was already designed. As a result, the annulus corrugation error can be significantly reduced or eliminated and the high-accuracy,continuous and smooth optical surface was obtained, on the other side, the machining efficiency can also be improved and the cost can be largely reduced.

articleTitle: Research on the transaction memory system in the team of early supplier involvement
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Transaction memory system (TMS) is attracted many scholars from different fields to investigate. Nevertheless, the application of TMS theory on the team of the early supplier involvement (ESI) is surprisingly scant. We propose to demonstrate the TMS helps suppliers' early involvement by eliciting and drawing a causal loop diagram to explicitly and systematically illustrate the process of knowledge flowing and learning, which have some differences between the traditional new product development team (NPD) and the team of ESI. And further examinations of our findings are showed that, in a dynamic environment, the ESI team, the more prior TMS experiences and stronger interaction pattern, the more stable of expectations, which could led to low adaptation of the membership change, forming inertias against the TMS.

articleTitle: Research on the mode of putting TPS in enterprise's practice
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The article describes an implementation mode of Toyota Production System (TPS), there are four stages in the mode: Lean Evaluation, Quality Kaizen, Efficiency Kaizen and Production Kaizen. The article describes the concepts, the activities, the tools, and the targets used in each stage. As basis of TPS, a new application of 5S is developed to use, and the way is easier to be understood and implemented. The article analyzes the application of different tools and activities in the TPS implementation mode, and brings out an implementation mode for TPS.

articleTitle: The self-mapping effect for consumers of qualitygap of TD services
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The quality of telecommunications services plays an important role in deciding whether to buy its telecommunications services for a consumer. This paper first analyzed the quality of telecommunications service and service quality gap. Then, we used the questionnaire method and analyzed the quality gap of TD services existedamong consumers. We find the self-mapping effect for consumers isthe main cause of the gap. At last, this articleis concluded with some policy recommendations to help China Mobile eliminate consumers' self-mapping effect of quality gap of TD services in order to attract more customers.

articleTitle: Robustness optimization for multiresponse using robust distance function
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In many designed experimental situations, several responses are considered simultaneously. Compared with much research work on how to simultaneously optimize multiple responses based on certain criteria or objective functions, little research has been done on how robust the optimum solution is. Generalized distance function approach is one of the most popular methods for the multiresponse optimization problem. However, the consideration of robustness is usually ignored in this method. This paper presents a robust generalized distance function for the multiresponse robust optimization. And its practical application is illustrated with an example. The proposed robust generalized distance function gives more robust optimal result.

articleTitle: A signal game model on security defense of information system
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With the continuous development of informationization, the issues about information systems security have been plaguing firms. As the security of information systems level is uneven, this paper uses signal game theory to study how different types of firms to maximize their own safety benefits in the case of incomplete information. Then analyze necessary and sufficient condition for entirely successful detach Bayesian equilibrium, partly successful pooling Bayesian equilibrium, nearly failing mixed Bayesian equilibrium and corresponding strategies of firms. Finally we propose countermeasures to enhance the overall safety level of firms.

articleTitle: A project management method for small and medium software enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on practice, this essay presents a concise and practical method on development of small and medium software. Combining process management and document management, the author rationally uses QA (Quality Assurance), CVS (Concurrent Versions System), Checksheet and other management mechanisms to include the compilation of different documents and codes into an unified process. The author shows the elements, combination charts and total flow chart of this method in order, as well as the basic documents aimed at filtering of software programs for small and medium enterprises.

articleTitle: Correlational study of producer service and profit in manufacturing enterprises —Taking Aluminium as an example
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper takes Baotou Alumunium Group and Xinjiang Joinworld in China's Alumunium Industry as research samples, the correlation between producer service and profits of enterprises as research purposes. Through the comparison of correlation and regression analysis between producer service investment and profit of the two companies, it can be confirmed the contribution that producer service makes to enterprise's profits and efficiency, which can provide new ideas for enterprises to improve management condition.

articleTitle: Efficient assessment of Electric Power company in Inner Mongolia by rule ensemble
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Evaluation of power enterprise has becoming a focus of electricity industry since market reformation. Operation datum of nine subsidiaries of Inner Mongolia Power Group Co., Ltd was collected. Indexes weights were obtained by AHP. Considering experts' preferences, it is more reasonable to view weights as random variables. Assessment values of sample were calculated by simulation. Rule ensembles algorithm was applied to fit assessment function. The order of 9 constituent companies showed that the smallest Wuhai Electric Power-Supply Bureau had the most efficiency. Its operation experiences deserve extension.

articleTitle: Effects of prolonged truck driving on drive safety based on real road driving
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: To investigate the effects of prolonged monotonous daytime driving on fatigue, reaction time, workload and driving speed, a real road driving has been conducted. To objectively assess the driver's state, workload, fatigue, reaction time and speed are recorded every one hour. Data analysis is based on PASW Statistic 18.0 statistical software. Results show that prolonged daytime driving under monotonous conditions leads to severe fatigue, which, to some extent, results in the increase of driving speed. Compared to the control group, drivers feel more fatigue. The subjective workload and reaction do not vary significantly over the prolonged driving time, and the significant difference between the driving group and the control group is not defined. These findings indicate the deterioration of fatigue and driving performance occurs after approximately 3 h of continuous monotonous daytime driving. It is highly recommended that the driver should take a rest after 3 h of continuous driving.

articleTitle: Innovation design of guide bearing based on TRIZ
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: As the size and weight of the submersible motor support components increase, when bearing shell damaged, guide bearing has some disadvantages, such as, it is difficult to transport, and increases maintenance time and cost etc. To solve this problem, Triz theory is proposed in this study for innovation design of guide bearing. Firstly analyze technology system for guide bearing using multiscreen method, finding the main problem is how to solve the contradiction between removal to repair and stability. That is, maintainability and stability is a pair of technology contradiction. So it can obtain a conflict matrix by existing technology contradiction, then select appropriate innovation principles, therefore an optimization design scheme is established for guide bearing. Finally, a removable guide bearing is designed using this optimization scheme.

articleTitle: Research of technologies on discreet factory construction general contract project management
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper focuses on factory construction management with multi-side participation, which is a general contract at the same time. To solve problems caused by resources sharing among different systems, which result in a divide between information technologies and the de facto requirement, this research applies SOA (Service Oriented Architecture) to integrate resources from different systems, which is a loosely coupled and cross-platform architecture. Through service choreograph, functions in different departments and enterprises could be reused. BPM (Business Process Management), a business process centered method, provides a sound solution to choreograph services. At last, building a business process warehouse to facilitate reuse business processes is proposed.

articleTitle: A new incidence Degree Model of Interval Grey Number based on space mapping
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on the space mapping method, we proposed a new incidence Degree Model of Interval Grey Number. This model digs the geometric meanings of interval grey number. Through calculating the length and midpoint coordinates of interval grey number line, an interval grey number sequence is converted into a group of real number sequence; and then a incidence degree model of interval grey number is set up on the foundation of the Deng's incidence degree model; finally, an example demonstrates the calculation process of the new model. Compared with the original model, there are some properties of this model: First, Calculation is simple; second, grey point sequence and grey length sequence contain all the information of Interval Grey Number sequence. One can obtain a satisfied Incidence Degree of Interval Grey Number by this new model.

Author Keywords: Incidence Degree Model of Interval Grey Number

articleTitle: Study of transport equipment manufacturing competitiveness of GuangXi under the frame of CAFTA
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper analyzed opportunities and challenges of transport equipment manufacturing industry in Guangxi under the background of China-ASEAN Free Trade Area (CAFTA), established the evaluation system of transport equipment manufacturing competitiveness, used the method of principal component analysis to evaluate all province development of transport equipment manufacturing in China, in 2008, found out the rank of transport equipment manufacturing competitiveness in Guangxi. Through the comparative analysis, summarized the main problems existing in this industry and gived the relevant policy suggestions.

articleTitle: Study on the model of demand-capacity analysis in supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: After the research and analyze of demand and capacity management in supply chain, the paper proposed an analysis model of MRP and supplier's capacity based on the demand data model and capacity data model to cover the limitations in current management of demand and capacity. Through the practical application of the model in enterprise, the results showed that the bottleneck of capacity can be found in advanced under the normal and maximal production capacity and the decision supports to adjust the production plan and capacity of suppliers were provided.

articleTitle: Research on informatization intelligence service platform based on exhibition industry
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The exhibition economy is an important resource and name card of Ningbo. Based on the existing characteristics and status of the technological revolution, this study is dedicated to the establishment of an advanced service platform in the exhibition industry, characterized by informatization and intelligence, so as to realize and enhance the value of sharing resources, to build up a platform that can provide the target customers with visualized, personalized and interactive web browser reinforce the degree of their satisfaction.

articleTitle: Reengineering of construction project procurement process on bill of quantities
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The promulgation of The Code of Valuation with Bill of Quantities of Construction Works has resulted in a transformation and revolution in China construction industry. It's essential and crucial to perform BPR (Business Process Reengineering) for Chinese construction corporations to succeed, even survive. Managers must fundamentally rethink and radically redesign the structures of their organizations as well as the operating processes. Construction project procurement process is a key process among various processes in a construction corporation. It is illustrated detailedly how to redesign and reengineer construction project procurement process in this paper.

articleTitle: On the control of Chinese total energy consumption
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on expounding the rapid increase of Chinese total energy consumption which broke through the goal of our national plan repeatedly, this paper analyzes its main reasons in-depthly. We must control the amount of energy consumption for four aspects, such as the storage of energy resources, environmental protection, structural adjustment and energy security. Countermeasures are also put forward accordingly to actualize the total amount control of energy consumption.

articleTitle: Research on knowledge sharing model of engineering consulting businesses
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The engineering consulting business is a knowledge enterprise. And the knowledge management is the core of its management. The knowledge management of the inner part of the enterprise includes the management of the human capital and the organization capital. It involves the person (the knowledge employee), the information technology and the organization structure. The purpose of the knowledge management is to enhance the core competition through knowledge sharing. Based on the organization structure and the information technology, several kinds of knowledge sharing models existed in the engineering consulting businesses are analyzed. It shows that the Creative-Flat knowledge sharing model is the best choice for the engineering consulting business's own characteristics.

articleTitle: The study of SOA-based FMIS
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The facilities management is a very crucial approach to improve production efficiency, decreasing investment and maintenance cost, helping managers to make a right decision. Yet, some problems exist during the process of the information systems applications: such as decentralized planning, isolated construction, only focusing on one side of the business or management. These result in the heterogeneity between enterprise information systems and producing information isolated islands. Service-oriented Architecture (SOA) connects different functions of the application service units through well-defined interfaces and contracts. Based on the practice of facilities management information system (FMIS) in a large-scale vehicle plant, this paper studies the FMIS architecture design and implementation. The SOA architecture is used and revised to form a flexible and rational framework and to implement the loosely coupled, coarse-grained application.

articleTitle: Analysis on affecting factors to the growth of the Listed Companies on GEM of China
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Since the GEM of China was on board in Oct 23rd 2009.more than 200 companies have successfully landed on it, the growth has become a hot topic and many scholars researched on it. This paper pick up 153 Listed Companies which came into the market before the end of 2010 as samples, use Factors Analysis Method and Regression Analysis Method to do some empirical research, the empirical results show that the Listed Companies in GEM, whose debt-paying ability have a negative correlation on the growth, its operating ability, profitability, asset scale, assets structure, cost control ability and cash flow have a positive correlation on the growth.

articleTitle: Research on influence factors and levels of automobile manufacturing system complexity
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Correctly identifying and determining complexity factors and influence levels remains a key issue for carrying out effective control and decision-makings in automobile manufacturing systems and is a pre-condition for bringing the advantages of advanced manufacturing systems into full play. This paper preliminarily identifies eight factors influencing complexity based on considering the variety induced by high integration level of automobile manufacturing systems. Then seen the factors identified as control variables simulation experiments are designed and virtual engine production line models are developed to observe system performance under different variable value. Using simulation output data ANOVA method is applied to test whether or not the factors identified have significant influences on complexity and the influence level. The final analysis results show that except for processing centre quality the others have significant influences on complexity and the greatest one is product structure breadth.

articleTitle: Research on sintering blending cost optimization design for quality loss
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper studies the problem of sintering blending from the perspective of quality loss, based on satisfying sinter property indexes that blast-furnace ironmaking requires. First, linear programming model for optimization blending is establish and return fine of blast furnace (unaccepted product in sintering production) is taken as one decision variable in sintering blending. Second, functional relations between blast furnace return fine and sintering materials, tumbler strength as well as average sinter size have been fitted out by statistical methods, which are considered to be the constraint conditions for the model. Finally, according to the actual production data of the sintering plant from an iron and steel group, the model is calculated using optimization model. The result of the example shows that the optimization model realized the purpose of sinter cost reduction, while quality indexes of sinter were improved.

articleTitle: The inventory demand forecasting model of the regional logistics network in supply chain
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This article is conducting a study on the demand forecast from the x-retailers, y-distribution centers, z-suppliers supply chain of logistics area. The supply chain will be divided into upstream and downstream levels. Combined with the characteristics of the supply chain and demand characteristics of the regional logistics network, Dijkstra shortest path algorithm is used and its demand forecast model is constructed based on it to obtain the exact demand of each node enterprises. At last, an example is given to prove it.

articleTitle: Preventive maintenance scheduling of FMS equipment based on improved ant colony algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The importance of preventive maintenance scheduling has been gradually recognized by decision makers as it includes the necessary tasks to avoid flexible manufacturing system (FMS) unavailability. The PM scheduling of FMS machines is NP-hard problem. ACOA is an efficient method to solve NP-hard problem. This paper put forward an improved algorithm based on multiple ant colonies to solve the PM scheduling plan of FMS machines. Experimental results of a preventive maintenance scheduling of FMS equipment indicate the effectiveness of the adaptive strategies and the efficiency of the multiple ant colonies algorithm.

articleTitle: Application and analysis of TRIZ in man-made environment
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: At present, there are lots of natural and man-made environmental problems and defects. Only under the instruction of Theory of Inventive Problem Solving (TRIZ) can we solve these defects. So we propose that it is necessary to bring forth new ideas in man-made ecological environmental. In order to find the perfect point between principle and innovation, analyses of man-made environmental have been taken from new perspective, on the basis of “The Ark” designed by Alexander Remizov the architect of Russia, combined with ideal result of TRIZ and solution of technical contradiction.

articleTitle: Research on the risk assessment of occupational hazard in thermal power plant
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: According to the principle of risk assessment using risk assessment methods to carry out the risk index classification of occupational hazards which may exist during the production process of thermal power plant. It provides a fundamental basis for thermal power plant to manage occupational health. It also optimizes the methods of occupational health protection according to how important the hazards are.

articleTitle: Real-time online forecasting model of ship rolling motion based on chaotic online LSSVM
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Considering the chaotic characteristics of ship rolling time series, the new real-time forecasting method is proposed to further enhance accuracy and real-time of the prediction model based on support vector machines in the prediction of ship rolling motion, which utilizes phase space reconstruction theory of chaotic systems and online LSSVM. Delay time and delay time window are estimated by C-C method, and then the chaotic online LSSVM real-time prediction model is established. The experiments of ship rolling time series prediction are done. The simulation results indicate the real-time prediction method can more effectively improve the convergence rate and the prediction precision and extend prediction time at the same time, which is compared to the combination prediction model based on support vector machine and neural network.

articleTitle: Energy efficiency at energy intensive factory - a facility planning approach
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Due to energy shortage and energy price increase, energy efficiency is a significant challenge for most factories. In order to get more benefit and become more competitive in the market, energy efficiency should be considered in early planning phase as an essential factor. However, the energy efficiency was often ignored in planning phase in the past decades. For these purposes, a new approach, which can effectively support the analysis and design of facility planning, is presented in this paper. This approach introduces energy efficiency as a key criterion into the planning process. At the same time, material transport costs and manpower costs are also taken into account with the purpose of performing good facility planning from both energy and economic aspects. A practical case study is carried out to validate the correctness and effectiveness of the presented approach.

articleTitle: A summary of the research on financial records logistics management system
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In recent years, the financial records management faces both opportunities and challenges. On the one hand, the flourishing of the financial market leads to more intensive competition in the whole industry. Financial institutions have to improve the records management level in order to provide more efficient and better service to their customers. On the other hand, with the further enhancement of China's economic strength and further increase of financial awareness of the people, financial institutions continue to develop new services and new financial products for the corporate and individual customers, which results in the unprecedented depth and breadth of business content and scope financial institutions. Therefore, under the new situation, the study of financial records logistics management has important practical significance to the development of the financial industry and related industries. Starting with basic theory, this article analyses the structure of records logistics management system and the organization and environment for the financial records logistics management system, thereby putting forward the system objective and future endeavor direction of financial records logistics management system.

articleTitle: The analysis of lean implementation ability and its appraisal model
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Lean production, evolved from Toyota Production System, is the regulation gave by automobile experts of MIT. The success of Toyota Motor Corporation has proven lean production is scientific and powerful, so many enterprises, including enterprises of China, are implementing lean production in order to upgrade core competitiveness. But due to some reasons, the implementation effect in China is not ideal. This paper first analyzes the wrong manner of implementing lean production, and then points out putting emphasis on building implementation ability, thus paying attention to “process” not “result”, can do great good to lean production's smooth implementation in China. After that the appraisal model to lean implementation ability is put forward, and finally one example is used to show the copulation process as well as the model's reasonability and feasibility.

articleTitle: Two-sided with multi-parallel stations assembly line balancing based on heuristic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Two-sided assembly lines are typically found in assembling large-sized high-volume products. One position of the two-sided assembly line usually has more than two parallel stations work simultaneously. Less attention has been paid to solving this problem. This paper researches the two-sided with multi-parallel stations assembly line balancing problem, and proposes a heuristic algorithm to solve the problem.

articleTitle: Reliability function of electronic equipments suffering a single environmental stress based on Poisson Process
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Environmental stresses are usually crucial factors leading to the fault of Electronic Equipments. In the past, Stress-Strength Interference Model (SSI) was applied extensively to analyze the reliability of Electronic Equipments suffering environmental stresses, correspondingly, the reliability was acquired as a fixed value. However, the reliability decreases as time goes on. For that reason, this paper establishes the function of the reliability of Electronic Equipments and time based on Poisson Process, improving Stress-strength Interference Model of Reliability. First, some relevant theories of Poisson Process and characteristics of environmental stresses are presented. Secondly, this paper studies the statistical property of a single environmental stress over time, and then, established the function of reliability and time. This function is verified by Monte-Carlo Simulation. At last, an example is provided to illustrate the feasibility of the findings in practice. This paper presents a new method to study the reliability of Electronic Equipments suffering a single environmental stress. In addition, the findings can be expected to provide guidelines for reliability design and life forecasting of Electronic Equipments.

articleTitle: Research on the converse FTA-FMECA comprehensive analysis based on Monte Carlo Simulation
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The existing research of FTA-FMECA (Fault Tree Analysis - Failure Mode Effect and Criticality Analysis) comprehensive analysis method can be classified into two fields: the positive combination and converse combination. This paper firstly describes the principle of converse combination technique, and then puts forward a model of converse FTA-FMECA comprehensive analysis based on Monte Carlo Simulation. Finally, a case of a certain electric power steering (EPS) is given to prove that the model is feasible.

articleTitle: Balancing analysis and algorithm design for mixed model assembly lines
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to rationally design the mixed model assembly line and effectively solve the assembly line balancing problem, this paper analyses the characteristics of mixed model assembly lines and designs a new algorithm based on the process exchange. This algorithm could combine with research achievements of mixed model sequencing problems to make the assembly line more balanced owing to its high compatibility. This paper describes the principle and the executing process of this new algorithm in details. Lastly, the new algorithm was applied in an automobile harness of lamp assembly line, the results of which proved the validity and feasibility of the algorithm this paper proposed.

articleTitle: Contract design of CLSC with recycled quantity affected by the interaction of recycling price and sales volume
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: On the base of the assumption that the recycled quantity of used products is affected by the interaction of recycling price and sales volume, this paper researches closed-loop supply chain's pricing and coordination, gives system members' optimal pricing and profits in decentralized decision and centralized decision and finds that reverse supply chain itself is in coordination and traditional forward supply chain is in incoordiantion under decentralized decision. Then it designs a revenue sharing contract which can coordinate closed-loop supply chain. At last, a numerical example is given to verify the conclusions drew in this paper.

articleTitle: Simulated annealing approach for the single-machine total late work scheduling problem with a position-based learning
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper considers a single-machine scheduling problem with a position-based learning effect where the aim is to find an optimal sequence to minimize the total late work. The late work for a job means the amount of processing of this job that is performed after its due date. Because the problem under consideration is NP-hard, this paper then proposes several simulated annealing algorithms for the near-optimal solution. Finally, the computational results of proposed algorithms are also reported.

articleTitle: Concerning the important position of product modeling design in the product life cycle strategy
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The length of the product life cycle can bring determines to value, and the interests of the product life cycle is not as long as possible. However, life cycle is too short to cause its lacking of competitivity in the market. Control product life cycle need scientific strategy. Product life cycle strategy includes many things, such as marketing strategy, development strategy, advertising strategies, etc. Product modeling design in product life cycle has its universal and special rules, the correct understanding and utilization of these rules, which can make the product modeling design strategy in the product life cycle to play an important role.

articleTitle: Research on evaluation for capability of process innovation in manufacturing enterprises— under IT circumstance
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With the widely used IT in manufacturing enterprises, the evaluation on capability of process innovation with IT is becoming increasingly important. The capability of process innovation with IT performs in many aspects, including not only financial but also customer, internal business, learning and growth perspectives. This study constructs an approach based on the balanced scorecard and the analytic hierarchy process for assessing the capability of process innovation with IT in the manufacturing industry in China.

articleTitle: Business model dynamics: A case study of Apple Inc.
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Traditionally, people once believed that business model should be static (something that is unchangeable), but in recent years, scholars have suggested that the dynamic business model of companies can bring about more lasting and more successful developments. This paper, based on Dynamic Business Model Framework, identifies and characterizes three stages: creation, extension and revision by demonstration of the change of Apple's business models. The results of the empirical analysis exhibited fully the good applicability of Dynamic Business Model Framework for characterizing business model dynamics.

articleTitle: The study of crisis response process for coal mine flooding based on knowledge generation
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: By analyzing the current crisis response process for coal mine flooding to identify its problems, this paper proposes knowledge generation theory and improves the crisis response system of rescuing coal mine flooding. Finally, it analyses the systems before and after improved by using fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method. Results show that using knowledge generation theory can improve the efficiency of crisis response system to rescuing coal mine flooding.

articleTitle: Study on the simulation of outpatient operating room process and capacity planning in terms of cost optimization
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: According to the real practice of hospital outpatient operating rooms, the problem of process and capacity planning is analyzed by considering the rule of balancing and increasing the resource utilization; based on queuing theory, this paper brings out the outpatient operating room process upswing plan and establishes simulation models; then, this paper puts forward the total cost objective function of outpatient operating rooms, and uses FlexsimHC to solve a case with the model above, and then analyzes the system indicators and costs, and finally determines the most rational model. This paper can be well verified in outpatient operating room process and capacity planning, and provide a scientific quantitative basis for hospital management decision-making.

articleTitle: Analysis on the influencing factors and countermeasures of high college and university competitiveness based on feedback archetype generating set
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In the paper, takes high college and university in Jiangxi province as an example, based on the survey in the targeted high college and university, with the help of the literature review, research methodology, analysis on the actual situation of high college and university and analytical framework of the competitiveness, the paper established the main influencing factors that acted on high college and university competitiveness, then on the basis of the influencing factors, built level-rate units of system dynamics and level variable-into-tree models based on standardized modeling method-in-trees archetype generating set method, and classified all the archetypes into four groups according to key influencing factors that play an important role in improving competitiveness of high college and university, then proposed the countermeasures of improving competitiveness.

articleTitle: The product life cycle design in Plant Extracts Industry
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: China's Plant Extracts Industry (PEI) is growing fast and becoming a new strategic industry, which has a promising future. Based on ecological processes of plant extracts products, an application of product life cycle design is the best way of system design evaluation for building an environmentally friendly plant extract industry. The importance lies in several ways including the sustainable utilization of plant resources, heavy metals and pesticide residues, microbial pollution control, the promotion of market access for high-end products. The key to enhance life cycle assessment (LCA) needed to be resolved by establishing and improving PEI's LCA database.

articleTitle: Analysis of Eco-Industrial Park supporting system on industrial symbiosis
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The establishment and development of the industrial symbiosis of Eco-Industrial Park is affected by several factors. Based on the formed industrial symbiosis supporting system chart, this article analyses the microcosmic supporting system and macroscopically supporting system. In the microcosmic supporting system, it detailed elaborates five aspects including key enterprises, service intermediaries in the Park, symbiotic enterprises, competitors and public. Then it describes the macroscopically supporting system from four aspects of governmental participation, technological innovation, educational promotion and cultural support. Finally, combining with the current construction status of the Eco-Industrial Park in China, it brings out the countermeasures and suggestions to build the supporting system for the Eco-Industrial Park and provides theoretic support for the faster and better construction of the Eco-Industrial Park in China.

articleTitle: The relationship of product reliability and its process dimensions: A study on product reliability assurance in manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The Stream of variation (SoV) model deals with process dimensional variation propagation of multistage machining processes. It describes the relationship of process dimensions and end-product dimensions. The reliability of end-products varies because of dimension deviation since the materials, designs and manufacturing processes are fixed in batch production. This paper studies the feasibility of modeling the relationship of reliability of products and the process dimensions (RPPD) based on the SoV model. RPPD modeling should be done in the design phase before launching the manufacturing process. Related work based on the RPPD model including key process characteristics identification, manufacturing process monitoring, feed-forward control are also discussed. It is shown that the RPPD model can be a useful tool in the assurance of reliability of end-productions in manufacturing.

articleTitle: Dynamic capabilities of the Chinese Football Clubs
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This dissertation is based on the ideas of dynamic capabilities in enterprise management science, it mainly discusses under dynamic circumstances, the effects of dynamic capabilities on Chinese Football Clubs' abilities to enhance their own strength and to maintain their competitive advantages. It establishes a research framework of retaining a dominant relationship between the clubs and their resource integration capability, tradition evolvement capability, and function transformation capability. This article utilizes network resources, interviews, internal club documents, discussions with senior football insiders, external documents and many other information sources to establish a fundamental research database; on the basis of the research database, it adopts multidimensional regression calculation method, cause and effect planning to analyze data, through case analysis examines under dynamic circumstances, ShanDong LuNeng football club's resource integration capability, tradition evolvement capability, and function transformation capability, thus, validates research propositions raised in this dissertation and in the process, reaches a conclusion: under dynamic circumstances, football clubs' dynamic capabilities has a positive effect on the continuous maintenance of competitive advantages during the self development phase of these domestic club.

articleTitle: The structure and development of visual system of airdrome control tower simulator
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: For a long time, due to the lack of a good airdrome tower control simulation training facilities and environments, the ATC controller trainees of both military and civil aviation are trained only by primitive simulation facilities and a short-time practice. Since the controllers' skills heavily depends on the quality of their training, it is crucial to develop new and more effective training methods. In order to improve the effectiveness of visual training, enabling surveying the airdrome for reconstruction without interfering with the air traffic and providing risk prediction for natural disasters, in this paper, we study the structure of tower simulator visual system from a practical viewpoint, and develop a sample system for the Latvian Riga airport. Our airdrome tower simulator creates virtual three-dimensional images of vivid moving aircrafts and airport vehicles, provides virtual console and communication equipments, and mimics the workflow and system responses of a real airdrome control.

articleTitle: Application of grey prediction models in final assembly duration of civil aircraft
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: As a basis for rational organized production, yearly production program and production planning are made respectively according to assembly cycle, which is a significant link of the whole process and has a great impact on the performance, lifespan and cost of production itself. Aiming at the complicated process of airplane assembly and less sample data, combining with the characteristics of Grey System Theory, this paper chooses the GM (1, N) to obtain a precise model by estimating the aircraft assembly duration.

articleTitle: Control stratory in coastal area using Markov Chain and Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Economy in coastal cities plays an important role in China. It is urgent to protect environment with economy developing. Four types of sea water quality can be regarded as states of Markov Chain. Transfer probability is viewed as the function of sewage and investment in environmental protection. Based on historical datum in Tianjin, the function is estimated by Random Forest. Given objective of sewage reduction and environmental investment, transfer probability matrix can be calculated and long-term proportion of four types of sea water is obtained. It provides scientific reference for design goal of sewage reduction and environmental investment in reason.

articleTitle: Construction of intelligent power distribution system in box-type substation based on field-bus technology
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on the field-bus technology and combined with the industrial control products, the intelligent power distribution system in box-type substation was investigated. The scheme model for the intelligent power distribution system was constructed using the field-bus technology. The hardware used in the intelligent power distribution system was presented. The intelligent power distribution system presented in this paper improved the technology of the equipment in box-type substation. The stability and reliability of the box-type substation products were enhanced greatly, which satisfied the users.

articleTitle: Analysis on effects of risk management level on internal control
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: It is specified within Appendix C of Business risk Management - Integrated Framework issued by COSO in 2004, that “Internal Control is involved in, and is an inseparable part of business risk management.” Meanwhile, it is emphasized that “Risk management framework is, indeed, not a substitute for internal control framework.” (COSO, 2004). Such descriptions leave the academic circle with a question which is how to accurately define the relation between internal control and risk management? In this article, effects of risk management level on internal control are theoretically analyzed by using mathematic tools, such analysis is conductive to figure out relation between internal control and risk management; assist policy-makers to scientifically define range of policies, and avoid omission and overlap; reduce cost of internal control and risk management, and increase efficiency and benefit of internal control and risk management.

articleTitle: Part information modeling based on manufacturing features
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper has introduced a part information model that takes manufacturing feature as the basic elements. The manufacturing feature refers to the processing surface of using some cutting tool or processing method to complete one time, it is the basic elements to compose a part. It has discussed the feature classification as well as the data structure of constructing part information model. This model not only includes the part geometric model, but also includes the feature model, precision model, material model and auxiliary model. Because the manufacturing feature corresponds with some processing methods, the part model based on the manufacturing feature is particularly beneficial to realize the automatic programming of numerical control machining, beneficial to realize manufacturing automation. At the same time, this model is constructed on the basis of geometric model; it has solved the key factor to realize the CAD/CAM integration.

articleTitle: The analysis of Guangxi's cultural and creative industries development
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
