abstract: Cultural and creative industries are a kind of practice which canonizes innovation and emphasizes blend of culture and economy at the background of knowledge economy. Cultural and creative industries not only promote economy development and exalt urban competitiveness, but also engender community consciousness in psychology and shapes urban whole image. Cultural and creative industries are the new points of growth in the economic development of the city. With the economic system switch, industries upgrade, city functional shift, the independent innovation has becoming the national strategy. The creative industry has brought the huge benefit for the society and economic development. At present, many cities and areas already started to develop the creative industry. Against the backdrop of the industry tend toward gathering, Guangxi's creative industries keep continuous rising, industrial development obtains the new environment, shows the new features, faces the new problems and expects the new idea, and shows the new development direction and development tendency under the guidance of the party's “China's 17th Communist Party Congress”. Against this major background, the article maintains that Guangxi should conform to historical, energetically develop creative industries, and give top priority to the development of cultural and creative industries. The paper analyzes the conditions, advantages, methods and others of Guangxi's cultural and creative industries.

articleTitle: Thinking about the application and development strategy of industrial engineering
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper points out: the tradition industrial engineering originated in the manufacturing industry, but the future industrial engineering will be suitable for all the integrated system which contains people and objects; the tradition industrial engineering emphasis on micro-management, but the development of the future industrial engineering will pay first attention to the macro-problems. It has analyzed the relationship of the specialized engineering technology and the industrial engineering technology in the integrated system, and pointed out: because the industrial engineering technology has the seeking optimization characteristic and the hysteresis of developing time, the research and application for industrial engineering technology falls behind to the specialized engineering technology. It has further pointed out that the application and extension of industrial engineering will appear the development period and slow growing period, in slow growing period, it will develop slowly, even stagnate. This paper has analyzed the reasons which cause this situation and proposed the countermeasures.

articleTitle: Analysis and research for interior workshop in FAW Car Co., Ltd.
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Thesis using the OEE analysis, system studies, examples and other research methods. Based on the FAW Group Co., Ltd. of equipment management, computing OEE workshop production lines and equipment based on the interior of the FAW truck shop equipment exists to make a detailed analysis of management; for their problems, put forward a company needs for standardization, efficiency of management methods. Overall Equipment Efficiency improvements in enhancing the FAW Group Co., Ltd. Device Management level, will bring economic benefits to the company and corporate culture and other aspects of the harvest.

articleTitle: Business model innovation in China's mobile multimedia broadcasting service
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With the development of mobile communication technologies, the mobile multimedia broadcasting service is becoming one of the important parts of our life. In China the China Broadcasting Communication (CBC) was set up to improve the developing of mobile multimedia broadcasting service based on the China Mobile Multimedia Broadcasting (CMMB) technology standard. This paper analyses the development process and status of the CMMB service in China, and summarises the successful experience of business model innovation in the CMMB service. The selection of business model cannot be determined by a single element. It is a problem of synthesis which is related to the company's technical innovation, organizational innovation, service innovation, financial innovation, and to the market, policy and other factors. The core of the mobile service business model has been transformed from particular subjects, such as operators, service providers, consumers, businesses elements, to the whole value network.

articleTitle: Experimental research about matching relationship between group size and communication mode in group decision-making
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The matching relationship between group size and communication modes is investigated in this paper. Three teams of students whose average age is 21 years old, and each team is divided into several groups with 3 to 17 persons respectively to take the experiment for an intellectual task, by means of two communication modes of FTF and CM. Quality of schemes created by different groups have been compared, the result shows that group in FTF mode can create better scheme than in CM mode when the group size is smaller (n≤7), and turns reversal when the group size is larger (n≥11).

articleTitle: Whether the education has effect on loan defaults: A theoretical and empirical study
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Education is often considered an important factor for the loan repayment. After the review of the literature, we establish a theoretical model which can measure various factors on the impact of loan defaults. With the relevant information, we obtain different results with different education groups in loan default and draw the corresponding conclusions.

articleTitle: The application of six sigma methods in Packing Line Y of Company A
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Facing the phenomena of high downtime and high outage rate, unstable OEE level of the equipment and unable to achieve the best level on Packing Line Y of Company A we use six sigma analysis tools for finding the various downtime reasons on Packing Line Y and then find out the key influence factors to OEE level, and present some improvement.

articleTitle: Distribution of curate future lifetime and model of life actuarial on credibility space
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to make the life actuarial theoretical model more extensive and more effective, this paper based the basic concepts in the credibility space and the conclusion of the credibility distribution of a fuzzy variable takes value on interval, gives that distribution expressions of curtate future lifetime and model of curtate-expectation-of-lifein the credibility space, and deduced the model of actuarial present value for payable at the end of the year of death on the credibility space. The life actuarial theory was extended from probability space to credibility space which is more extensive than the former.

articleTitle: Investigation of ergonomics in Chinese university cafeterias' working situation at peak hours using jack
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Cafeterias play a vital role in universities, however, in China, where shows a high frequency of occupational ill health at university cafeterias' staffs, few researches have been conducted on ergonomics in university cafeterias. The objective of this study is to investigate the physical ergonomics situations in Chinese university cafeterias and find out the reasons behind such a high occupational diseases frequency. Investigation in our university's cafeteria and ergonomic simulation of providing meal tasks at peak hours were carried out. Cafeteria's situation was simulated by using Siemens Jack. Four main task analysis toolkits (TAT) were used; they were NIOSH, Metabolic energy expenditure, Ovako Working Posture Analysis (OWAS) and Rapid Upper Limb Assessment (RULA). This study demonstrates that reducing the working hours and minimizing the loads on staffs' hands show benefits for reducing exposure to occupational illness during Chinese university cafeterias' working. It is urgent to develop programs that provide staffs with necessary ergonomics knowledge and skills regarding proper working postures.

articleTitle: Boiler feed water control system based on improved MFAC
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper improved the model free adaptive control (MFAC) method. And applied the improved MFAC algorithm to boiler feed water control system. Use the improved Model Free Adaptive controller as the main controller and P controller as the deputy controller. The two different control algorithms compose of the cascade control in boiler feed water control system. To demonstrate the control effects we did lots of simulation experiments. And the simulation results shown that, compared with basic MFAC and PID, the improved MFAC algorithm has superior stability, stronger anti-interference ability, faster tracking speed, better adaptability and robustness.

articleTitle: Multi granularity resource encapsulation for P2P Semantic Manufacturing Grid
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Extended manufacturing resource involving all kinds of resources passing through the product lifecycle, are diversified, complex, weak online automation and remote control. It is supposed to be carefully explored before conceiving a Manufacturing Grid. Taken a Peer-to-Peer (P2P) (between resource providers and consumers) Semantic Manufacturing Grid as the background scene, this paper classifies manufacturing resources into six cell categories based on the types and characteristics analysis of them and for the purpose of supporting inter organizational collaborative manufacturing. Then a multi granularity resource network model is fabricated, from which a multi granularity WSRF service set is derived. The structure of the resource cell and the service along with their relationship are formalized by ontology. The model and method was employed in a P2PSMG prototype system which then verified their feasibility.

articleTitle: Modeling study of lot-sizing in virtual enterprise based on Multi-objective
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: According to the operational features of virtual enterprise, lot-sizing is divided into two parts-process batch size (PBS) and transfer batch size (TBS). Multi-objective optimization model based on production logistics balance, shortest time and lowest cost is established to research the optimum PBS and TBS of bottleneck and its forward or backward. The application example and results show that the optimum lot-sizing ensure the production rhythm of all stages are in synchronism, and the logistics time and cost are declined. This paper is of certain directive significance to practical production.

articleTitle: A new progress in the theory of PERT
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper put forward the concept of “quasi-critical path” and related four theorems. We proved that each activity has a quasi-critical path related with it. By “activity dependent quasi-critical path” we mean that for this activity, there must be a path preceding it and for all activities in the path their free slacks are zeros. Similarly, there must be a path succeeding it and for all activities in the path, their backward free slacks (a new concept!) are zeros. The difference between a “critical path” and an “activity dependent quasi-critical path” is: For the “critical path”, there are no time slacks. For the “activity dependent quasi-critical path”, there are no free slacks in the activities preceding this activity and no backward free slacks in the activities succeeding this activity. For important activities with uncertain time we need to calculate their “activity dependent quasi-critical path” to guarantee enough time for them.

articleTitle: Research on estimation of energy consumption in machining process based on CBR
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The estimate result of energy consumption in machining process could be used in process planning evaluation, workshop scheduling and fine energy management. In the layer of process planning, a process model of energy consumption prediction based on case-based reasoning was presented, in view of the characteristics of energy consumption in discrete manufactures, the case retrieval process and the method of energy consumption result reuse were proposed. The machining process of turbine rotor was taken as example to verify the feasibility and validity of the approach finally.

articleTitle: Improved genetic neural network for image segmentation
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The paper provides the method of the improved genetic neural network for image segmentation. The method uses improved genetic algorithm BP neural network weights and thresholds to optimize, and use the definition of bipolar fitness function mapping compression to speed up neural network training speed, and then use iterative improved neural network algorithm to achieve image segmentation. The results of experimental show that the improved genetic neural network can better achieve the image segmentation, compared with the traditional method; Compared with BP neural network training speed is greatly improved.

articleTitle: The study of man-machine interface design based on Kansei engineering and with the center on users
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper starts with the concept of Kansei engineering and man-machine interface to discuss the relationship between them. The paper also further analyzes visual perception elements of man-machine interface which is based on kansei engineering, i.e. color and image, and their application in man-machine interface design. After in-depth analysis, it's concluded that kansei engineering with the center on users plays a significant part in man-machine interface design.

articleTitle: A research on educational efficiency evaluation of vocational school based on SE-DEA
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Traditional DEA model such as CCR and BCC cannot be applied to rank the efficient DMUs. In this paper, we present a new DEA-based model, in which the upper bound value of efficiency can be relaxed, to evaluate and rank the educational efficiency and performance of vocational schools in 30 provinces in mainland China. This new technique, super-efficiency data envelope analysis, abbreviated to SE-DEA, has shown its advantages over the traditional DEA models in encouraging greater output of efficient DMUs. Considering all relevant factors comprehensively, three optimized input indicators and three output indicators are selected to formulate the DMU indicator system to evaluate the efficiency of each province. Finally, after modeling and calculating the efficiency of each DMU based on SE-DEA, a ranking list of efficiencies of all provinces can be obtained and the intrinsic factors that affect their efficiency can be acquired. The result indicates that the east part of China ranked the highest in educational efficiency in 2007 and 2008. In the end of this paper, some constructive suggestions for those provinces which are inefficient are proposed.

articleTitle: Pricing and capacity planning decisions for BTO manufacturing based on priority differentiation strategy
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Many BTO manufacturing firms are exploring production strategies when customers may be segmented into different classes based on service level or priority. Such segmentation can result in a more efficient production system as well as a better match between supply and demand. A BTO manufacturing system with two customer classes is studied, where one customer class has higher priority of fulfillment than the other customer class. Optimal pricing and capacity planning decisions for each segment assuming each segment demand as being linear in price are developed. Numerical studies show that priority differentiation strategy increases profit and product substitutability influences a firm's differentiation strategy.

articleTitle: The empirical study on Market orientation and joint actions
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Drawing upon the resource-based perspectives, this study aims to examine how market orientation of the firm's strategy orientation can be beneficial to performance. Using survey data from a sample of SMEs from mainland China in Yangtze triangle area, we demonstrate that Market orientation plays a very important role on joint actions. Market orientation facilitates joint actions. In other words, the higher the level of Market orientation is, the higher the level of both joint planning and joint problem solving is. Future studies can take joint action as mediator to find their impact on performance. Theoretical and managerial implications are discussed.

articleTitle: Just-in-time preemptive one-machine problem with costs of earliness- tardiness, interruption and work in process: A mathematical programming
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper considers preemption and idle time are allowed in a one-machine scheduling problem with just-in-time (JIT) approach. It incorporates earliness/tardiness penalties, interruption penalties and holding cost of jobs which are waiting to be processed as work-in-process (WIP). Generally in non-preemptive problems, earliness/tardiness penalties are a function of the completion time of the jobs. Then, we introduce a non-linear preemptive scheduling model where the earliness penalty depends on the starting time of a job. The model is linearized by an elaborately-designed procedure to reach the optimum solution. To validate and verify the performance of proposed model, computational results are presented by solving a number of numerical examples.

articleTitle: Knowledge management performance evaluation based on triangular fuzzy number and the theory of knowledge cycle
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to express the differences between subjective judgments and real results and reflect the dynamic process of knowledge management performance evaluation, the paper bases on the triangular fuzzy number and knowledge cycle theory to construct a knowledge management performance evaluation index system, with knowledge acquisition, knowledge sharing, knowledge utilization and knowledge innovation as its foundation. The paper summarizes the weights of each index with the theory of triangular fuzzy number and describes how to evaluate the knowledge management performance through the observation of knowledge management performance index in detail. The effectiveness of this method is also illustrated by the empirical analysis.

articleTitle: Evaluation of measurement items involved in the assessment of personal tacit knowledge
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: As tacit knowledge is stored in people's heads and is difficult to be articulated, if we want to manage it pertinently we should assess it firstly. Researches on the tacit knowledge assessment are being carried out in many related fields. However, few researches are done on determining the weights of measurement items which are used to assess one's tacit knowledge. So this paper, based on the results of previous studies, proposes a new method, Fuzzy Weighted G1 method (FWG1 for short), to determine the measurement items' weights. On the one hand, this method can overcome the defects of AHP and FAHP which are often used to determine indexes' weights; on the other hand, this method can improve the measurement's accuracy of indexes' weights.

articleTitle: The model research of upper limb and toothbrush in ergonomics
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: A new type of man machine model between upper limbs and toothbrush has been established. The research involves the analysis and designing of toothbrush in ergonomic aspect. Using this method, the mechanism motion analysis has been done from related portions of the upper limb and brushing motion analysis. The work gets some man-machine rules for brushing. That built foundation in brushing product design and toothbrush design structure relations.

articleTitle: Research on joint distribution of sinter and pellet in iron and steel enterprise based on transportation problem
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: An iron and steel enterprise needs to distribute sinter and pellet from different sintering workshops and pelletizing workshops to multiple blast furnaces. The iron content in sinter and pellet can substitute for one another. However, as the iron grades of sinter that each sintering workshop produces are different, the amount and the iron grades that the blast furnace receives are different. So is the pellet, and both of them are coupling. This paper solves the joint relation of distributions between them, and reduces the cost of production of blast furnaces. Taking cost minimization as the objective function and taking interval numbers as the constraint, a mathematical model is established in this paper. The optimizing that joint distribution brings to the production cost of blast furnace is reflected by setting the shadow prices of sinter and pellet. Finally, an example illustrates the application of the proposed methodology.

articleTitle: Optimization of wind turbine vane manufacture based on queuing theory
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Wind turbine vane is the key components of wind power generators effectively capture the wind. RTM is a manufacture technology of advanced composite materials, low cost, medium batch blade. Some random factors often lead to the production schedule can not be predetermined program normally. It can help reduce production costs that with the start-up costs were study of production scheduling on single injection machine vane manufacture. It is focused on the applications of queuing theory in the anemoscope processing problems of wind turbine. After a statement of the basic problem, various situations involving possibility knowledge are investigated. The single injection machine vane manufacture model based on N-policy M/G/1 is established. Making the lowest total cost of the system as the objective function to optimize the problem, it is found the most optimal number of buffer vane.

articleTitle: Forecasting of production cycle of engineer-to-order products
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Mass customization has turned out to be a crucial style of modern manufacturing for meeting customers' individual and diversifiable demands, in which forecasting a production cycle plays an important role due to being a basis of order signing and production organizing for enterprises. Currently, literature employs general methodology such as time series and combination forecast, which may result in low accuracy of prediction and not adaptation to customized needs. This study focuses on products stipulated in orders, dealing with components of production cycle in general modules of production-predicting, and in designing, making, and assembly of product special modules. On this basis, the study establishes a model of manufacturing cycle estimation and makes an empirical analysis of Xi'an XD Switchgear Electrical Co.

articleTitle: Study on presentation layer structure of multi-tenant e-business systems
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In this paper, some researches have been done on the customization method of SaaS user interface. A method based on Portlet and relevant technology is used to construct the presentation layer of SaaS and the customization of user interface can be fulfilled. It makes the construction of SaaS presentation layer have the loosely coupled and service-oriented characteristics and can realize the expansion of different levels.

articleTitle: Post-earthquake emergency rescue system based on multi-agent simulation
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Rescue forces decide the results of a rescue. We try to quantitatively study the rescue forces' influence on the result of the earthquake relief[1][2]. We build a model of post-earthquake emergency rescue system on the CAS theory and build a simulation model based on Swarm platform. And analyze the outputs of the simulation. Through the analysis, we find that in the rescue process, the number of rescuer and the proportion of professional rescuer in the rescue forces has a great impact on the results, and the time of each rescue has an obvious impact in early rescue processing but not in late.

articleTitle: Color saturation preference of train's seat based on visual comfort
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Color selection in train's inner design plays a crucial role in creating impressions of the overall environment and shaping the special brand image, on account of color's sensibility aspects and being associated with a certain atmosphere or a style. This research used a series of experiments with variable saturation, that the observer was asked to adjust saturation of the seat's color to the most comfortable level. The result shows, in the same backgroud of train interior, the selection of the same color's saturation has no strong consistency. It is caused by individual differences in color preference. When the mean value calculated from each tester's optimum value, the saturation selection has a certain tendency: For the warm color, the overall trend shows that people prefer the medium saturation; For cool colors such as green or blue, the overall trend shows that people prefer the higher saturation.

articleTitle: Research on problems and countermeasures of college entrepreneurship education
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Entrepreneurship education is a new education idea which western countries come to in the late 1980s, it advocated to take cultivating students' entrepreneurial skills and entrepreneurial spirit as a higher education primary goal. In recent years, Chinese university education face new difficult to entrepreneurship education, most universities still stay in the minority “entrepreneurial activity”, rather than most people's “entrepreneurship education” level. This article analyzes the existing problems in the college education development and some countermeasures pertinently, in order to provide reference for education in college students' entrepreneurship education and promote the healthy development of university of sustainable entrepreneurship education.

articleTitle: A study on the evaluation of water conservancy for well-off rural area building in China—The evaluation of water resource management
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: To build a well-off society in an all-around way is the target of China. It is a long term goal that may take a century to accomplish. The rural population is the majority of the nation's. In order to reach a well-off society at a quick pace, the comprehensive improvement of economy, culture, technology and social level in the rural areas is the key, and, water conservancy is vital to the national economy and the people's livelihood. In reference to relevant materials and research results, the authors sum up the evaluating indicators of water conservancy for a well-off rural area. In addition they make evaluation of the indexes of water resources based on DEA and arrive at some conclusions. This article can be used as a referential material for the state, government and society.

articleTitle: Application of activity-based costing on cost accounting of acupuncture project
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Nowadays, hospital managers pay more and more attention to the cost accounting in order to reduce the hospital operating cost and improve efficiency. The appearance of activity-based costing (ABC), whose idea is “cost objects consume activities, which in turn consume resources”, gives a new idea to cost accounting of medical treatment project. In this paper, ABC is applied to the acupuncture service project to calculate the cost of acupuncture project and the ratio of each activity cost. The results proved that ABC was valid for the cost accounting of medical treatment project.

articleTitle: Application of fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method based on entropy to evaluation risk of an EPC project
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Recently, more and more big projects are contracting by EPC (Engineer-Procure-Construct) mode. Comparing with traditional contract modes, the general contractors face more risks. In this paper, a method of fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method based on entropy is used to evaluate the risks in EPC projects, building a risk evaluation model. Moreover, the modified normalization method has been used, so the evaluation result is more scientific and reasonable. The result shows that fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method based on entropy is feasible and has some application value in the practice.

articleTitle: Cooperation among business incubator, venture capital and entrepreneur from the principal-agent's perspective
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper uses framework of one principal and two agents to argue the cooperation among the venture capital, business incubator and entrepreneur. The paper shows that venture capital, entrepreneur and business incubator will cooperate if their private information is fully revealed. At the same time, the three parties will put into the highest effort level and they can be also assigned the highest net profit. Secondly, the tripartite efforts level is lower when one of the three parties cooperates with another. In the end, the tripartite efforts level is the lowest when all of them only pursue their own maximum utility respectively. The effort level that one of the three parties cooperates with another is relevant to the profit percentage of another party.

articleTitle: The analysis of coal mine safety management evaluation system based on the DEMATEL and ISM model
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Mine safety management is the most important task to ensure safety in coal mines. To ensure the effective implementation of mine safety management and find an effective way to implement safety management, it must recommend a complete evaluation of safety management system. Based on DEMATEL methods and ISM model, we intend to establish the system architecture of indicators of impact on mine safety management system and to explore effective ways to implement safety management.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional gantt chart based resource-constrained multiple projects scheduling and critical chain identification
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Aiming at resources-constrained multiple projects scheduling problem (RCMPSP), a three-dimensional representation is presented through extending the two-dimensional representation of resources-constrained scheduling problem by adding resource dimension to the two-dimensional Gantt chart. It can clearly display the resources consumption of every activity and provide valuable reference for concerning bottleneck resources and solving the resources conflict. In addition, a hybrid algorithm which combined the merits of bidirectional scheduling and parallel schedule generation scheme (PSGS) is proposed to optimize the RCMPSP. Furthermore how to use the presented three-dimensional Gantt chart to represent the schedule and identify critical chain is also described in details. The results of single project with single resource scheduling, single project with multiple resources scheduling, multiple projects with single resource scheduling and multiple projects with multiple resources scheduling show that the proposed approach is effective and explicit for resource constrained project scheduling and critical chain identification.

articleTitle: Research on Probability Reliability-Centered Maintenance model based on Requirement-Oriented Maintenance
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on the requirement of integrating manufacture and modern industry maintenance mode, to solve the yes or no rigid determinant of maintenance decision which is adopted by Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM), as well as they brought judgment difficulty, misjudgement and difficult to synthesis etc. The decision process and method of reliability-centered maintenance are reconstructed. The decision method of Probability Reliability-Centered Maintenance (PRCM) is put forward. Thereby Reliability-Centered Maintenance is pressed close to enterprise maintenance requirement. Finally, the validity of this model is demonstrated by example of certain petrifaction corporation.

articleTitle: Application of TRIZ to improve the layout for a screw packaging factory
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Although the screw is a small peanut, it is really basic and necessary in our living. It is an integral part of almost all the industrial products. In this study, a systematic and innovative approach that use TRIZ (Teoriya Resheniya Izobreatatelskikh Zadatch) will be applied to solve the layout problems of an existing screw packaging factory. In this TRIZ approach, the layout of the factory is modified and a closed loop type RGVS (Rail Guided Vehicle System) with forklift device is applied. Some of forklift trucks will be replaced by this automatic material handling system. The advantages of this modification will increase the numbers of packaging lines and double the yield of production. In addition, it can also improve the industrial safety and make the environment more eco-friendly.

articleTitle: CART approach in the credit evaluation of certified cost engineer in China
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper proposes a credit evaluation and decision-making model for the enterprises to determine the credibility of the certified cost engineer in China. However, Personnel credit evaluation is quite different from enterprise credit evaluation. Both qualitative and quantitative criteria and information should be considered in the credit evaluation processes. Classification and regression tree (CART) is used in this study for it combines the two criteria. The indicators system of credit evaluation is established of 25 key factors, embedded within two broad categories-business credit indicators and practicing credit indicators. Finally, an example is provided for illustrative purpose.

articleTitle: Enterprises strategy deployment based on HOS
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: According to the problem that existing in Chinese typical enterprise group such as lacking of efficient strategy transition and difficulty of translating strategy into operation actions, a new methodology of strategy deployment is proposed which takes critical success factor, key strategy performance index and action plan into consideration. In the proposed methodology, a new tool named House of Strategy (HOS) is given to realize strategy transformation based on Quality Function Deployment (QFD) approach. Finally, a software prototype system is developed and a case study is presented to illustrate the application of the methodology.

articleTitle: An exploratory study of supplier selection and evaluation techniques
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The increasing importance assigned to supplier relationship management has alerted firms about how to select their suppliers. Since companies are focusing on their core competencies and relying on suppliers so as to have more competitive advantage in their processes, selecting and monitoring suppliers have been shown to be strategic activities that can provide continuous improvement in the supply chain. Thus, this paper investigated how Brazilian companies in the food sector have been selecting and monitoring their suppliers and whether or not they are applying advanced tools and techniques. The findings offer useful insights as to what further improvements regarding such activities might best be explored.

articleTitle: The research into crisis early warning of supply chain quality based on Rough Set&Feature Weighted Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: A RS-FWSVM model is presented by means of combining RS (Rough Set) with FWSVM (Feature Weighted Support Vector Machine) theory. Application process of this model to the crisis early warning of SCQ is researched, which can help enable chain enterprises to identify crises in the process of operations and to predict possible crises.

articleTitle: Simulation of astronaut's movement for orbital replaceable units
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This study primarily focuses on the simulation of an astronaut moving the orbital replaceable units (ORUs) into the worksites in spacecraft payloads or removing them from these worksites. The upper limb model is established, which includes three segments of upper arm, forearm, and hand, as well as three revolute joints of shoulder, elbow, and wrist. Joint kinematical parameters during one period were obtained by using the numerical solution of reverse kinematical equation. The corresponding virtual upper limb model was established and simulated using LifeMOD software. Thus, the simulation results can be validated by comparing the simulation trajectories of the mass center of hands with that of hands' known motion. Additionally, the joints' strengths can be compared when hands move in different directions of the human body coordinate system. The results are useful to astronaut's orbital mission planning and training in the ground.

articleTitle: Selection of appropriate technology based on Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Appropriate technology represents an important theory of technology and is drawing more and more attention nowadays. It is of great strategic significance for an enterprise or a country to select appropriate technology rationally and scientifically. But the previous selection of appropriate technology is based on experience only for lack of in-depth study of theory, especially quantitative study. In this paper the author thinks that Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation (FCE), as a feasible and effective method, can be applied into the selection of appropriate technology. After summarizing and sorting out the initial, multilevel and multioperator mathematical models of FCE, the author proposes and analyses preliminarily the index system of appropriate technology selection and its general method with FCE. He further illustrates the general process of appropriate technology selection with a practical example, in the hope of realizing the selection to be scientific, standardized and quantitative.

articleTitle: Value chain risk analysis, measurement and management strategy—Based on fuzzy set
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Due to the structural characteristics of the value chain, there exists great risk. Any problem that occurred in any link would influence the entire value chain. Risk management of value chain will become an important future research direction. This paper summarizes the main risk sources in the value chain and provides their assessment method. The results analyzed from which the counter measures for preventing the value chain risk are suggested.

articleTitle: The research of the improving management of AA Corporation based on Industrial Engineering under the post financial crisis era
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Aim at the impact of the financial crisis to SMEs, and the present situation and management problems of SMEs, according to the management improvement of AA Corporation based on IE under the post financial crisis era, from the aspects of the 5S management implementation for production site management improvement, warehouse consolidation, the establishment of basic management data and corresponding management procedures, strengthening the process management and quality control, the improvement of production performance and so on, to investigate the approach for SMEs to deal with the financial crisis with the application of basic IE to improve the management level of enterprises.

articleTitle: Applying constraint satisfaction methods in life cycle engineering
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Engineering, economical, environmental, and social performance of a product need to be considered comprehensively to reach a globally acceptable product solution. These aspects are determined and realized during several product life cycle stages. Life cycle stages are interrelated and mutually constrained. Each stage has its own concerns while they need to coordinate to reach global product solutions. This paper proposes using distributed constraint satisfaction methods to model and solve product life cycle problems.

articleTitle: Research on document management system based on streaming storage technology
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper mainly analyzed the graphics storage way used in document management system-streaming storage technology, and expounded at length how this kind of storage way stored different formats of graphics in data base. Also it introduced the way the system used to display and operate the graphics, and summarized the merits of the way above. In the end, the paper briefly introduced a scheme composed of design and achievement of document management system in a pharmaceutical packaging company to show the advantages when using streaming storage technology.

articleTitle: Optimization of knowledge work based on experts' implicit knowledge mining
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: To improve the efficiency of knowledge work, an optimization method, mining experts' implicit knowledge is proposed. The valuable implicit knowledge is mined from the experts, and then the corresponding model of work steps and related implicit knowledge is established. Considered the specialty of implicit knowledge existed in different practical activities, an experiment about dimension design based on the secondary development of ANSYS is performed. The experts' implicit knowledge work is externalized with methods of think-aloud protocols and observations. At last, comparative experiments are designed to analyze the optimization effect, and the result indicates that the externalized knowledge has obvious contribution to the knowledge work optimization.

articleTitle: Internal salary gap, government intervention and enterprise performance: Evidence from Chinese listed companies
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Since the outbreaks of the international financial crisis in 2008, exorbitant executives salary has become a hot topic, and extensive discussions had carried out about salary fairness as well as whether salary gap of executives can realize the effective incentive. Based on the unbalanced panel data of Chinese A-share listed companies from 2005 to 2007, this article builds linear regression models between executive salary gap and enterprise performance which take the government intervention into account, and the empirical results show that: In companies whose internal salary gap is not big, the internal salary gap and enterprise performance are positively related and the reduction of government intervention is benefit to improve firm performance; Whereas in companies whose internal salary gap is exorbitant, the internal salary gap and enterprise performance are negatively related and the government intervention doesn't significantly affect firm performance. Our empirical results are helpful for the current executive incentive and salary reformation.

articleTitle: Bi-level programming model for the paid use of waterfront resources
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: As a kind of scarce and valuable natural resources, waterfront resources must be utilized scientifically. However, due to irrational distribution and rapid exploitation, there is increasing scarcity of waterfront resources in countries. In order to realize the value of them, paid use should be implemented. This paper started with a general description of several kinds of natural resources pricing models. Considering the game behavior between government and companies, a bi-level programming model was set up. The upper-level problem represented government whose target was to maximize the efficiency whereas companies as the users of waterfront resources were the lower-level decision-makers seeking the lowest cost. And then sensitivity analysis method was proposed as a solution approach of the model. Bi-level programming model combined with paid use provides a new research thought to sustainable exploitation and utilization of waterfront resources.

articleTitle: Comprehensive evaluation of teaching and talents cultivation based on factor analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper establishes a comprehensive evaluation indicator system of teaching and talents cultivation and elaborates principles and procedures of the evaluation indicator system based on factor analysis. It carries out an empirical study on the outcome of teaching and talents cultivation in 58 key disciplines in 15 Tianjin higher educational institutes during the period of the “11th Five-Year” Plan. Finally the result shows that factor analysis is an objective and suitable method for appraising teaching and talents cultivation outcome.

articleTitle: The research of college student group crisis evolution mechanism and intervention mechanism in higher education zone of China
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With the development and construction of higher education zone, college student group crisis in the zone can't be ignored. This article aims at the unique characteristics of the college student group crisis in higher education zone, analyzes the generation and evolution mechanism of crisis, and puts forward to establish a group crisis intervention mechanism with the mode of government-school double-core, school-student double linkage and culture-emotion double influence.

articleTitle: Implementation strategy of Eco-city: Taking an example for Sino-Tianjin Eco-city
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Sino-Singapore Tianjin Eco-city is a strategic cooperation project between China and Singapore to build an eco-culture and improve the people's living environment. In this paper, to ensure this target, some implementation stategies were put froward which including building a sustainable resource using system with intensive development mode, a low-carbon eco-industrial system cycle, a safe and healthy environment system and a people-oriented, livable and friendly environment system.

articleTitle: Research of the coordination between philosophy of user-friendly and awareness of green environmental protection
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The philosophy of user-friendly and awareness of green environmental protection currently are the important design concept of industrial design. There are not only similarities and intersection, but also contradictions and conflicts. This article focuses on how to coordinate the relationship between user-friendly design and awareness of green environmental protection, how to create an optimal balance between them, and realize the coordinate of “people - product - environment”.

articleTitle: Application practice of SPC technology in the process of DVR production
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: SPC technology was applied to the process of DVR production of a company in Hangzhou of Zhejiang province of China. The product defects were analyzed statistically first. The main effects which affects the product performance were found by T-type matrix chart analysis.

articleTitle: The new iterative methods for the solution of H-matrices linear equations
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In [1], the modified Gauss-Seidel method with a preconditioning matrix was proposed. And the authors of [1] obtained the result that the convergence rate of the new method with a preconditioning matrix was better than that of the basic iterative method. In this paper, we proposed the new preconditioning matrix and provided the convergence theorems of the new method. Finally, numerical example shows that the convergence rate of the new iterative method is superior to the corresponding classical Gauss-Seidel method.

articleTitle: Extension evaluation on coal seam geological condition of coal face from the point of view of mining technology
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The extension engineering method is combined with evaluation on coal seam geological condition of coal face from the point of view of mining technology. From the point of view of mining technology, the important geological factors which affect the mining work are took into account for evaluation. On the basis of matter-element theory, extension set theory and dependent function calculation, an extension evaluation model on coal seam geological condition is proposed. Lastly, the application of evaluation method is shown.

articleTitle: A dynamic model for the handling of the surplus bulk goods
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With the rapid development of our country, the demands of steel, timber and other bulk goods are greatly increased, the transportation becomes even more important and complicated. For the difference of vehicles' loading capacity, in the process of transferring vehicles, it is likely to cause surplus. In this paper, we study on the handling of the surplus bulk goods due to the transferring vehicles in purchasing and transportation. In order to choose the best handling mode for the surplus, we establish a model of dynamic programming. In the model, we want to satisfy customers' needs first, then try to reduce the inventory and make the total costs minimized. At the end of the paper, a timber retailer who imports Russian logs is taken as an example to verify the correctness of the model. The results of the paper can provide some reference for the retailers of bulk goods.

articleTitle: The express aviation network hub optimization method research based on the genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: As to the location optimization of the express aviation, this paper presents a scientific and effective hub choice evaluation model, focusing on the goal of cost optimization. The result of optimization is automatically employed in the type and quantity selection of the freighters, accordingly a reference evaluation model is established for the express hub optimization, freighters selection and flight path design in the express aviation network. Genetic algorithm is applied in the solution of the model, with code rules and crossover operators being set correspondingly. In the last part, feasibility and effectiveness of this model is verified through a case study on optimization calculation.

articleTitle: Iteration planning of product concurrent design process based on activity item
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: To manage product concurrent design process effectively, a product concurrent design process model supporting the concurrent iteration of product design and process plan is established based on the Generalized Stochastic Petri Nets, the workflow abstract model of the product concurrent design process is given. The task item and activity item of the product concurrent design process is described based on the task decomposition model. The activity item state together with its transformation and the activity item action together with its transformation are analyzed based on the workflow abstract model. The workflow control mechanism of product concurrent design process is built based on the Petri net and activity item. It's the basis of implementation of concurrent design.

articleTitle: The micro-level of formation and evolution of innovation cluster: Based on the mechanism of organizational tacit knowledge spillover
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: On the basis of in conclusion the existing research on the formation and evolution mechanism of innovation cluster, summarizes the content of tacit knowledge and tacit knowledge spillovers, and for the study of organization, divided tacit knowledge spillover for three levels which are within the organization, between organizations and cluster level; in accordance with the current more mainstream life-cycle theory for formation and evolution of innovation cluster, divided the course into three stages which are its formation, development and maturity, and through the establishment of two-dimensional model diagram, give a creative research on mechanism of how the tacit knowledge spillover affects the formation and evolution of innovation clusters.

articleTitle: An emergency service center location model for vehicle repair with priority queuing rules and service level constrains
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE 18th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The system of vehicle repair service is a problem that needs to research on the location of repair centers according to the service needs and available resource based on the maximal covering location and priority queuing theory. Considering the effect of waiting time due to rush jobs, this paper proposes a model that maximizes the service covering, and restrains the service level of uncovered zones. Model application with solution approaches by LINGO is provided through an example illustrations to demonstrates the applicability of the model.
